AntiAliasingSupported.s: Returns which anti-aliasing methods the graphics card supports, as booleans for FXAA, CMAA and CMAA2. The graphics settings only list the methods it reports.

ArchaeologyGetIconInfo.s: Returns the icon information of the archaeology entry at the index.

AreDangerousScriptsAllowed.s: Whether the player has allowed scripts run from the chat (`/run`, `/script`).

AreTalentsLocked.s: Returns whether the player's talents are currently locked.

p.target: The name of the player to invite.

ArenaTeamInviteByName.s: Invites the player by name to the arena team.

p.target: The name of the new captain.

ArenaTeamSetLeaderByName.s: Makes the named player the arena team's captain.

p.target: The name of the player to remove.

ArenaTeamUninviteByName.s: Removes the named player from the arena team.

AttachGlyphToSpell.s: Applies the glyph the player is currently using to the spell with the given ID. Blizzard's spell book and flyout call it when the player clicks a spell while a glyph is pending, often after a confirmation dialog.

AutoChooseCurrentGraphicsSetting.s: Has the client choose the current graphics setting automatically.

AutoLootMailItem.s: Takes all attachments and money from the inbox mail at the given index. Blizzard's inbox only calls it for mail without cash on delivery, or after the player confirms the payment.

BNAcceptFriendInvite.s: Accepts the pending Battle.net friend request with the given invite ID.

BNCheckBattleTagInviteToGuildMember.s: Starts a BattleTag friend request to the guild member with the given full name. The client checks the request first and then asks the player to confirm it.

BNCheckBattleTagInviteToUnit.s: Starts a BattleTag friend request to the given unit. The client checks the request and sets the target, so the confirmation can then send it with `C_BattleNet.SendVerifiedBattleNetFriendInvite`.

BNDeclineFriendInvite.s: Declines the pending Battle.net friend request with the given invite ID.

BNFeaturesEnabled.s: Returns whether Battle.net features are available to this client. Blizzard's friends frame hides its Battle.net panel when they are not, and checks `BNConnected` as well before using them.

BNFeaturesEnabledAndConnected.s: Returns whether Battle.net features are available and the client is connected to Battle.net.

BNGetBlockedInfo.s: Returns the ID and name of the blocked Battle.net account at the given index of the player's invite block list.

BNGetDisplayName.s: Returns the display name of the Battle.net account with the given ID, as used to send it a whisper.

BNGetNumBlocked.s: Returns how many Battle.net accounts the player has blocked from sending invites.

BNGetNumFOF.s: Returns the number of mutual friends and potential friends among the friends of the given Battle.net account. Request the data with `BNRequestFOFInfo` first.

BNGetNumFriendInvites.s: Returns how many Battle.net friend requests are waiting for the player's answer.

BNGetSelectedBlock.s: Returns the index of the Battle.net invite block selected in the ignore list.

BNGetSelectedFriend.s: Returns the index of the Battle.net friend selected in the friends list.

BNInviteFriend.s: Invites the Battle.net friend's game account to the player's group.

BNIsBlocked.s: Returns whether the Battle.net account with the given ID is blocked.

BNIsFriend.s: Returns whether the Battle.net account with the given ID is on the player's friends list.

BNIsSelf.s: Returns whether the Battle.net account with the given ID is the player's own account.

BNRemoveFriend.s: Removes the Battle.net account with the given ID from the player's friends list. Blizzard's UI asks the player to confirm first.

BNRequestFOFInfo.s: Requests the friends list of the given Battle.net friend from the server, for the friends of friends view.

BNRequestInviteFriend.s: Asks the Battle.net friend's game account with the given ID to invite the player to their group.

BNSendFriendInvite.s: Sends a Battle.net friend request to a BattleTag or email address.

BNSendFriendInviteByID.s: Sends a Battle.net friend request to the account with the given Battle.net account ID, such as a friend of a friend.

BNSendVerifiedBattleTagInvite.s: Sends a Battle.net friend request to a verified BattleTag.

BNSetSelectedBlock.s: Selects the Battle.net invite block at the given index in the ignore list.

BNSetSelectedFriend.s: Selects the Battle.net friend at the given index in the friends list.

BNSummonFriendByIndex.s: Summons the Battle.net friend at the given friends list index through Recruit-A-Friend, as `C_RecruitAFriend.SummonFriend` does for character friends.

BattlefieldMgrEntryInviteResponse.s: Accepts or declines the invitation to enter the world PvP zone battle with the given ID.

BattlefieldMgrExitRequest.s: Leaves the queue for the world PvP zone battle with the given ID.

BattlefieldMgrQueueInviteResponse.s: Accepts or declines the invitation to queue for the world PvP zone battle with the given ID.

BattlefieldMgrQueueRequest.s: Requests to queue for a world PvP zone battle.

Blob:DrawAll.s: Draws the areas of all quests on the map.

Browser:NavigateForward.s: Goes forward to the next page.

Browser:NavigateHome.s: Opens the browser's home page of the given type.

Browser:NavigateTo.s: Loads the given URL in the browser frame.

Browser:OpenExternalLink.s: Opens the current page in the system's web browser.

Browser:OpenTicket.s: Opens the support ticket in the browser.

Button:SetPushedTexture.s: Sets the texture the button shows while pushed.

BuyGuildBankTab.s: Buys the next guild bank tab. Blizzard's UI calls it from the confirmation dialog that shows the cost.

C_AccountServices.GetPreferredLocales.s: Returns the languages the player can choose as preferred, as a list of IDs and a list of names.

C_AccountStore.BeginPurchase.s: Starts buying the item from the account store.

C_AccountStore.GetCategories.s: Returns the IDs of the store front's categories.

C_ActionBar.FindFlyoutActionButtons.s: Returns the action slots that hold the flyout.

C_ActionBar.GetExtraBarIndex.s: Returns the action bar page of the extra action bar.

C_ActionBar.GetProfessionQualityInfo.s: Returns information about the crafting quality of the item in the action slot.

C_ActionBar.GetSpell.s: Returns the ID of the spell in the action slot, or 0 when it holds none.

C_ActionBar.GetTempShapeshiftBarIndex.s: Returns the action bar page of the temporary shapeshift bar.

C_ActionBar.GetVehicleBarIndex.s: Returns the action bar page of the vehicle bar.

C_ActionBar.HasAssistedCombatActionButto.s: Whether an action slot holds the assisted combat action.

C_ActionBar.HasBonusActionBar.s: Whether the player has a bonus action bar, such as for a stance or form.

C_ActionBar.HasExtraActionBar.s: Whether the extra action bar is shown.

C_ActionBar.HasFlyoutActionButtons.s: Whether an action slot holds the flyout.

C_ActionBar.HasOverrideActionBar.s: Whether the player has an override action bar.

C_ActionBar.HasPetActionPetBarIndices.s: Whether a pet bar slot holds the pet action.

C_ActionBar.HasRangeRequirements.s: Whether the action in the slot has a range, such as a spell with one.

C_ActionBar.HasSpellActionButtons.s: Whether an action slot holds the spell.

C_ActionBar.HasTempShapeshiftActionBar.s: Whether the player has a temporary shapeshift action bar.

C_ActionBar.HasVehicleActionBar.s: Whether the player has a vehicle action bar.

C_ActionBar.IsAutoCastPetAction.s: Whether the pet action in the slot can autocast.

C_ActionBar.IsAutoRepeatAction.s: Whether the action in the slot is repeating, such as Auto Shot.

C_ActionBar.IsItemAction.s: Whether the action slot holds an item.

C_ActionBar.IsPossessBarVisible.s: Whether the possess bar is shown.

C_ActionBar.IsStackableAction.s: Whether the action slot holds an item that stacks.

C_ActionBar.IsUsableAction.s: Returns whether the action in the slot is usable, and whether it lacks only power (such as mana) to be.

C_ActionBar.PutActionInSlot.s: Places what the cursor holds in the action slot.

p.cooldownFrame: The cooldown frame that shows the action's cooldown.

C_ActionBar.SetActionBarPage.s: Switches the main action bar to the page.

C_ActionBar.ShouldOverrideBarShowManaBar.s: Whether the override bar shows a power bar.

C_ActionBar.ShouldShowKeyring.s: Whether the keyring button is shown.

C_ActionBar.ToggleAutoCastPetAction.s: Turns autocast on or off for the pet action in the slot.

C_ActionBar.UnregisterActionUIButton.s: Stops the game updating the button registered with `RegisterActionUIButton`.

C_ActionBar.UsesActionText.s: Whether the action slot shows text, such as a macro's name.

C_AddOns.DoesAddOnHaveLoadError.s: Whether the addon failed to load.

C_AddOns.GetAddOnNotes.s: Returns the addon's notes from its TOC file.

C_AddOns.GetAddOnSecurity.s: Returns whether the addon is secure (Blizzard's) or insecure.

C_AddOns.GetAddOnTitle.s: Returns the addon's title from its TOC file, or its name without one.

C_AddOns.GetScriptsDisallowedForBeta.s: Whether addon scripts are disallowed on this beta client.

C_AdventureJournal.ActivateEntry.s: Acts on an Adventure Guide suggestion, such as opening the dungeon finder or quest log it points to. Takes the suggestion's index; the matching `AJ_*` event fires.

C_AdventureJournal.GetNumAvailableSugges.s: Returns how many Adventure Guide suggestions are available.

C_AdventureJournal.GetSuggestions.s: Fills the table passed in with the Adventure Guide's current suggestions.

C_AdventureJournal.SetPrimaryOffset.s: Sets which suggestion the Adventure Guide shows in its main slot, as an offset into the suggestion list.

C_AdventureJournal.UpdateSuggestions.s: Asks the game to rebuild the Adventure Guide's suggestions. Blizzard passes true after the player levels up and false after their item level rises.

EJ_ClearSearch.s: Clears the current Encounter Journal search and its results.

EJ_EndSearch.s: Ends the current Encounter Journal search.

EJ_GetContentTuningID.s: Returns the content tuning ID of the instance selected in the Encounter Journal. Blizzard's UI passes it with the difficulty to `SetHyperlink` for journal tooltips.

EJ_GetCreatureInfo.s: Returns the ID, name, description, display ID, icon and model scene ID of a creature in an encounter, by index. Without an encounter ID it uses the selected encounter.

EJ_GetCurrentTier.s: Returns the index of the Encounter Journal tier (expansion) that is selected.

EJ_GetDifficulty.s: Returns the difficulty ID selected in the Encounter Journal.

EJ_GetEncounterInfo.s: Returns the name, description, boss ID, root section ID, link, journal instance ID, dungeon encounter ID and map ID of the journal encounter with the given ID.

EJ_GetEncounterInfoByIndex.s: Returns the same information as `EJ_GetEncounterInfo` for the encounter at the given index of the selected instance. Returns nothing past the last encounter.

EJ_GetInstanceByIndex.s: Returns the journal instance ID, name, description, images, link and map ID of the dungeon or raid at the given index of the selected tier. The second argument picks raids (`true`) or dungeons (`false`).

EJ_GetInstanceForMap.s: Returns the journal instance ID that belongs to the given map ID.

EJ_GetInstanceInfo.s: Returns the name, description, images, map IDs, difficulty display flag and other information of a journal instance. Without an ID it describes the instance selected in the Encounter Journal.

EJ_GetInvTypeSortOrder.s: Returns the position of an inventory type in the Encounter Journal's item sort order. Blizzard's loot journal and transmog UI sort items with it.

EJ_GetLootFilter.s: Returns the class ID and specialization ID the Encounter Journal's loot list is filtered by. A specialization ID of 0 means no specialization filter.

EJ_GetMapEncounter.s: Returns information about the journal encounter at the given index on a map, including its name and encounter ID.

EJ_GetNumEncountersForLootByIndex.s: Returns how many encounters drop the item at the given index of the Encounter Journal's loot list.

EJ_GetNumLoot.s: Returns how many items are in the Encounter Journal's loot list for the current selection. Read each one with `C_EncounterJournal.GetLootInfoByIndex`.

EJ_GetNumSearchResults.s: Returns how many results the current Encounter Journal search has found.

EJ_GetNumTiers.s: Returns the number of Encounter Journal tiers (expansions).

EJ_GetSearchProgress.s: Returns how far the current Encounter Journal search has got. Divide it by `EJ_GetSearchSize` for the fraction done.

EJ_GetSearchResult.s: Returns the ID, type, difficulty ID, instance ID, encounter ID and item link of the Encounter Journal search result at the given index.

EJ_GetSearchSize.s: Returns the total amount of journal data the current Encounter Journal search goes through. It is 0 while the data is not loaded.

EJ_GetSectionPath.s: Returns the IDs of the journal sections that lead to the given section, so they can be expanded to show it.

EJ_GetTierInfo.s: Returns the name of the Encounter Journal tier (expansion) at the given index.

EJ_HandleLinkPath.s: Returns the instance ID, encounter ID, section ID and tier index that a journal link of the given type and ID points to.

EJ_InstanceIsRaid.s: Returns whether the instance selected in the Encounter Journal is a raid.

EJ_IsLootListOutOfDate.s: Returns whether the Encounter Journal's loot list is out of date and must be built again.

EJ_IsSearchFinished.s: Returns whether the current Encounter Journal search has finished.

EJ_IsValidInstanceDifficulty.s: Returns whether the selected Encounter Journal instance has the given difficulty. Blizzard's code notes it cannot check difficulty IDs above 64 and uses `C_EncounterJournal.InstanceHasDifficultyID` for those.

EJ_ResetLootFilter.s: Clears the class and specialization filter of the Encounter Journal's loot list.

EJ_SelectEncounter.s: Selects the journal encounter with the given ID in the Encounter Journal.

EJ_SelectInstance.s: Selects the journal instance with the given ID in the Encounter Journal.

EJ_SelectTier.s: Selects the Encounter Journal tier (expansion) at the given index.

EJ_SetDifficulty.s: Sets the difficulty the Encounter Journal shows encounters and loot for. Blizzard's UI checks it with `EJ_IsValidInstanceDifficulty` first.

EJ_SetLootFilter.s: Filters the Encounter Journal's loot list by class ID and specialization ID.

EJ_SetSearch.s: Starts an Encounter Journal search for the given text.

GetLFGCompletionRewardItem.s: Returns the icon, quantity, bonus flag and bonus quantity, name, quality, ID and object type (`item` or `currency`) of the dungeon completion reward at the given index.

GetLFGCompletionRewardItemLink.s: Returns the link of the dungeon completion reward at the given index.

GetLFGDungeonRewardCapInfo.s: Returns the currency a group finder dungeon rewards and how much of it the player can still earn against its limits.

GetLFGDungeonRewardInfo.s: Returns the name, icon, quantity, bonus flag, reward type, reward ID and quality of the reward at the given index of the given group finder dungeon.

GetLFGDungeonRewardLink.s: Returns the link of the reward at the given index of the given group finder dungeon.

GetLFGDungeonRewards.s: Returns whether the player has completed the given group finder dungeon today, its money and experience rewards, the number of other rewards and a spell ID.

GetLFGDungeonShortageRewardInfo.s: Returns the name, icon, quantity, bonus flag, reward type, reward ID and quality of a reward for queuing in a role the dungeon is short of, by shortage index and reward index.

GetLFGDungeonShortageRewardLink.s: Returns the link of a reward for queuing in a role the dungeon is short of, by shortage index and reward index.

GetLFGInfoServer.s: Returns the server's information about the player's group finder entry for a category and ID: whether in a party, joined and queued, the comment, slot count, category and the roles signed up for.

GetLFGInviteRoleAvailability.s: Returns whether the given role is available to the player, and whether to show an alert for it.

GetLFGInviteRoleRestrictions.s: Returns a table of the reasons the player cannot take the given role.

GetLFGProposalEncounter.s: Returns the name and kill state of the boss at the given index of the group finder proposal's instance.

GetLFGProposalMember.s: Returns whether the member at the given index of the group finder proposal is the leader, their role, level, whether they have answered and accepted, their name and class.

GetLFGQueuedList.s: Fills the given table with the IDs the player is queued for in the given group finder category, keyed by ID, and returns it.

GetLFGReadyCheckUpdate.s: Returns whether a group finder ready check is in progress and whether it is for a battleground queue.

GetLFGReadyCheckUpdateBattlegroundInfo.s: Returns the name of the battleground queue the current ready check is for.

GetLFGRoleUpdate.s: Returns whether a group finder role check is in progress, the number of slots and members, the category and ID it is for, and whether it is for a battleground.

GetLFGRoleUpdateMember.s: Returns information about the group member at the given index of the current role check.

GetLFGSuspendedPlayers.s: Returns a table of the names of the group members who are not ready while the group's queue in the given category is suspended.

GetLatestCompletedAchievements.s: Returns the IDs of the achievements the player completed most recently. Pass `true` for the guild's achievements.

GetLatestCompletedComparisonAchievements.s: Returns the IDs of the achievements the compared unit completed most recently.

GetLatestUpdatedComparisonStats.s: Returns the IDs of the compared unit's statistics that changed most recently.

GetLatestUpdatedStats.s: Returns the IDs of the player's statistics that changed most recently.

GetLegacyRaidDifficultyID.s: Returns the legacy raid difficulty the player chose.

GetLocalGameTime.s: Returns the game's time of day as hour and minute.

GetLooseMacroIcons.s: Adds a further set of spell icons available for macros to the given table. Blizzard's icon picker combines it with `GetMacroIcons`.

GetLooseMacroItemIcons.s: Adds a further set of item icons available for macros to the given table. Blizzard's icon picker combines it with `GetMacroItemIcons`.

GetMacroIcons.s: Adds the spell icons available for macros to the given table.

GetMacroItemIcons.s: Adds the item icons available for macros to the given table.

GetManaRegenFromSpirit.s: Returns the mana regeneration the player gets from Spirit.

GetMaxCombatRatingBonus.s: Returns the highest bonus a combat rating can give.

GetMaxNumCUFProfiles.s: Returns the maximum number of raid frame profiles. Blizzard's UI disables the new profile button once `GetNumRaidProfiles` reaches it.

GetMaxRenderScale.s: Returns the highest value the render scale setting allows.

GetMaxRewardCurrencies.s: Returns the maximum number of currency rewards a quest can have.

GetMaxSpellStartRecoveryOffset.s: Returns the largest offset allowed for the start of a spell's recovery.

GetMaximumExpansionLevel.s: Returns the newest expansion level available.

GetMerchantCurrencies.s: Returns the currencies the merchant accepts.

GetMerchantFilter.s: Returns the filter the merchant's item list uses.

GetMinRenderScale.s: Returns the lowest value the render scale setting allows.

GetMinimumExpansionLevel.s: Returns the oldest expansion level the game supports.

GetModResilienceDamageReduction.s: Returns the damage reduction the player gets from resilience modifiers.

GetModifiedClickAction.s: Returns the name of the modified-click action at the given index.

GetMonitorAspectRatio.s: Returns the aspect ratio of the monitor.

GetMonitorCount.s: Returns the number of monitors. The graphics settings list them by index with `GetMonitorName`.

GetMonitorName.s: Returns the name of the monitor at the given index, and whether it is the primary monitor.

GetMouseButtonName.s: Returns the name of a mouse button.

GetMovieDownloadProgress.s: Returns whether a movie is downloading and how much of it has been downloaded.

GetNativeRealmID.s: Returns the ID of the player's home realm.

GetNetIpTypes.s: Returns the IP version of each of the client's connections.

p.startIndex: The marker to start searching from.
p.treatDeadNonFriendlyAsAvailable: Whether markers on dead enemies count as free.
p.wrapSearch: Whether to continue from the other end.

GetNextAvailableRaidTargetMarkerIndex.s: Returns the next raid target marker that is not in use.

GetNextCompleatedTutorial.s: Returns the ID of the next tutorial the player has seen after the given one, for paging through seen tutorials.

GetNextPendingInviteConfirmation.s: Returns the next group invite that waits for the player's confirmation, if any.

GetNormalizedRealmName.s: Returns the player's realm name without spaces and hyphens.

GetNumArenaOpponentSpecs.s: Returns the number of arena opponents whose specialization is known. It is available before the match starts, unlike `GetNumArenaOpponents`.

GetNumArenaOpponents.s: Returns the number of opponents in the current arena match. It is only known once the match has started.

GetNumBattlefieldFlagPositions.s: Returns the number of flags whose position the battlefield map can show.

GetNumBattlefieldVehicles.s: Returns the number of vehicles the battlefield map can show.

GetNumChannelMembers.s: Returns the number of members in a chat channel.

GetNumDisplayChannels.s: Returns the number of entries in the chat channel list.

GetNumDungeonForRandomSlot.s: Returns the number of dungeons a random dungeon queue can pick from. Read each with `GetDungeonForRandomSlot`.

GetNumFlyouts.s: Returns the number of spell flyouts.

GetNumGroupChannels.s: Returns the number of group chat channels in the chat channel list.

GetNumGuildBankMoneyTransactions.s: Returns the number of entries in the guild bank's money log.

GetNumGuildBankTabs.s: Returns the number of guild bank tabs the guild has bought.

GetNumGuildBankTransactions.s: Returns the number of entries in the item log of the given guild bank tab.

GetNumGuildChallenges.s: Returns the number of guild challenges.

GetNumGuildEvents.s: Returns the number of entries in the guild event log. Read each with `GetGuildEventInfo`.

GetNumGuildNews.s: Returns the number of guild news entries.

GetNumGuildPerks.s: Returns the number of guild perks.

GetNumGuildRewards.s: Returns the number of guild rewards. Read each with `GetGuildRewardInfo`.

GetNumGuildTradeSkill.s: Returns the number of entries in the guild's profession list.

GetNumMembersInRank.s: Returns the number of guild members in the given rank.

GetNumModifiedClickActions.s: Returns the number of modified-click actions.

GetNumQuestCurrencies.s: Returns the number of currencies the quest at the quest giver requires.

GetNumQuestItemDrops.s: Returns the number of item drop hints the quest at the given quest log index has. Blizzard's map shows them in the quest's tooltip.

GetNumQuestLogRewardFactions.s: Returns the number of reputation rewards of the quest in the quest log.

GetNumRaidProfiles.s: Returns the number of raid frame profiles. Read their names with `GetRaidProfileName`.

GetNumRandomScenarios.s: Returns the number of random scenario queues. Read each with `GetRandomScenarioInfo`.

GetNumRoutes.s: Returns the number of hops of the flight route to the taxi node at the given index.

GetNumTotemSlots.s: Returns the number of totem slots.

GetNumUnspentPvpTalents.s: Returns the number of PvP talents the player can still choose.

GetNumWarGameTypes.s: Returns the number of war game types. Read each with `GetWarGameTypeInfo`.

GetObjectiveText.s: Returns the objective text of the quest the quest giver is showing.

GetOffhandHitModifier.s: Returns the player's hit chance modifier for off-hand attacks.

GetOverrideAPBySpellPower.s: Returns how much of the player's spell power replaces attack power.

GetOverrideSpellPowerByAP.s: Returns how much of the player's attack power replaces spell power.

GetPVPGearStatRules.s: Whether PvP gear stat rules apply.

GetParryChanceFromAttribute.s: Returns the parry chance the player gets from attributes.

GetPartyLFGBackfillInfo.s: Returns the name, ID and type of the group finder dungeon the player's group can queue to refill.

GetPartyLFGID.s: Returns the group finder dungeon or queue ID of the player's current group finder group.

GetPendingGlyphName.s: Returns the name of the glyph waiting to be applied to a spell.

GetPendingInviteConfirmations.s: Returns the group invites that wait for the player's confirmation.

GetPetActionsUsable.s: Returns whether the pet's actions can be used.

GetPetCritChance.s: Returns the pet's melee and spell critical strike chances.

GetPetHitChanceModifier.s: Returns the pet's hit chance modifier.

GetPetIcon.s: Returns the icon of the player's pet.

GetPetSpellBonusDamage.s: Returns the pet's bonus spell damage.

GetPetSpellHitChanceModifier.s: Returns the pet's spell hit chance modifier.

GetPetTimeRemaining.s: Returns the time left on the player's pet, in milliseconds.

GetPetitionNameInfo.s: Returns the name of the player who signed the open petition at the given index.

GetPlayerTradeCurrency.s: Returns the currency the player offers in the current trade.

GetPowerRegenForPowerType.s: Returns the player's regeneration rates for a power type.

GetPrevCompleatedTutorial.s: Returns the ID of the previous tutorial the player has seen before the given one, for paging through seen tutorials.

GetPreviousArenaSeason.s: Returns the number of the previous arena season.

GetProtocolTypes.s: Returns the network protocol of each of the client's connections.

GetPvpTalentLink.s: Returns the chat link of the PvP talent with the given ID.

GetQuestCurrencyID.s: Returns the currency ID of a quest giver's currency reward or requirement, by reward type and index.

GetQuestExpansion.s: Returns the expansion the quest with the given ID belongs to.

GetQuestFactionGroup.s: Returns the faction a quest belongs to.

GetQuestItemInfoLootType.s: Returns the loot type (item or currency) of a quest giver's reward or requirement, by reward type and index.

GetQuestLogChoiceInfoLootType.s: Returns the loot type (item or currency) of the reward choice at the given index of the quest selected in the quest log.

GetQuestLogCompletionText.s: Returns the text shown for the completed quest at the given quest log index. Blizzard's UI falls back to `QUEST_WATCH_QUEST_READY` when it has none.

GetQuestLogCriteriaSpell.s: Returns the spell ID, name and icon of the spell objective of the quest selected in the quest log, and whether it is finished.

GetQuestLogItemDrop.s: Returns the text, objective type and finished state of an item drop hint, by hint index and quest log index. Loop up to `GetNumQuestItemDrops`.

GetQuestLogPortraitTurnIn.s: Returns the portrait shown for turning in the quest selected in the quest log.

GetQuestLogQuestType.s: Returns the type of the quest at the given quest log index, such as `QUEST_TYPE_SCENARIO`.

GetQuestLogRewardArtifactXP.s: Returns the artifact experience a quest rewards and the artifact category it goes to. Blizzard's UI passes a quest ID, or no argument for the quest selected in the quest log.

GetQuestLogRewardFactionInfo.s: Returns the faction and amount of the reputation reward at the given index of the quest in the quest log.

GetQuestLogRewardHonor.s: Returns the honor a quest rewards. Blizzard's UI passes a quest ID, or no argument for the quest selected in the quest log.

GetQuestLogRewardSkillPoints.s: Returns the name and icon of the skill the quest selected in the quest log rewards points in, and the number of points.

GetQuestLogRewardTitle.s: Returns the title the quest selected in the quest log rewards.

GetQuestMoneyToGet.s: Returns the money in copper the quest at the quest giver requires to complete it. Blizzard's UI asks for confirmation before completing such a quest.

GetQuestPOIBlobCount.s: Returns the number of map areas (blobs) the quest with the given ID shows on the map.

GetQuestPOILeaderBoard.s: Returns the text, objective type and finished state of an objective shown on a quest's map area, by POI index and quest log index.

GetQuestPOIs.s: Fills the given table with quest points of interest for the map.

GetQuestPortraitGiver.s: Returns the portrait display ID, text, name, mount display ID and model scene ID shown for the giver of the quest the quest frame shows. The display ID is 0 when there is none.

GetQuestPortraitTurnIn.s: Returns the portrait display ID, text and name shown for turning in the quest the quest frame shows. The display ID is 0 when there is none.

GetQuestText.s: Returns the description text of the quest the quest giver is showing.

GetQuestUiMapID.s: Returns the map ID the world map should open to for the quest with the given ID, or 0. Pass `true` as the second argument to ignore waypoints.

GetRaidProfileFlattenedOptions.s: Returns a table of all settings of the raid frame profile with the given name, keyed by setting name.

GetRaidProfileName.s: Returns the name of the raid frame profile at the given index.

GetRaidProfileOption.s: Returns the value of a setting of the raid frame profile with the given name, such as `autoActivatePvP`.

GetRaidProfileSavedPosition.s: Returns the saved position of the raid frames of the given profile: whether they are placed automatically, then the top, bottom and left anchor points with their offsets.

GetRandomDungeonBestChoice.s: Returns the ID of the random dungeon queue that suits the player best. Blizzard's Dungeon Finder selects it by default.

GetRandomScenarioBestChoice.s: Returns the ID of the random scenario queue that suits the player best. Blizzard's Scenario Finder selects it by default.

GetRandomScenarioInfo.s: Returns the dungeon ID, name, type, subtype and level range of the random scenario queue at the given index.

GetRangedAttackPowerForStat.s: Returns the ranged attack power an amount of a stat gives.

GetRangedHitModifier.s: Returns the player's ranged hit modifier.

GetRatedBattleGroundInfo.s: Returns the name and group size of the current rated battleground.

GetReadyCheckStatus.s: Returns the unit's answer to the current ready check: `ready`, `notready` or `waiting`, or `nil` when there is none.

GetReadyCheckTimeLeft.s: Returns the time left to answer the current ready check.

GetRealmID.s: Returns the ID of the player's realm.

GetRepairAllCost.s: Returns the cost of repairing all items and whether anything needs repair.

GetResSicknessDuration.s: Returns how long resurrection sickness lasts at the player's level, as text.

GetRewardArtifactXP.s: Returns the artifact experience the quest at the quest giver rewards and the artifact category it goes to.

GetRewardHonor.s: Returns the honor the quest at the quest giver rewards.

GetRewardMoney.s: Returns the money in copper the quest at the quest giver rewards.

GetRewardNumSkillUps.s: Returns the number of skill points the quest at the quest giver rewards.

GetRewardPackArtifactPower.s: Returns the artifact power of the reward pack with the given ID.

GetRewardPackCurrencies.s: Returns the currencies of the reward pack with the given ID.

GetRewardPackItems.s: Returns the items of the reward pack with the given ID.

GetRewardPackMoney.s: Returns the money, in copper, that a reward pack grants.

GetRewardPackTitle.s: Returns the ID of the title that a reward pack grants; Blizzard's honor reward code treats a value above 0 as a title reward and passes it to `GetRewardPackTitleName`.

GetRewardPackTitleName.s: Returns the display name of a reward title, given the title ID from `GetRewardPackTitle`.

GetRewardSkillLineID.s: Returns the ID of the skill line that the quest being completed rewards points in.

GetRewardSkillPoints.s: Returns the skill reward of the quest being completed at an NPC: the skill's name, its icon and the number of skill points.

GetRewardTitle.s: Returns the title the player earns from the quest being completed at an NPC, or nil if it rewards none.

GetRunningMacro.s: Returns the index of the macro that is currently running, if any.

GetRunningMacroButton.s: Returns the mouse button that started the macro that is currently running.

GetScriptBucketThrottleLimits.s: Returns the throttle limits of script buckets.

GetScriptCPUUsage.s: Returns the total CPU time used by addon scripts.

GetSecondsUntilParentalControlsKick.s: Returns the seconds until parental controls log the player out.

GetSelectedDisplayChannel.s: Returns the chat channel selected in the channel list.

GetSelectedGlyphSpellIndex.s: Returns the spell index of the selected glyph.

GetSelectedWarGameType.s: Returns the index of the war game type selected in the war games list; Blizzard passes it to `GetWarGameTypeInfo`.

GetSendMailMoney.s: Returns the money, in copper, attached to the mail being composed.

GetSourceLocation.s: Returns where the calling code is, as its chunk name and line.

p.gender: The gender to word the name for.

GetSpecializationInfoForSpecID.s: Returns information about a specialization by its ID.

p.gender: The gender to word the name for.

GetSpecializationNameForSpecID.s: Returns the name of a specialization by its ID.

GetSpecializationRoleEnum.s: Returns the group role (tank, healer or damage) of one of the player's specializations, given its index. Blizzard calls it with the index from `C_SpecializationInfo.GetSpecialization`.

GetSpecializationRoleEnumByID.s: Returns the group role (tank, healer or damage) of a specialization, given its spec ID.

GetSpecializationSystem.s: Returns the specialization system the game uses.

GetSpecsForSpell.s: Returns the names of the specializations a spell book spell belongs to, one value per specialization. Classic UI code calls it with a spell book slot and book type.

GetSpellConfirmationPromptsInfo.s: Returns a list of the spell confirmation prompts that are pending, such as bonus rolls. Blizzard shows a dialog for each, using its `spellID`, `confirmType`, `text` and `duration`.

GetSpellCritChanceFromStat.s: Returns the spell critical strike chance an amount of a stat gives.

GetSpellQueueWindow.s: Returns the spell queue window in milliseconds.

GetSpellsForCharacterUpgradeTier.s: Returns the spells that a tier of a character upgrade grants.

p.modifiers: A mask of modifier keys, as `MakeModifiers` returns.

GetStringFromModifiers.s: Returns the modifier keys in a modifier mask as text, as key bindings write them.

GetSuggestedGroupSize.s: Returns the suggested group size for the quest offered at an NPC, or 0 if it suggests none. For quests in the log, Blizzard uses `C_QuestLog.GetSuggestedGroupSize` instead.

GetTabardCreationCost.s: Returns the cost, in copper, of creating a guild tabard at the tabard vendor.

GetTalentInfoByID.s: Returns information about a talent, given its talent ID, including its name, icon, tier, column, whether it is selected and whether it is available. Optional arguments read a given talent group or an inspected unit.

GetTalentInfoBySpecialization.s: Returns information about the talent at a tier and column for a specialization.

GetTalentLink.s: Returns a chat link for a talent.

GetTargetTradeCurrency.s: Returns the currency the other player in a trade has offered.

GetTaskPOIs.s: Returns the map points of interest of the bonus objective tasks in the current zone.

GetTasksTable.s: Returns a list of the quest IDs of the task quests (bonus objectives and world quests) the player is on. The objective tracker builds its bonus objective and world quest sections from it.

GetTaxiBenchmarkMode.s: Whether taxi benchmark mode is on.

GetTextureMetatable.s: Returns the metatable shared by all `Texture` objects; its `__index` holds the texture methods.

GetTotemCannotDismiss.s: Whether the totem in a slot cannot be dismissed.

GetTotemDuration.s: Returns the duration of the totem in a slot.

p.slotIndex: The filter's index.

GetTradeSkillInvSlotFilter.s: Returns the state of the profession window's filter for an inventory slot.

GetTradeSkillSubClassFilter.s: Returns the state of the profession window's filter for an item subclass.

GetTrainerServiceNumAbilityReq.s: Returns how many ability requirements a trainer service has, given its index.

GetTrainerServiceStepIndex.s: Returns the index of the trainer service that is the next skill step of the trainer's profession, or nil. Blizzard shows it in its own button instead of in the service list.

GetTrainerTradeskillRankValues.s: Returns the player's rank in the trainer's profession: the current rank, the maximum rank and the bonus from modifiers. Blizzard shows them in the trainer's status bar.

GetTreasurePickerItemInfo.s: Returns information about an item offered by a quest reward's treasure picker.

GetTutorialsEnabled.s: Returns whether tutorials are turned on. Blizzard loads the new player experience only when it returns true.

GetUICameraInfo.s: Returns the settings of a UI camera.

GetUnitEmpowerHoldAtMaxTime.s: Returns how long the unit can hold an empowered spell at its last stage.

GetUnitEmpowerMinHoldTime.s: Returns the shortest time the unit must hold an empowered spell.

GetUnitEmpowerStageDuration.s: Returns the duration of a stage of the unit's empowered spell.

GetUnitMaxHealthModifier.s: Returns the unit's maximum health modifier.

GetUnitPowerBarInfo.s: Returns information about the unit's alternate power bar.

GetUnitPowerBarInfoByID.s: Returns information about an alternate power bar.

GetUnitPowerBarStrings.s: Returns the name, tooltip and cost text of the unit's alternate power bar.

GetUnitPowerBarStringsByID.s: Returns the name, tooltip and cost text of an alternate power bar.

p.timerIndex: The bar's timer, for timer textures.

GetUnitPowerBarTextureInfo.s: Returns a texture of the unit's alternate power bar and its color.

GetUnitPowerBarTextureInfoByID.s: Returns a texture of an alternate power bar and its color.

GetUnitTotalModifiedMaxHealthPercent.s: Returns the total percentage by which the unit's maximum health is modified.

GetUpgradeExpansionLevel.s: Returns the expansion level the account can upgrade to.

GetValuesArray.s: Returns a new array of the values of a table, in no set order.

GetVehicleUIIndicator.s: Returns the background texture and number of seats of a vehicle indicator.

p.indicatorSeatIndex: The seat's index on the indicator.

GetVehicleUIIndicatorSeat.s: Returns a seat of a vehicle indicator and its position.

GetVersatilityBonus.s: Returns the versatility bonus of a combat rating.

GetVideoCaps.s: Returns what the graphics hardware supports.

GetWarGameQueueStatus.s: Returns the status of the player's war game queue.

GetWarGameTypeInfo.s: Returns information about a war game type, given its index: its localized name, PvP type, whether its header is collapsed, battleground ID, minimum and maximum players, whether it is random, icon, and short and long descriptions.

GetWorldElapsedTime.s: Returns information about a world timer, such as a dungeon's elapsed time.

GetWorldElapsedTimers.s: Returns the IDs of the world state timers that are running. Blizzard reads them on `CHALLENGE_MODE_START` and `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` to show scenario and challenge mode timers.

GetWorldMapActionButtonSpellInfo.s: Returns the spell ID and spell visual kit ID of the spell that the world map action button casts on quests.

GroupHasOfflineMember.s: Returns whether the player's group, in the given party category, has a member who is offline. The group finder blocks signing up while it does.

GuildControlAddRank.s: Adds a new rank to the player's guild with the given name.

GuildControlGetAllowedShifts.s: Returns whether a guild rank can be moved up and whether it can be moved down, given its rank order.

GuildControlGetNumRanks.s: Returns the number of ranks in the player's guild.

GuildControlGetRank.s: Returns the guild rank selected for editing in the guild control panel.

GuildControlShiftRankDown.s: Moves a guild rank one place down the rank order.

GuildControlShiftRankUp.s: Moves a guild rank one place up the rank order.

GuildMasterAbsent.s: Returns whether the player's guild master has been absent.

GuildNewsSetSticky.s: Pins a guild news entry to the top of the list, or unpins it. Blizzard passes 1 to pin and 0 to unpin.

GuildNewsSort.s: Sorts the guild news, taking filters and pinned entries into account. `GUILD_NEWS_UPDATE` fires afterwards.

HandleAtlasMemberCommand.s: Handles an atlas for the debug tools; Blizzard's texture info tool calls it with an atlas name when one is picked.

HasAPEffectsSpellPower.s: Whether the player's attack power affects their spell power.

HasArtifactEquipped.s: Returns whether the player has an artifact weapon equipped.

HasAttachedGlyph.s: Returns whether a spell has a glyph attached.

HasCompletedAnyAchievement.s: Returns whether the player has completed any achievement. Blizzard opens the achievement UI only when this is true or the player is in a guild.

HasDualWieldPenalty.s: Whether the player has the dual wield hit penalty.

HasIgnoreDualWieldWeapon.s: Whether the player has an effect that ignores the dual wield weapon.

HasInboxItem.s: Returns whether a mail in the inbox has an item in an attachment slot. Blizzard calls it with the mail's index and the attachment index.

HasLoadedCUFProfiles.s: Returns whether the raid frame profiles have loaded.

HasLootSpecializations.s: Whether the player can choose a loot specialization.

HasNewMail.s: Returns whether the player has unread mail. Blizzard shows the minimap mail icon from it.

HasNoReleaseAura.s: Returns whether an aura keeps the player from releasing their spirit, and how long it lasts.

HasPendingGlyphCast.s: Returns whether a glyph is waiting to be applied to a spell.

HasSPEffectsAttackPower.s: Whether the player's spell power affects their attack power.

HasSendMailItem.s: Returns whether an attachment slot of the mail being composed holds an item.

HaveQuestData.s: Returns whether the client has the data for a quest. Blizzard checks it before showing a quest and waits for the data otherwise.

HaveQuestRewardData.s: Returns whether the client has the reward data for a quest. Calling it also requests the data when it is missing, which Blizzard does to prime rewards.

HearthAndResurrectFromArea.s: Leaves the current world PvP zone. Blizzard offers it in the queue status menu, only when `CanHearthAndResurrectFromArea` returns true.

HousingCatalogSearcher:GetEditorModeCont.s: Returns the housing editor mode the search is for.

p.groupID: The filter group the tag belongs to.

HousingCatalogSearcher:GetFilterTagStatu.s: Whether a filter tag of the search is turned on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:GetFilteredCatego.s: Returns the category the search is limited to.

HousingCatalogSearcher:GetFilteredSubcat.s: Returns the subcategory the search is limited to.

HousingCatalogSearcher:GetSortType.s: Returns how the search results are sorted.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsAllowedIndoorsA.s: Whether the filter for decor allowed indoors is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsAllowedOutdoors.s: Whether the filter for decor allowed outdoors is on.

r.isActive: Whether the base-variant-only option is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsBaseVariantOnly.s: Returns whether the searcher includes only the base variant of each decor entry.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsCollectedActive.s: Whether the filter for collected decor is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsCustomizableOnl.s: Whether the search shows only customizable decor.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsDistinctPerReco.s: Whether the search lists each decor record only once.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsFirstAcquisitio.s: Whether the search shows only decor that gives a first acquisition bonus.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsOwnedOnlyActive.s: Whether the search shows only owned decor.

r.isActive: Whether the stored-only option is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsStoredOnlyActiv.s: Returns whether the searcher includes only entries the player has available in storage, not ones they own that are all placed.

HousingCatalogSearcher:IsUncollectedActi.s: Whether the filter for uncollected decor is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:SetResultsUpdated.s: Sets the function called when the search results update.

HousingCatalogSearcher:SetSortType.s: Sets how the search results are sorted.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleAllowedIndo.s: Turns the filter for decor allowed indoors on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleAllowedOutd.s: Turns the filter for decor allowed outdoors on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleBaseVariant.s: Turns the searcher's base-variant-only option on if it is off, or off if it is on.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleCollected.s: Turns the filter for collected decor on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleCustomizabl.s: Turns showing only customizable decor on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleDistinctPer.s: Turns listing each decor record only once on or off.

p.groupID: The filter group the tag belongs to.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleFilterTag.s: Turns a filter tag of the search on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleFirstAcquis.s: Turns showing only decor that gives a first acquisition bonus on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleOwnedOnly.s: Turns showing only owned decor on or off.

HousingCatalogSearcher:ToggleStoredOnly.s: Turns the searcher's stored-only option on if it is off, or off if it is on. Replaces the older `ToggleOwnedOnly`.

IsShiftKeyDown.s: Whether a Shift key is held down.
