UnitInVehicleControlSeat.s: Whether the unit sits in the seat that controls its vehicle.

UnitInVehicleHidesPetFrame.s: Whether the unit's vehicle hides the pet frame.

UnitIsBossMob.s: Whether the unit is a boss.

UnitIsGameObject.s: Whether the unit is a game object, such as a chest or a door, instead of a creature or player.

p.partyIndex: The party category to check, such as home or instance.

UnitIsHumanPlayer.s: Whether the unit is a character controlled by a player.

UnitIsInInteractRange.s: Whether the unit is close enough to interact with.

UnitIsInteractable.s: Whether the player can interact with the unit.

UnitIsLieutenant.s: Whether the unit is a lieutenant.

UnitIsNPCAsPlayer.s: Whether the unit is an NPC that takes the place of a player.

UnitIsOtherPlayersPet.s: Whether the unit is a pet that belongs to another player.

p.controlledUnit: The unit that may be owned or controlled.
p.controllingUnit: The unit that may own or control.

UnitIsOwnerOrControllerOfUnit.s: Whether the first unit owns or controls the second.

UnitLeadsAnyGroup.s: Whether the unit leads any group it is in.

UnitNameFromGUID.s: Returns the name and realm of the unit with the given GUID, or nil if no such unit is known.

UnitNameUnmodified.s: Returns the unit's name and realm, without any changes the game makes to names it shows.

UnitNumPowerBarTimers.s: Returns the number of timers on the unit's alternate power bar.

UnitOwnerGUID.s: Returns the GUID of the unit's owner.

UnitPartialPower.s: Returns the fraction of the next whole point of the unit's power that has built up.

UnitPercentHealthFromGUID.s: Returns the health of the unit with the given GUID as a fraction of its maximum, from 0 to 1, or nil if unknown.

p.showFacing: Whether the marker shows the unit's facing.
p.sublayer: The draw sublayer of the marker.

UnitPositionFrame:AddUnit.s: Adds a unit's marker to the frame.

UnitPositionFrame:ClearUnits.s: Removes all unit markers from the frame.

UnitPositionFrame:FinalizeUnits.s: Finishes adding units, so the frame draws their markers.

UnitPositionFrame:GetMouseOverUnits.s: Returns the units whose markers are under the mouse.

UnitPositionFrame:GetPlayerPingScale.s: Returns the scale of the ping that marks the player.

UnitPositionFrame:GetUiMapID.s: Returns the ID of the map the frame shows units on.

UnitPositionFrame:SetPlayerPingScale.s: Sets the scale of the ping that marks the player.

p.textureType: Which of the ping's textures to set.

UnitPositionFrame:SetPlayerPingTexture.s: Sets a texture of the ping that marks the player.

UnitPositionFrame:SetUiMapID.s: Sets the map the frame shows units on.

UnitPositionFrame:SetUnitColor.s: Sets the color of a unit's marker.

p.duration: How long the ping lasts, in seconds.
p.fadeDuration: How long the ping takes to fade out, in seconds.

UnitPositionFrame:StartPlayerPing.s: Starts the ping that marks the player.

UnitPositionFrame:StopPlayerPing.s: Stops the ping that marks the player.

UnitPowerBarID.s: Returns the ID of the unit's alternate power bar.

UnitPowerBarTimerInfo.s: Returns information about a timer on the unit's alternate power bar.

UnitPowerDisplayMod.s: Returns the number a power type's raw value is divided by to give the value shown, such as 10 for rage.

UnitSetRoleEnum.s: Sets the unit's group role. Returns whether it succeeded.

UnitSexBase.s: Returns the unit's sex as an `Enum.UnitSex` value.

UnitShouldDisplayName.s: Whether the unit's name should be shown above it.

UnitSwitchToVehicleSeat.s: Moves the unit to another seat of its vehicle.

UnitTargetsVehicleInRaidUI.s: Whether clicking the unit in raid frames targets its vehicle instead of the unit.

UnitThreatPercentageOfLead.s: Returns the unit's threat on the enemy as a percentage of the threat of the unit with the most.

UnitTrialBankedLevels.s: Returns the levels a trial account's character has banked beyond the trial's level cap.

UnitTrialXP.s: Returns the experience a trial account's character has banked beyond the trial's level cap.

UnitUsesAmmo.s: Whether the unit's ranged weapon uses ammunition.

UnitVehicleSeatCount.s: Returns the number of seats in the unit's vehicle.

UnitVehicleSeatInfo.s: Returns information about a seat of the unit's vehicle: its occupant's name and realm, its kind, and whether the occupant can eject and switch seats.

UnitVehicleSkin.s: Returns the ID of the action bar skin of the unit's vehicle.

UnitWeaponAttackPower.s: Returns the attack power of the unit's main hand, off hand and ranged weapons.

UnitWidgetSet.s: Returns the ID of the UI widget set shown for the unit, or nil if it has none.

UnlearnSpecialization.s: Unlearns a specialization, given its index. Classic UI code calls it after the player confirms.

UpdateInventoryAlertStatus.s: Updates the alert status of the player's inventory.

UpdateUIParentPosition.s: Moves `UIParent` down to make room for the debug bars or a screen notch. A FrameXML function.

UseQuestLogSpecialItem.s: Uses a quest's special item, given its quest log index.

UseWorldMapActionButtonSpellOnQuest.s: Casts the world map action button's spell on a quest, given its quest ID.

VectorGraphics:ClearSVG.s: Removes the SVG image from the region.

VectorGraphics:GetSVGFileID.s: Returns the file ID of the region's SVG image.

VectorGraphics:HasSVG.s: Whether the region has an SVG image.

VectorGraphics:SetSVG.s: Sets the SVG image the region shows. Returns whether it succeeded.

VehicleAimDecrement.s: Lowers the vehicle's aim by an amount. Blizzard's bindings pass 0.1.

VehicleAimGetNormPower.s: Returns the vehicle's aim power, normalized.

VehicleAimIncrement.s: Raises the vehicle's aim by an amount. Blizzard's bindings pass 0.1.

VehicleAimRequestAngle.s: Requests an aim angle for the vehicle.

VehicleAimSetNormPower.s: Sets the vehicle's aim power, normalized.

VehicleExit.s: Makes the player leave the vehicle.

VehicleNextSeat.s: Moves the player to the vehicle's next seat.

VehiclePrevSeat.s: Moves the player to the vehicle's previous seat.

VertexColor:GetEndColor.s: Returns the vertex color the animation ends at.

VertexColor:GetStartColor.s: Returns the vertex color the animation starts at.

VertexColor:SetEndColor.s: Sets the vertex color the animation ends at.

VertexColor:SetStartColor.s: Sets the vertex color the animation starts at.

ViewGuildRecipes.s: Opens the recipes that guild members know for a profession, given its skill line ID.

WarGameRespond.s: Accepts or declines a war game challenge.

WithdrawGuildBankMoney.s: Withdraws money, in copper, from the guild bank.

WorldLootObjectExists.s: Whether the unit is a loot object in the world.

abs.s: Returns the absolute value of a number; the same as `math.abs`.

assert.s: Raises an error if its first argument is false or nil; otherwise returns all its arguments. The optional message becomes the error.

bit.arshift.s: Shifts a 32-bit integer right by a number of bits, copying the sign bit into the bits shifted in (arithmetic shift).

bit.band.s: Returns the bitwise AND of its 32-bit integer arguments. Blizzard's UI uses it to test flags, such as `bit.band(flags, SOME_FLAG) ~= 0`.

bit.bnot.s: Returns the bitwise NOT of a 32-bit integer, flipping every bit. Blizzard's UI combines it with `bit.band` to clear flags.

bit.bor.s: Returns the bitwise OR of its 32-bit integer arguments, for example to combine flags.

bit.bxor.s: Returns the bitwise exclusive OR of its 32-bit integer arguments.

bit.lshift.s: Shifts a 32-bit integer left by a number of bits, filling with zeros; `bit.lshift(1, n)` makes the flag for bit `n`.

bit.mod.s: Returns the integer remainder of dividing one integer by another.

bit.rshift.s: Shifts a 32-bit integer right by a number of bits, filling with zeros (logical shift).

ceil.s: Returns the smallest whole number not less than a number; the same as `math.ceil`.

coroutine.running.s: Returns the running coroutine, or nil when called from the main thread.

coroutine.status.s: Returns the status of a coroutine: `"running"`, `"suspended"`, `"normal"` or `"dead"`.

coroutine.wrap.s: Creates a coroutine from a function and returns a function that resumes it each time it is called. Errors inside the coroutine are raised in the caller.

deg.s: Converts an angle from radians to degrees; the same as `math.deg`.

difftime.s: Returns the number of seconds from one time to another; the same as `os.difftime`.

error.s: Raises an error with a message. The optional level chooses which caller the error position points at.

event:ACCOUNT_CHARACTER_CURRENCY_DATA_RE.s: Fires when currency data for the account's other characters arrives. Blizzard's currency tab redraws when its filter needs that data.

event:ACCOUNT_CVARS_LOADED.s: Fires at the login screens when the account's CVars have loaded. Blizzard's character select list checks its help tips again.

event:ACCOUNT_MONEY.s: Fires when the money in the account (warband) bank changes. Blizzard's money frames for the account bank redraw.

event:ACCOUNT_STORE_CURRENCY_AVAILABLE_U.s: Fires when the amount of an account store currency the player has changes. Blizzard's account store and Plunderstorm panel update it.

event:ACCOUNT_STORE_FRONT_UPDATED.s: Fires when the items of an account store front arrive or change. Blizzard's account store redraws them.

p.itemID: The account store item that changed.

event:ACCOUNT_STORE_ITEM_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the information of an account store item changes. Blizzard's store cards redraw.

event:ACCOUNT_STORE_TRANSACTION_ERROR.s: Fires when an account store purchase fails. Blizzard shows a dialog saying the transaction did not complete.

p.alreadyEarned: Whether the achievement was already earned on the account.

event:ACHIEVEMENT_EARNED.s: Fires when the player earns an achievement. Blizzard shows an achievement alert and refreshes the achievement frame and tracker.

event:ACHIEVEMENT_SEARCH_UPDATED.s: Fires when an achievement search has new results. Blizzard reads them with `GetNumFilteredAchievements`.

event:ACTIONBAR_HIDEGRID.s: Fires when the player stops dragging something that can go on the action bars. Blizzard's action buttons hide their empty slots again.

event:ACTIONBAR_PAGE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the main action bar switches to another page. Blizzard's action bar updates its buttons and page number.

event:ACTIONBAR_SHOWGRID.s: Fires when the player starts dragging something that can go on the action bars. Blizzard's action buttons show their empty slots.

event:ACTIONBAR_SHOW_BOTTOMLEFT.s: Fires when the game asks for the bottom left action bar to be shown. Blizzard's UI turns on its setting for that bar.

event:ACTIONBAR_SLOT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the contents of an action slot change.

event:ACTIONBAR_UPDATE_COOLDOWN.s: Fires when the cooldown of actions on the action bars may have changed. Blizzard's action buttons update their cooldowns.

event:ACTIONBAR_UPDATE_STATE.s: Fires when the state of actions on the action bars may have changed, such as whether they are active. Blizzard's action buttons update their checked state.

event:ACTIONBAR_UPDATE_USABLE.s: Fires when the usability of actions on the action bars may have changed. Blizzard's action buttons now use `ACTION_USABLE_CHANGED` instead.

p.changes: The actions whose usability changed, each with its slot.

event:ACTION_USABLE_CHANGED.s: Fires when actions become usable or unusable. Blizzard's action buttons update the slots listed in the changes.

event:ACTION_WILL_BIND_ITEM.s: Fires when an action would bind an item to the player and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ActionBindsItem`.

p.spellID: The spell the glyph is applied to.

event:ACTIVATE_GLYPH.s: Fires when the player picks the spell to apply a glyph or glyph remover to. Blizzard's spellbook plays the glyph activated visuals on that spell.

p.configID: The ID of the now active configuration.

event:ACTIVE_COMBAT_CONFIG_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's active talent configuration changes.

event:ACTIVE_GAME_MODE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the active game mode changes. Blizzard's game rules code tells the systems that depend on it.

event:ACTIVE_PLAYER_SPECIALIZATION_CHANG.s: Fires when the player's active specialization changes. Blizzard's talent frame redraws its spec background and loadout options.

event:ACTIVE_TALENT_GROUP_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player switches to another talent group or specialization. Blizzard's character frame updates the portrait and stats.

event:ADAPTER_LIST_CHANGED.s: Fires when the list of graphics adapters available to the game changes.

p.closingClient: Whether the game client is closing.

event:ADDONS_UNLOADING.s: Fires before addons are unloaded, as the player logs out, reloads the UI or quits. Blizzard's frames save their state into saved variables on it.

p.function: The name of the function that was blocked.
p.isTainted: The name of the addon that was blocked.

event:ADDON_ACTION_BLOCKED.s: Fires when an addon tried an action that is protected right now, usually during combat. Blizzard's UI prints a notice that an action was blocked.

p.function: The name of the function that was blocked.
p.isTainted: The name of the addon that was blocked.

event:ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN.s: Fires when an addon tried an action only the Blizzard UI may perform. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog offering to disable the addon.

p.addOnName: The name of the addon that loaded.
p.containsBindings: Whether the addon has its own key bindings.

event:ADDON_LOADED.s: Fires after an addon's files and saved variables have loaded, once for each addon, Blizzard's included. Check `addOnName` to react to your own addon.

p.signature: The name of the player who signed.

event:ADD_NEIGHBORHOOD_CHARTER_SIGNATURE.s: Fires when a player signs the open neighborhood charter. Blizzard's charter frame adds the signature.

event:ADVENTURE_MAP_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with an adventure map table, such as a mission table. Blizzard's mission frames close.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type the map is for.

event:ADVENTURE_MAP_OPEN.s: Fires when the player opens an adventure map table. Blizzard's UI shows the adventure map for the follower type.

event:ADVENTURE_MAP_QUEST_UPDATE.s: Fires when a quest on the adventure map changes. Blizzard's adventure map refreshes its pins.

event:ADVENTURE_MAP_UPDATE_INSETS.s: Fires when the insets of the adventure map change. Blizzard's adventure map redraws them.

event:ADVENTURE_MAP_UPDATE_POIS.s: Fires when the points of interest on the adventure map change. Blizzard's adventure map refreshes its pins.

event:AJ_DUNGEON_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a dungeon suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the dungeon finder on that dungeon.

event:AJ_OPEN.s: Fires when the Adventure Guide is asked to open.

event:AJ_OPEN_COLLECTIONS_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a collections suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the collections journal.

event:AJ_PVE_LFG_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a premade group suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvE Group Finder.

event:AJ_PVP_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a battleground suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP frame with that battleground selected.

event:AJ_PVP_LFG_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a PvP premade group suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP Group Finder.

event:AJ_PVP_RBG_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a random battleground suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP frame with random battlegrounds selected.

event:AJ_PVP_SKIRMISH_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks an arena skirmish suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP frame with skirmishes selected.

event:AJ_PVP_SPECIAL_BG_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a special battleground or brawl suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP frame on it.

event:AJ_PVP_TRAINING_GROUNDS_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a training grounds suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the PvP frame on the training grounds.

p.uiMapID: The map the quest is on.

event:AJ_QUEST_LOG_OPEN.s: Fires when the player picks a quest suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the quest log on the quest, or the map where it is.

event:AJ_RAID_ACTION.s: Fires when the player picks a raid suggestion in the Adventure Guide. Blizzard opens the raid finder on that raid.

p.newAdventureNotice: Whether there is a new suggestion to point the player to.

event:AJ_REFRESH_DISPLAY.s: Fires when the Adventure Guide's suggestions change. Blizzard redraws the suggestions tab.

event:AJ_REWARD_DATA_RECEIVED.s: Fires when reward data for the Adventure Guide's suggestions arrives. Blizzard redraws the suggestion rewards.

event:ALERT_AGE_VERIFICATION_RESTRICTED.s: Fires when an action is blocked because the account's age is not verified. Blizzard shows a dialog, worded for minors when `C_SocialRestrictions.IsAgeVerificationRestrictedMinor` is true.

event:ALERT_REGIONAL_CHAT_DISABLED.s: Fires when chat is disabled for the player's region. Blizzard shows a dialog saying so.

event:ALLIED_RACE_CLOSE.s: Fires when the allied race recruitment window should close.

event:ALLIED_RACE_OPEN.s: Fires when the allied race window should open for a race. Blizzard's UI tries to show the allied races frame for it.

event:ALTERNATIVE_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CHANG.s: Fires when the player's alternative default language changes. Blizzard's chat frames read it again with `GetAlternativeDefaultLanguage` and use it for say and yell.

event:ANIMA_DIVERSION_CLOSE.s: Fires when the interaction with the anima conductor ends. Blizzard's anima diversion frame closes.

p.info: Information for the anima diversion frame.

event:ANIMA_DIVERSION_OPEN.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with the anima conductor. Blizzard's UI opens the anima diversion frame.

event:ANIMA_DIVERSION_TALENT_UPDATED.s: Fires when an anima diversion node changes. Blizzard's anima diversion frame updates its progress bar.

event:ARCHAEOLOGY_CLOSED.s: Fires when the archaeology interface closes. Blizzard's action buttons and professions book update their state.

p.numFindsCompleted: The finds completed at the dig site.
p.researchBranchID: The archaeology race of the find.
p.totalFinds: The finds the dig site holds.

event:ARCHAEOLOGY_FIND_COMPLETE.s: Fires when the player completes a find at an archaeology dig site. Blizzard's dig site progress bar advances.

p.numFindsCompleted: The finds completed at the dig site.
p.researchBranchID: The archaeology race of the dig site.
p.totalFinds: The finds the dig site holds.

event:ARCHAEOLOGY_SURVEY_CAST.s: Fires when the player casts Survey at an archaeology dig site. Blizzard shows the dig site progress bar.

event:ARCHAEOLOGY_TOGGLE.s: Fires when the archaeology interface should open or close. Blizzard toggles the archaeology frame.

event:AREA_POIS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the map's area points of interest change. Blizzard's map refreshes its area POI pins.

event:AREA_SPIRIT_HEALER_IN_RANGE.s: Fires when the dead player comes in range of an area spirit healer, as in battlegrounds. Blizzard's UI accepts the area resurrection with `AcceptAreaSpiritHeal` and shows its dialog.

event:AREA_SPIRIT_HEALER_OUT_OF_RANGE.s: Fires when the dead player leaves the range of an area spirit healer. Blizzard's UI hides the area resurrection dialog.

event:ARENA_COOLDOWNS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the cooldown of an arena opponent's crowd-control removal changes. Blizzard's arena frames refresh the cooldown they show.

p.spellID: The spell the unit uses to break crowd control.

event:ARENA_CROWD_CONTROL_SPELL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the spell an arena opponent uses to break crowd control becomes known or changes.

p.unitToken: The arena unit that changed, such as `arena1`.

event:ARENA_OPPONENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's view of an arena opponent changes: the opponent is seen, goes out of sight, is destroyed or is cleared. Blizzard's arena frames lock, unlock or hide the opponent's frame depending on the reason.

event:ARENA_PREP_OPPONENT_SPECIALIZATION.s: Fires when the specializations of the arena opponents become available during arena preparation. Blizzard's arena preparation frames update and show.

event:ARENA_SEASON_WORLD_STATE.s: Fires when the arena season information changes. Blizzard's PvP frame updates its title while shown.

event:ARTIFACT_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops viewing an artifact. Blizzard's artifact frame hides.

p.researchBranchID: The archaeology race of the dig site.

event:ARTIFACT_DIGSITE_COMPLETE.s: Fires when the player has completed every find at an archaeology dig site. Blizzard's dig site progress bar finishes.

p.bagOrSlotIndex: Where the artifact is: a bag or an equipment slot.
p.refundedTier: The artifact tier the traits were refunded from.
p.slotIndex: The slot in the bag, if the artifact is in a bag.

event:ARTIFACT_ENDGAME_REFUND.s: Fires when artifact traits are refunded. Blizzard's artifact frame shows the refund.

event:ARTIFACT_RELIC_FORGE_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops using the relic forge.

event:ARTIFACT_RELIC_FORGE_PREVIEW_RELIC.s: Fires when the relic previewed at the relic forge changes.

event:ARTIFACT_RELIC_FORGE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the relic forge opens or its contents change. Blizzard's UI shows the relic forge frame.

event:ARTIFACT_RELIC_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when information about an artifact's relics arrives. Blizzard's artifact frame redraws its traits.

event:ARTIFACT_RESPEC_PROMPT.s: Fires when the player asks to reset an artifact's traits. Blizzard's UI shows the artifact frame and a popup with the cost from `C_ArtifactUI.GetRespecCost`, or one saying there isn't enough power.

p.bagOrSlotIndex: Where the artifact is: a bag or an equipment slot.
p.slotIndex: The slot in the bag, if the artifact is in a bag.

event:ARTIFACT_TIER_CHANGED.s: Fires when an artifact moves to a new tier.

p.newItem: Whether a different artifact is now being viewed.

event:ARTIFACT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the viewed artifact's data changes, or when an artifact is opened for viewing. Blizzard's UI shows the artifact frame and redraws it.

event:ARTIFACT_XP_UPDATE.s: Fires when artifact power changes. Blizzard's artifact bar and artifact frame redraw.

event:ASSISTED_COMBAT_ACTION_SPELL_CAST.s: Fires when the player casts a spell from the assisted combat action button. Blizzard dismisses its help tip about the button.

event:AUCTION_CANCELED.s: Fires when an auction is cancelled. Blizzard's auctions tab refreshes its search results.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_BROWSE_FAILURE.s: Fires when an auction house browse search fails. Blizzard's results list shows "Internal auction error." (`ERR_AUCTION_DATABASE_ERROR`).

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_BROWSE_RESULTS_ADDED.s: Fires when more results arrive for the current browse search, for example after `C_AuctionHouse.RequestMoreBrowseResults`. Blizzard's browse list appends them.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_BROWSE_RESULTS_UPDAT.s: Fires when the results of the current browse search change. Blizzard's browse list redraws from `C_AuctionHouse.GetBrowseResults`.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops using the auction house. Blizzard's UI hides the auction house frame.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_DISABLED.s: Fires when the player tries to use the auction house while it is closed. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying the auction house is closed at the moment (`ERR_AUCTION_HOUSE_DISABLED`).

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_FAVORITES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's auction house favorites change. Blizzard's favorite buttons and favorites search button refresh.

p.cancelledItemDeliveryDelay: The delivery delay for items from cancelled auctions.
p.purchasedItemDeliveryDelay: The delivery delay for items the player buys.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_ITEM_DELIVERY_DELAY_.s: Fires when the delay before bought or cancelled auction items are delivered changes.

p.auctionID: The auction that received the bid.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_NEW_BID_RECEIVED.s: Fires when a new bid is placed on an auction. Blizzard's auctions tab refreshes its search results.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_POST_ERROR.s: Fires when the player tries to post an auction but posting is blocked. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying items can't be posted right now (`AUCTION_POSTING_ERROR_TEXT`).

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_POST_WARNING.s: Fires when posting an auction needs the player's confirmation first. Blizzard's UI shows a popup warning about upcoming auction house maintenance (`CONFIRM_AUCTION_POSTING_TEXT`) and posts only when it is accepted.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_PURCHASE_COMPLETED.s: Fires when buying out an auction completes. Blizzard's buyout popup closes when the ID matches its auction.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SCRIPT_DEPRECATED.s: Fires when an addon is disabled for using auction house scripts that are no longer supported. Blizzard's UI shows a popup asking the player to install an updated version (`AUCTION_HOUSE_DEPRECATED`).

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW.s: Fires when the player opens the auction house by talking to an auctioneer. Blizzard's UI shows the auction house frame, or closes the auction house again with an error for trial accounts.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW_COMMODITY_WON_N.s: Fires when the player wins a commodity auction. Blizzard's UI prints "You won an auction for …" to chat (`ERR_AUCTION_COMMODITY_WON_S`).

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW_ERROR.s: Fires when an auction house action fails. Blizzard's UI shows the error text in the error frame and closes an open buyout popup.

p.auctionID: The auction the notice is about, if any.
p.text: The text placed into the notice.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW_FORMATTED_NOTIF.s: Fires when the auction house has a notice that includes text, such as an item name. Blizzard's UI prints it to chat as a system message.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_SHOW_NOTIFICATION.s: Fires when the auction house has a notice for the player. Blizzard's UI prints it to chat as a system message.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_THROTTLED_MESSAGE_DR.s: Fires when a throttled auction house request is dropped instead of being sent.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_THROTTLED_MESSAGE_QU.s: Fires when an auction house request is queued because requests are being throttled.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_THROTTLED_MESSAGE_RE.s: Fires when the response to a throttled auction house request arrives.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_THROTTLED_MESSAGE_SE.s: Fires when a throttled auction house request is sent. Blizzard's sell frames update their post button.

event:AUCTION_HOUSE_THROTTLED_SYSTEM_REA.s: Fires when the auction house can accept requests again after throttling. Blizzard's sell frames update their post button.

event:AUCTION_MULTISELL_FAILURE.s: Fires when posting several auctions of an item at once stops because of a failure. Blizzard's item sell frame ends its multisell state.

p.numRepetitions: How many auctions will be posted.

event:AUCTION_MULTISELL_START.s: Fires when the player starts posting several auctions of an item at once. Blizzard's UI shows the multisell progress bar.

p.createdCount: How many auctions have been posted so far.
p.totalToCreate: How many auctions the multisell posts in all.

event:AUCTION_MULTISELL_UPDATE.s: Fires as each auction of a multisell is posted. Blizzard's progress bar advances and the multisell ends when `createdCount` reaches `totalToCreate`.

p.useRealDataProvider: Whether the real auras are used again; false while Edit Mode's sample auras are shown.

event:AURA_DATA_PROVIDER_SWITCH.s: Fires when the aura frames switch between the player's real auras and the sample auras Edit Mode shows. Blizzard's aura containers swap their data source.

p.name: Name of the unit being followed.

event:AUTOFOLLOW_BEGIN.s: Fires when the player starts following another unit. Blizzard shows a "following" message with the unit's name.

event:AUTOFOLLOW_END.s: Fires when the player stops following a unit. Blizzard fades out the follow status message.

event:AVAILABLE_GAME_MODES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of game modes the player can choose from changes. Blizzard's game mode picker refreshes.

p.clubType: The club type whose avatar list changed.

event:AVATAR_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of avatars available for a club type changes. Blizzard's avatar picker reloads it with `C_Club.GetAvatarIdList`.

event:AVOIDANCE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's avoidance changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

p.isHeartEquipped: Whether the Heart of Azeroth is now equipped.

event:AZERITE_EMPOWERED_ITEM_EQUIPPED_ST.s: Fires when the Heart of Azeroth is equipped or unequipped. Blizzard's Azerite power buttons update their state.

event:AZERITE_EMPOWERED_ITEM_LOOTED.s: Fires when the player loots an Azerite empowered item. Blizzard's UI shows a loot toast and may point the backpack button's tutorial at it.

event:AZERITE_EMPOWERED_ITEM_SELECTION_U.s: Fires when the chosen powers of an Azerite empowered item change. Blizzard's character frame redraws the item's slot.

p.slot: The slot the essence went into.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_ACTIVATED.s: Fires when an Azerite essence is placed in a slot of the Heart of Azeroth. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its slots.

p.essenceID: The essence that failed to activate.
p.slot: The slot the essence was meant for.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_ACTIVATION_FAILED.s: Fires when placing an Azerite essence in a slot fails. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its slots.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player learns an Azerite essence or a new rank of one. Blizzard's essence frame plays its learn animation.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_FORGE_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops using the Heart Forge. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its milestones.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_FORGE_OPEN.s: Fires when the player starts using the Heart Forge. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its milestones.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_MILESTONE_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when a milestone of the Heart of Azeroth is unlocked. Blizzard's essence frame plays the unlock on that milestone.

event:AZERITE_ESSENCE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's Azerite essences change. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its slots and list.

p.enabled: Whether the Heart of Azeroth is enabled now.

event:AZERITE_ITEM_ENABLED_STATE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's Heart of Azeroth is enabled or disabled. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes.

p.azeriteItemLocation: Where the Heart of Azeroth is.

event:AZERITE_ITEM_EXPERIENCE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the Heart of Azeroth gains Azerite power. Blizzard's Azerite bar redraws.

p.azeriteItemID: The item ID of the Heart of Azeroth.
p.azeriteItemLocation: Where the Heart of Azeroth is.
p.unlockedEmpoweredItemsInfo: Azerite armor whose traits the new level unlocks.

event:AZERITE_ITEM_POWER_LEVEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when the Heart of Azeroth gains a level. Blizzard's essence frame refreshes its level and milestones.

event:BAG_CLOSED.s: Fires when a bag is closed.

event:BAG_CONTAINER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's bags themselves change, such as when a bag is equipped or removed. Blizzard's bag and bank frames update.

event:BAG_NEW_ITEMS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the set of items marked as new in the player's bags changes. Blizzard's bag frames update.

event:BAG_OPEN.s: Fires when the game asks the UI to open a bag. Blizzard's bag frame opens the bag with the matching ID.

event:BAG_OVERFLOW_WITH_FULL_INVENTORY.s: Fires when items could not be delivered because the player's inventory is full. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog asking the player to make room.

event:BAG_SLOT_FLAGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the settings of a bag slot change, such as which items it is assigned to. Blizzard's bag frames update the bag's filter icon.

event:BAG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the items in a bag change: an item comes, goes, moves or changes its count. Several can fire for one action, one for each bag it changes; `BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED` follows once they have all fired. Blizzard's bag frames mark the bag and draw it again on the next frame (`ContainerFrame.lua`).

event:BAG_UPDATE_COOLDOWN.s: Fires when the cooldown of an item in the player's bags or equipment starts or ends. Blizzard's item buttons update their cooldown display.

event:BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED.s: Fires once after a batch of `BAG_UPDATE` events, when all bag changes from an action are done.

event:BANKFRAME_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with the bank.

event:BANKFRAME_OPENED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with the bank. Blizzard's bank frame opens.

event:BANK_BAG_SLOT_FLAGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the settings of a bank bag slot change.

event:BANK_TABS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's bank tabs change, such as when one is bought. Blizzard's bank frame rebuilds for that bank type.

event:BANK_TAB_SETTINGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the settings of a bank tab, such as its name or icon, change.

event:BARBER_SHOP_APPEARANCE_APPLIED.s: Fires when the changes made at the barber shop are applied. Blizzard's barber shop frame closes.

event:BARBER_SHOP_CAMERA_VALUES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the barber shop camera settings are ready. Blizzard's barber shop frame resets the character's rotation and camera.

event:BARBER_SHOP_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player leaves the barber shop. Blizzard's UI hides the barber shop frame.

event:BARBER_SHOP_COST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the cost of the changes at the barber shop changes. Blizzard's barber shop frame updates its buttons.

event:BARBER_SHOP_FORCE_CUSTOMIZATIONS_U.s: Fires when the barber shop's customization options must be rebuilt. Blizzard's barber shop frame redraws them.

event:BARBER_SHOP_OPEN.s: Fires when the player sits in a barber's chair. Blizzard's UI shows the barber shop frame.

event:BARBER_SHOP_RESULT.s: Fires after the player tries to apply changes at the barber shop.

event:BATTLEFIELDS_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player's interaction with a battlemaster ends. Blizzard's PvP frame hides itself if it is open.

p.isArena: Whether the battlemaster queues for arenas.

event:BATTLEFIELDS_SHOW.s: Fires when the player talks to a battlemaster, asking the UI to show the battleground or arena queue. Blizzard's PvP frame opens on the arena tab or on the given battleground.

event:BATTLEFIELD_AUTO_QUEUE.s: Fires when a world PvP battle in the player's zone is about to begin and the player can join its queue. The classic UI shows a popup to join the queue alone or as a group, using `JoinWorldPVPQueue`.

event:BATTLEFIELD_AUTO_QUEUE_EJECT.s: Fires when a world PvP battle in the player's zone is about to begin and the player must leave the area until it ends. The classic UI shows a popup saying so.

event:BATTLEFIELD_QUEUE_TIMEOUT.s: Fires when a battleground queue invitation times out. Blizzard's PvP popup hides a pending war game request.

event:BATTLEGROUND_OBJECTIVES_UPDATE.s: Fires when the state of the current battleground's objectives changes.

event:BATTLEGROUND_POINTS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the points of the current battleground change.

event:BATTLEPET_FORCE_NAME_DECLENSION.s: Fires when the declensions of a battle pet's name must be entered, on the Russian client. Blizzard shows the declension frame.

event:BATTLE_NET_FRIEND_TAG_ENABLED_STAT.s: Fires when the feature for tagging Battle.net friends is turned on or off. Blizzard's friends list refreshes.

event:BATTLE_NET_TITLE_FRIEND_CUSTOM_NAM.s: Fires when the feature for giving Battle.net friends custom names is turned on or off.

event:BATTLE_PET_CURSOR_CLEAR.s: Fires when a battle pet is no longer on the cursor. Blizzard's pet journal hides its loadout slot highlights.

event:BC_26_COLD_SWAP_FEATURE_ENABLED_CH.s: Fires on BlizzCon 2026 kiosk clients when the cold swap feature is turned on or off.

event:BC_26_EXPERIENCE_CHANGED.s: Fires on BlizzCon 2026 kiosk clients when the demo experience changes.

event:BEHAVIORAL_NOTIFICATION.s: Fires when the player has a notice about their behavior. Blizzard's UI shows it in its notification tray.

event:BIDS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of auctions the player has bid on changes. Blizzard's auction house redraws its bids list.

event:BID_ADDED.s: Fires when an auction is added to the player's bids. Blizzard's auction house redraws its bids list.

event:BINDINGS_LOADED.s: Fires when the key bindings have been loaded. Blizzard's turn and strafe setup waits for it together with `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` and `VARIABLES_LOADED`.

event:BIND_ENCHANT.s: Fires when enchanting an item would bind it to the player and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.BindEnchant`.

event:BLACK_MARKET_BID_RESULT.s: Fires when the server answers a bid on the black market. Blizzard requests the item list again with `C_BlackMarket.RequestItems` while its frame is open.

event:BLACK_MARKET_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops using the black market auction house. Blizzard hides the black market frame.

event:BLACK_MARKET_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when the black market item list changes. Blizzard's black market frame redraws its list.

event:BLACK_MARKET_OPEN.s: Fires when the player opens the black market auction house. Blizzard loads and shows the black market frame.

event:BLACK_MARKET_OUTBID.s: Fires when the player is outbid on the black market. Blizzard requests the item list again with `C_BlackMarket.RequestItems` while its frame is open.

event:BLACK_MARKET_UNAVAILABLE.s: Fires when the black market auction house is unavailable.

event:BLACK_MARKET_WON.s: Fires when the player wins an item on the black market.

p.dps: Whether the damage role was chosen.
p.healer: Whether the healer role was chosen.
p.questSessionActive: Whether the player is in an active quest session (Party Sync).
p.tank: Whether the tank role was chosen.

event:BNET_REQUEST_INVITE_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when the player asks to join a Battle.net friend's group and the request needs confirming. Blizzard's UI confirms with `ConfirmBNRequestInviteFriend`, after a warning dialog when a quest session is active.

p.blockType: Which block list is full: `"RID"` or `"CID"`.

event:BN_BLOCK_FAILED_TOO_MANY.s: Fires when the player cannot block another Battle.net user because their block list is full. Blizzard's UI shows an error dialog.

event:BN_BLOCK_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's Battle.net block list changes. Blizzard's ignore list updates.

p.channel: The channel the message came through.

event:BN_CHAT_MSG_ADDON.s: Fires when an addon message arrives over Battle.net, such as one sent with `C_BattleNet.SendGameData`.

event:BN_CHAT_WHISPER_UNDELIVERABLE.s: Fires when a Battle.net whisper the player sent could not be delivered.

p.suppressNotification: Whether to skip the notice in chat.

event:BN_CONNECTED.s: Fires when the client connects to Battle.net. Blizzard's chat frames print a notice unless it is suppressed.

p.id: The friend's Battle.net account ID, or nil when it is the player's own message.

event:BN_CUSTOM_MESSAGE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a Battle.net friend, or the player, changes their broadcast message.

event:BN_CUSTOM_MESSAGE_LOADED.s: Fires when the player's own Battle.net broadcast message has loaded. Blizzard's friends frame shows it.

p.suppressNotification: Whether to skip the notice in chat.

event:BN_DISCONNECTED.s: Fires when the client loses its connection to Battle.net. Blizzard's chat frames print a notice unless it is suppressed, and the friends list clears.

p.isCompanionApp: Whether it was the friend's companion app that went offline.

event:BN_FRIEND_ACCOUNT_OFFLINE.s: Fires when a Battle.net friend goes offline. Blizzard's UI shows a toast unless it was only the friend's companion app.

p.isCompanionApp: Whether it is the friend's companion app that came online.

event:BN_FRIEND_ACCOUNT_ONLINE.s: Fires when a Battle.net friend comes online. Blizzard's UI shows a toast unless it is only the friend's companion app.

p.friendIndex: The friend's index in the friends list, or nil.

event:BN_FRIEND_INFO_CHANGED.s: Fires when information about a Battle.net friend changes, such as their status or game. Blizzard's friends list updates.

event:BN_FRIEND_INVITE_ADDED.s: Fires when the player receives a Battle.net friend request. Blizzard's UI shows a toast and updates the friends list.

p.listSize: The number of pending friend requests.

event:BN_FRIEND_INVITE_LIST_INITIALIZED.s: Fires when the list of pending Battle.net friend requests has loaded. Blizzard's friends list updates.

event:BN_FRIEND_INVITE_REMOVED.s: Fires when a pending Battle.net friend request is removed, such as when it is accepted or declined. Blizzard's friends list updates.

p.accountID: The Battle.net account ID of the friend added or removed, or nil.

event:BN_FRIEND_LIST_SIZE_CHANGED.s: Fires when Battle.net friends are added or removed. Blizzard's friends list updates.

event:BN_INFO_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's own Battle.net information changes, such as their status. Blizzard's friends frame updates its status menu.

event:BN_REQUEST_FOF_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when the list of a Battle.net friend's friends has been received. Blizzard's friends-of-friends frame shows it.

event:BONUS_ROLL_ACTIVATE.s: Fires when the bonus roll prompt's roll button may be used again. Blizzard's bonus roll frame enables the button if it is still prompting.

event:BONUS_ROLL_DEACTIVATE.s: Fires when a bonus roll can't be used for now. Blizzard's bonus roll frame disables its roll button.

event:BONUS_ROLL_FAILED.s: Fires when a bonus roll fails. Blizzard's bonus roll frame stops its spinner and plays its closing animation.

p.currencyID: The currency won, if the reward is a currency.
p.isSecondaryResult: Whether this is a secondary reward of the roll.
p.personalLootToast: Whether the reward came from personal loot.
p.specID: The loot specialization the reward was rolled for.
p.typeIdentifier: The kind of reward, such as `"item"` or `"currency"`.

event:BONUS_ROLL_RESULT.s: Fires with the reward of a bonus roll after `BONUS_ROLL_STARTED`. Blizzard's bonus roll frame slows its spinner and shows the reward.

event:BONUS_ROLL_STARTED.s: Fires when a bonus roll starts. Blizzard's bonus roll frame plays the rolling sound and spinner until `BONUS_ROLL_RESULT` or `BONUS_ROLL_FAILED`.

event:BOSS_KILL.s: Fires when a boss encounter is defeated. Blizzard's boss banner shows the kill.

p.bestTopUpProductID: The top-up product the shop suggests when funds were too low.
p.totalCost: The total cost of the purchase.

event:BULK_PURCHASE_RESULT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the result of buying several shop products at once (such as a housing market cart) arrives. Blizzard's shop offers a currency top-up when the result says the funds were too low.

event:BULK_REFUND_RESULT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the result of refunding several shop products at once arrives. On success Blizzard's shop refreshes the player's Hearthsteel balance.

event:B_NET_NEIGHBORHOOD_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the search for neighborhoods of the player's Battle.net friends returns. Blizzard's house finder lists them, or shows an error when `result` is not `Enum.HousingResult.Success`.

p.pending: Whether an action is now pending.

event:CALENDAR_ACTION_PENDING.s: Fires when a calendar action starts or stops waiting for the server. Blizzard's guild mass invite frame updates on it.

event:CALENDAR_CLOSE_EVENT.s: Fires when the calendar event being viewed or edited is closed. Blizzard's calendar hides its event frame.

event:CALENDAR_EVENT_ALARM.s: Fires before a calendar event begins, to remind the player. Blizzard's UI prints "<title> begins in 15 minutes." to chat (`CALENDAR_EVENT_ALARM_MESSAGE`).

p.isCopy: Whether the event was created as a copy.

event:CALENDAR_NEW_EVENT.s: Fires when the player creates a calendar event. Blizzard's create event frame closes unless the event was a copy; the new event appears with the next `CALENDAR_UPDATE_EVENT_LIST`.

p.calendarType: The kind of event, such as `"HOLIDAY"`, `"RAID_LOCKOUT"`, `"RAID_RESET"` or a player-created type.

event:CALENDAR_OPEN_EVENT.s: Fires when a calendar event has been opened, for example with `C_Calendar.OpenEvent`. Blizzard's calendar shows the holiday, raid or player event frame depending on `calendarType`, or the edit frame if the player can edit it.

p.errorReason: The name of the global string with the error text.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_ERROR.s: Fires when a calendar action fails. Blizzard's calendar shows the error in a popup.

p.count: The number placed into the text.
p.errorReason: The name of the global string with the error text.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_ERROR_WITH_COUNT.s: Fires when a calendar action fails with an error that includes a number. Blizzard's calendar formats the global string with the count and shows it in a popup.

p.errorReason: The name of the global string with the error text.
p.playerName: The player the error is about.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_ERROR_WITH_PLAYER_.s: Fires when a calendar action fails with an error about a player. Blizzard's calendar formats the global string with the name and shows it in a popup.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_EVENT.s: Fires when the opened calendar event changes. Blizzard's calendar redraws its event frame, switching to the edit frame if the player can now edit it.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_EVENT_LIST.s: Fires when the calendar's list of events changes. Blizzard's calendar redraws its days.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_GUILD_EVENTS.s: Fires when the guild's calendar events change. Blizzard's guild news frame redraws.

p.hasCompleteList: Whether the whole invite list has arrived, if given.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_INVITE_LIST.s: Fires when the invite list of the opened calendar event changes. Blizzard's calendar redraws the invite list and the player's sign-up state.

event:CALENDAR_UPDATE_PENDING_INVITES.s: Fires when the player's pending calendar invites change. Blizzard's calendar button by the minimap refreshes its invite notice.

event:CANCEL_ALL_LOOT_ROLLS.s: Fires when every pending group loot roll is cancelled. Blizzard's group loot frames all close.

event:CANCEL_GLYPH_CAST.s: Fires when the player cancels using a glyph or glyph remover. Blizzard's spellbook clears its pending glyph visuals.

event:CANCEL_LOOT_ROLL.s: Fires when a group loot roll is cancelled or ends. Blizzard's UI removes that roll's frame and its confirmation popup.

p.playerName: Name of the player whose invite was cancelled.

event:CANCEL_NEIGHBORHOOD_INVITE_RESPONS.s: Fires when the server answers a request to cancel a pending neighborhood invite. Blizzard removes the invite from the list on success.

p.informChat: Whether to report it in chat.
p.initiatedBy: The GUID of the player who cancelled it.
p.initiatedByName: The name of that player, or nil.

event:CANCEL_PLAYER_COUNTDOWN.s: Fires when a countdown started by a group member is cancelled. Blizzard's timer frame stops it.

event:CANCEL_SUMMON.s: Fires when a pending summon offer is withdrawn or expires. Blizzard hides the summon confirmation dialogs.

p.status: Whether and how the target can be whispered.
p.whisperTarget: The GUID of the player asked about.

event:CAN_LOCAL_WHISPER_TARGET_RESPONSE.s: Fires with the server's answer after `C_ChatInfo.RequestCanLocalWhisperTarget`, telling whether the player can whisper that target. Blizzard's crafting order frames use it to enable their whisper buttons.

p.canSpeakLanguage: Whether the player can now speak the language.

event:CAN_PLAYER_SPEAK_LANGUAGE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player learns or loses the ability to speak a language. Blizzard's chat menu button shows a help tip for a newly learned language.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_ADD_PENDING_PRODUCT.s: Fires when a product is added to the shop's pending products.

p.shoppingSessionUUIDStr: The shopping session the data belongs to; Blizzard's shop ignores the event for another session.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_DATA_REFRESH.s: Fires when the shop's catalog data changes. Blizzard's shop rereads its categories and products.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_DISABLED.s: Fires when the in-game shop becomes disabled.

p.shoppingSessionUUIDStr: The shopping session the request belonged to.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_FETCH_FAILURE.s: Fires when the shop fails to load its catalog. Blizzard's shop marks the load as failed and shows an error.

p.shoppingSessionUUIDStr: The shopping session the request belonged to.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_FETCH_SUCCESS.s: Fires when the shop has loaded its catalog.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_OPEN_SIMPLE_CHECKOUT.s: Fires when the shop opens the checkout window for a purchase.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_PURCHASE_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a shop purchase succeeds. Blizzard's shop plays a celebration for the product, after the checkout window closes if it is open.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_REBUILD_SCROLL_BOX.s: Fires when the shop should rebuild its product list. Blizzard's shop redraws the products without resetting the selection.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_REFUNDABLE_DECORS_UPD.s: Fires when the list of housing decor the player can refund from the shop changes.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_REMOVE_PENDING_PRODUC.s: Fires when a product is removed from the shop's pending products.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_RESULT_ERROR.s: Fires when a shop request fails. Blizzard's shop reads the error with `C_CatalogShop.GetFailureInfo` and shows it.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_SPECIFIC_PRODUCT_REFR.s: Fires when the data of one shop product changes. Blizzard's shop redraws that product while it is shown.

p.balance: The new balance, as a string; Blizzard's UI converts it with `tonumber`.

event:CATALOG_SHOP_VIRTUAL_CURRENCY_BALA.s: Fires when the player's balance of a shop virtual currency, such as Hearthsteel, arrives or changes. It follows `C_CatalogShop.RefreshVirtualCurrencyBalance`.
Fires when the player's balance of a shop virtual currency could not be fetched.

p.confirmNumber: The held message's number, for `C_ChatInfo.SendCautionaryChatMessage` or `C_ChatInfo.DropCautionaryChatMessage`.

event:CAUTIONARY_CHANNEL_MESSAGE.s: Fires when a message the player sends to a chat channel is held back for confirmation.

p.chatLineID: The ID of the chat line holding the message.
p.confirmNumber: The held message's number, for the confirm and drop functions.

event:CAUTIONARY_CHAT_MESSAGE.s: Fires when a chat message the player sent is held back for the player to confirm. Blizzard's chat frames turn the matching line into a prompt; confirm with `C_ChatInfo.SendCautionaryChatMessage` or discard with `C_ChatInfo.DropCautionaryChatMessage`.

event:CEMETERY_PREFERENCE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's chosen graveyard changes. Blizzard's map refreshes its selectable graveyard pins.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_COMPLETED.s: Fires when the group completes a Mythic+ (challenge mode) dungeon. Blizzard's UI reads `C_ChallengeMode.GetChallengeCompletionInfo` and shows a completion banner.

p.mapID: The dungeon's challenge mode map ID.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_COMPLETED_REWARDS.s: Fires with the rewards for completing a challenge mode dungeon. Classic flavors of Blizzard's UI show an alert for it.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_DEATH_COUNT_UPDATED.s: Fires when the death count of the current Mythic+ run changes. Blizzard's objective tracker updates the count.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_KEYSTONE_RECEPTABLE.s: Fires when the player opens the keystone pedestal in a Mythic+ dungeon. Blizzard's UI shows the keystone frame.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_KEYSTONE_SLOTTED.s: Fires when a keystone is placed into the keystone pedestal. Blizzard's keystone frame shows the keystone's icon.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_LEADERBOARD_RESULT.s: Fires with a page of results from a Mythic+ leaderboard request.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_LEADERS_UPDATE.s: Fires when Mythic+ leader data has arrived. Blizzard's challenges frame updates.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_LEAVER_TIMER_ENDED.s: Fires when the warning timer for leaving a Mythic+ run ends. Blizzard's UI hides the leaver warning dialog.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_LEAVER_TIMER_STARTE.s: Fires when a warning timer for leaving a Mythic+ run starts. Blizzard's UI shows a leaver warning dialog with the time left from `C_ChallengeMode.GetLeaverPenaltyWarningTimeLeft`.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_MAPS_UPDATE.s: Fires when Mythic+ map data, such as the player's best runs, has arrived.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_MEMBER_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when Mythic+ information about the group's members has been updated. Blizzard's challenges frame updates.

p.mapID: The dungeon's challenge mode map ID.
p.timeMS: The new record time, in milliseconds.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_NEW_RECORD.s: Fires when the player sets a new best time in a challenge mode dungeon. Classic flavors of Blizzard's UI show a toast for it.

p.mapID: The dungeon's challenge mode map ID.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_RESET.s: Fires when the current Mythic+ run is reset. Blizzard's UI hides any resurrect dialogs.

p.mapID: The dungeon's challenge mode map ID.

event:CHALLENGE_MODE_START.s: Fires when a Mythic+ run starts. Blizzard's objective tracker starts the run's timers.

p.displayIndex: The channel's index in the channel list display.

event:CHANNEL_COUNT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the member count of a chat channel changes. Blizzard's channel frame updates the count on the channel's button.

p.displayIndex: The channel's index in the channel list display.

event:CHANNEL_FLAGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the flags of a chat channel the player is in change.

p.name: The name of the player who sent the invite.

event:CHANNEL_INVITE_REQUEST.s: Fires when another player invites the player to a chat channel. Blizzard's UI shows an accept dialog, or declines at once with `DeclineChannelInvite` when the `blockChannelInvites` CVar is set.

p.chatChannelID: The ID of the channel left.
p.name: The channel's name.

event:CHANNEL_LEFT.s: Fires when the player leaves a chat channel. Blizzard's channel frame removes it from its list.

event:CHANNEL_PASSWORD_REQUEST.s: Fires when the player tries to join a chat channel that needs a password. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog to enter it.

p.displayIndex: The channel's index in the channel list display.

event:CHANNEL_ROSTER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the member list of a chat channel changes. Blizzard's channel frame redraws the roster if that channel is selected.

event:CHANNEL_UI_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's chat channel list changes. Blizzard's channel frame redraws its list, and the chat settings refresh their channel options.

event:CHARACTER_ITEM_FIXUP_NOTIFICATION.s: Fires when the game has replaced some of the character's items, such as giving new weapons when abilities came to need a specific weapon type. Blizzard's character frame uses it to show a help tip about the new items.

p.change: The change in the number of points.

event:CHARACTER_POINTS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's number of unspent talent points changes. Blizzard's character frame registers it.

event:CHAT_COMBAT_MSG_ARENA_POINTS_GAIN.s: Fires when a chat message about gaining arena points arrives.

event:CHAT_DISABLED_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's chat is turned on or off. Blizzard's communities list and guild micro button update their notifications.

event:CHAT_DISABLED_CHANGE_FAILED.s: Fires when turning the player's chat on or off fails. Blizzard's chat settings and notifications update.

event:CHAT_LOGGING_CHANGED.s: Fires when chat or combat logging to file is turned on or off.

p.playerName: The name of the player who earned the achievement.

event:CHAT_MSG_ACHIEVEMENT.s: Fires when the player or someone nearby earns an achievement. The text is a format string; Blizzard's chat frames insert a link to the player for the `%s`.

p.channel: The chat type the message came through, such as `"PARTY"`, `"GUILD"` or `"WHISPER"`.
p.localID: The channel's number in the player's channel list, for channel messages.
p.name: The channel's name, for channel messages.
p.prefix: The prefix the message was sent with.
p.target: The name of the target, for whispered messages.
p.zoneChannelID: The ID of the zone channel, for channel messages.

event:CHAT_MSG_YELL.s: Fires when a player nearby yells.

event:CHAT_REGIONAL_SEND_FAILED.s: Fires when a chat message to a regional channel could not be sent because the regional chat service is unavailable. Blizzard's chat frames print a system message.

p.isServiceAvailable: Whether the regional chat service is now available.

event:CHAT_REGIONAL_STATUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the regional chat service becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard's chat frames print a system message and the channel list refreshes.

p.isInitialMessage: Whether this is the first notice of the disconnect.

event:CHAT_SERVER_DISCONNECTED.s: Fires when the client loses its connection to the chat server. Blizzard's chat frames print a warning that messages may not be sent or received.

event:CHAT_SERVER_RECONNECTED.s: Fires when the client reconnects to the chat server after a disconnect.

event:CHEST_REWARDS_UPDATED_FROM_SERVER.s: Fires when the player's pending Trading Post chest rewards arrive from the server. Blizzard's Traveler's Log and Trading Post currency display refresh.

p.canBeCancelled: Whether the player can cancel the cinematic.
p.forcedAspectRatio: The aspect ratio the cinematic forces.

event:CINEMATIC_START.s: Fires when an in-game cinematic starts. Blizzard shows the cinematic frame and hides tutorial frames; `CINEMATIC_STOP` fires when it ends.

event:CINEMATIC_STOP.s: Fires when an in-game cinematic ends. Blizzard hides the cinematic frame and shows the tutorial frames it hid.

p.loadoutIndex: The loadout's index in the loadout menu, from 1.

event:CLASS_TALENTS_SWITCH_TO_LOADOUT_BY.s: Fires when a script asks to switch to a talent loadout by index, such as through `C_ClassTalents.SwitchToLoadoutByIndex`. Blizzard's talents frame loads and switches.
Fires when a script asks to switch to a talent loadout by name, such as through `C_ClassTalents.SwitchToLoadoutByName`. Blizzard's talents frame loads and switches.

event:CLASS_TALENTS_SWITCH_TO_SPECIALIZA.s: Fires when a script asks to activate a specialization by index. Blizzard's specialization frame loads and activates it.
Fires when a script asks to activate a specialization by name. Blizzard's specialization frame loads and activates it.

event:CLASS_TRIAL_TIMER_START.s: Fires when the timer of a class trial character starts. Blizzard may show a thank-you dialog.

event:CLASS_TRIAL_UPGRADE_COMPLETE.s: Fires when a class trial character has been upgraded to a full character. Blizzard's class trial frame finishes the upgrade.

event:CLEAR_BOSS_EMOTES.s: Fires when boss emotes on screen should be cleared. Blizzard's raid boss emote frame and encounter warnings hide what they show.

event:CLICKBINDINGS_SET_HIGHLIGHTS_SHOWN.s: Fires when the highlights for click bindings should be shown or hidden. Blizzard's click binding frame shows or hides its icon highlights.

event:CLIENT_SCENE_CLOSED.s: Fires when a client scene, such as a minigame scene, closes. Blizzard's UI shows the frames it hid for the scene again.

event:CLIENT_SCENE_OPENED.s: Fires when a client scene, such as a minigame scene, opens. Blizzard's UI hides unit frames and cooldown displays during a minigame scene.

event:CLOSE_CHARTER_CONFIRMATION_UI.s: Fires when the neighborhood charter confirmation should close. Blizzard hides `HousingCreateCharterNeighborhoodConfirmationFrame`.

event:CLOSE_CREATE_CHARTER_NEIGHBORHOOD_.s: Fires when the frame for creating a charter neighborhood should close. Blizzard hides `HousingCreateNeighborhoodCharterFrame`.

event:CLOSE_CREATE_GUILD_NEIGHBORHOOD_UI.s: Fires when the frame for creating a guild neighborhood should close. Blizzard hides `HousingCreateGuildNeighborhoodFrame`.

p.mailIndex: The inbox index of the message.

event:CLOSE_INBOX_ITEM.s: Fires when an inbox message should be closed. Blizzard hides the open mail frame if it shows that message.

event:CLOSE_PLOT_CORNERSTONE.s: Fires when the interaction with a housing plot's cornerstone ends. Blizzard closes the cornerstone frames.

event:CLOSE_TABARD_FRAME.s: Fires when the guild tabard design frame should close.

event:CLUB_ADDED.s: Fires when a club, such as a community, is added to the player's clubs. Blizzard's communities list rebuilds.

event:CLUB_ERROR.s: Fires when a club action fails. Blizzard's UI shows a message built from the action and error in the error frame.

p.clubFinderGUIDs: The finder GUIDs of the clubs that sent invitations.

event:CLUB_FINDER_APPLICANT_INVITE_RECIE.s: Fires when a guild or community the player applied to through the finder invites them. Blizzard's communities list and Battle.net toasts show the invitations.

p.clubFinderGUIDs: The finder GUIDs of the clubs whose applications changed.
p.type: Which lists changed: guild, community or all (`Enum.ClubFinderRequestType`).

event:CLUB_FINDER_APPLICATIONS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the applications to the player's guild or community through the finder change. Blizzard's finder frames rebuild the guild or community applicant lists.

event:CLUB_FINDER_CAN_WHISPER_APPLICANT.s: Fires when the player may whisper a guild or community applicant. Blizzard's communities frame opens a whisper to them.

event:CLUB_FINDER_MEMBERSHIP_LIST_CHANGE.s: Fires when the club finder's list of the player's memberships changes. Blizzard's club finder frame listens for it.

p.type: Which list arrived: guild, community or all (`Enum.ClubFinderRequestType`).

event:CLUB_FINDER_PLAYER_PENDING_LIST_RE.s: Fires when the list of the player's pending guild or community applications arrives. Blizzard's communities list updates its finder invitations.

p.clubFinderGUIDs: The finder GUIDs of the listings that changed.

event:CLUB_FINDER_POST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the finder listing of a guild or community has been posted or changed. Blizzard's recruitment dialogs close.

event:CLUB_FINDER_RECRUIT_LIST_CHANGED.s: Fires when the list of players looking for a guild or community changes. Blizzard's club finder rebuilds its recruit lists.

p.clubId: The club the invitations belong to.

event:CLUB_INVITATIONS_RECEIVED_FOR_CLUB.s: Fires when the list of pending invitations for a club arrives. Blizzard's member list refreshes its invitations when it shows that club.

p.invitation: Information about the invitation and the club.

event:CLUB_INVITATION_ADDED_FOR_SELF.s: Fires when the player is invited to a club. Blizzard's communities list and micro menu button show the new invitation.

event:CLUB_INVITATION_REMOVED_FOR_SELF.s: Fires when one of the player's club invitations goes away. Blizzard's communities list updates its invitations.

event:CLUB_MEMBERS_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club's member list changes or finishes loading. Blizzard's member list redraws and shows a spinner until `C_Club.AreMembersReady` is true.

event:CLUB_MEMBER_ADDED.s: Fires when a member joins a club. Blizzard's member list redraws and drops the matching pending invitation.

event:CLUB_MEMBER_PRESENCE_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club member's online presence changes. Blizzard's member list updates that member's presence and sorts again.

event:CLUB_MEMBER_REMOVED.s: Fires when a member leaves or is removed from a club. Blizzard's member list redraws.

event:CLUB_MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club member's role changes. Blizzard's member list stores the new role and sorts again.

event:CLUB_MEMBER_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club member's information changes. Blizzard's member list redraws, and the chat refreshes messages that were waiting for that member's info.

p.streamId: The stream the message was posted to.

event:CLUB_MESSAGE_ADDED.s: Fires when a new message is posted to a club stream. Blizzard's communities chat adds it with `C_Club.GetMessageInfo` when that stream is shown.

p.contiguousRange: The range of messages now held without gaps.
p.downloadedRange: The range of messages that was downloaded.

event:CLUB_MESSAGE_HISTORY_RECEIVED.s: Fires when older messages of a club stream have been downloaded. Blizzard's communities chat fills in the history when that stream is shown.

event:CLUB_MESSAGE_UPDATED.s: Fires when an existing club message changes. Blizzard's communities chat redraws that message.

event:CLUB_REMOVED.s: Fires when the player leaves a club or the club is removed. Blizzard's communities list rebuilds and chat windows drop the club's channels.

event:CLUB_REMOVED_MESSAGE.s: Fires when the player is removed from a club, with the reason. Blizzard's UI shows a message naming the club in the error frame.

event:CLUB_SELF_MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's own role in a club changes. Blizzard's communities frame reloads the player's privileges with `C_Club.GetClubPrivileges`.

event:CLUB_STREAMS_LOADED.s: Fires when a club's streams have loaded. Blizzard's communities frame selects the first stream if none is selected and redraws its stream menu.

event:CLUB_STREAM_ADDED.s: Fires when a stream (channel) is added to a club. Blizzard's communities frame updates its stream menu.

event:CLUB_STREAM_REMOVED.s: Fires when a stream (channel) is removed from a club. Blizzard's communities frame selects another stream if the removed one was shown.

event:CLUB_STREAM_SUBSCRIBED.s: Fires when the player is subscribed to a club stream. Blizzard's communities chat requests the stream's first messages when it is the one shown.

event:CLUB_STREAM_UNSUBSCRIBED.s: Fires when the player is unsubscribed from a club stream.

event:CLUB_STREAM_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club stream's settings change.

p.clubId: The club the tickets belong to.

event:CLUB_TICKETS_RECEIVED.s: Fires when a club's invite links (tickets) arrive. Blizzard's invite link manager redraws its list.

event:CLUB_TICKET_CREATED.s: Fires when a new invite link (ticket) is created for a club. Blizzard's invite link manager adds it to its list.

event:CLUB_TICKET_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the answer to `C_Club.RequestTicket` arrives. Blizzard's UI reads it with `C_Club.GetLastTicketResponse` and lists the club or shows an error.

event:CLUB_UPDATED.s: Fires when a club's information changes. Blizzard's communities list and frame redraw that club.

event:COLOR_OVERRIDES_RESET.s: Fires when all color overrides are reset to their defaults. Blizzard's scrolling message frames and widgets redraw with the default colors.

event:COLOR_OVERRIDE_UPDATED.s: Fires when a color override changes, such as an item quality color. Blizzard's scrolling message frames and widgets redraw.

event:COMBAT_LOG_APPLY_FILTER_SETTINGS.s: Fires when new combat log filter settings should be applied. Blizzard's combat log processor stores them.

event:COMBAT_LOG_ENTRIES_CLEARED.s: Fires when the combat log's entries are cleared.

event:COMBAT_LOG_EVENT.s: Fires for each new combat log entry. Blizzard's docs mark it as a restricted callback event, delivered through callbacks rather than frame registration; Blizzard's combat log reads the entry with `C_CombatLogSecure.GetCurrentEventInfo`.

event:COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED.s: Fires for each new combat log entry, without the combat log's filters. Blizzard's docs mark it as a restricted callback event, delivered through callbacks rather than frame registration.

p.colorB: The blue part of the line's color.
p.colorG: The green part of the line's color.
p.colorR: The red part of the line's color.
p.order: Where the line goes in the log (`Enum.CombatLogMessageOrder`).

event:COMBAT_LOG_MESSAGE.s: Fires with a formatted combat log line to show. Blizzard's combat log frame adds it in the given color.

event:COMBAT_LOG_MESSAGE_LIMIT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the number of messages the combat log keeps changes.

event:COMBAT_LOG_REFILTER_ENTRIES.s: Fires when the combat log entries should be filtered again. Blizzard's combat log processor registers it.

event:COMBAT_RATING_UPDATE.s: Fires when one of the player's combat ratings changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

p.combatTextType: The kind of message, such as `"DAMAGE"` or `"HEAL"`.

event:COMBAT_TEXT_UPDATE.s: Fires for each floating combat text message. Blizzard's combat text reads the details with `C_CombatText.GetCurrentEventInfo`.

event:COMBO_TARGET_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's combo points move to a new target. The number of points may stay the same, so no power event fires; Blizzard's combo point bar redraws itself.

event:COMMENTATOR_COMBAT_EVENT.s: Fires for a combat event the spectator UI shows. Read it with `C_Commentator.GetCombatEventInfo`.

event:COMMENTATOR_ENTER_WORLD.s: Fires when a commentator enters the world. Blizzard's spectator UI sets itself up if the player is spectating.

event:COMMENTATOR_HISTORY_FLUSHED.s: Fires when the commentator's match history is cleared. Blizzard's spectator scoreboard resets.

event:COMMENTATOR_IMMEDIATE_FOV_UPDATE.s: Fires when the spectator camera's field of view is changed at once.

event:COMMENTATOR_MAP_UPDATE.s: Fires when the map in spectator mode changes.

p.overrideName: The name to show instead, or nil to clear the override.

event:COMMENTATOR_PLAYER_NAME_OVERRIDE_U.s: Fires when the name shown for a player in spectator mode is overridden or the override is cleared. Blizzard's spectator unit frames rebuild.

event:COMMENTATOR_PLAYER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the players tracked in spectator mode change. Blizzard's spectator unit frames rebuild.

event:COMMENTATOR_RESET_SETTINGS.s: Fires when the spectator settings are reset. Blizzard's spectator UI goes back to its default settings.

p.swapped: Whether the teams are now swapped.

event:COMMENTATOR_TEAMS_SWAPPED.s: Fires when the two teams' sides are swapped in spectator mode. Blizzard's spectator nameplates update their colors.

event:COMMENTATOR_TEAM_NAME_UPDATE.s: Fires when a team's name changes in spectator mode. Blizzard's spectator scoreboard refreshes.

event:COMMODITY_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE.s: Fires when a commodity purchase the player started can't be given a price. Blizzard's buy dialog shows the price as unavailable.

p.updatedTotalPrice: The price for the whole quantity, in copper.
p.updatedUnitPrice: The price per unit, in copper.

event:COMMODITY_PRICE_UPDATED.s: Fires with the current price after the player starts buying a commodity with `C_AuctionHouse.StartCommoditiesPurchase`. Blizzard's buy dialog compares it with the price it showed and asks again if it went up.

event:COMMODITY_PURCHASED.s: Fires when the player buys a commodity.

event:COMMODITY_PURCHASE_FAILED.s: Fires when buying a commodity fails. Blizzard's buy dialog shows the price as unavailable.

event:COMMODITY_PURCHASE_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when buying a commodity succeeds. Blizzard's buy dialog plays a coin sound and closes, and the buy frame resets its quantity to 1.

event:COMMODITY_SEARCH_RESULTS_ADDED.s: Fires when more results arrive for a commodity search. Blizzard's commodities list redraws.

event:COMMODITY_SEARCH_RESULTS_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the results of a commodity search have arrived. Blizzard's commodities list and buy frame treat the results as loaded.

event:COMMODITY_SEARCH_RESULTS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the results of a commodity search change. Blizzard's commodities list rebuilds.

event:COMPACT_UNIT_FRAME_PROFILES_LOADED.s: Fires when the raid frame profiles have loaded. From then on `HasLoadedCUFProfiles` returns true.

event:COMPANION_LEARNED.s: Fires when the player learns a companion, such as a mount. Blizzard's mount journal refreshes and the collections button checks its alert.

event:COMPANION_UNLEARNED.s: Fires when the player loses a companion, such as a mount. Blizzard's mount journal refreshes.

p.companionType: The kind of companion that changed, `MOUNT` or `CRITTER`; nil when not given.

event:COMPANION_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's companions change, such as when one is summoned or dismissed. Blizzard's mount and pet journals refresh when the type matches.

event:CONFIG_COMMIT_FAILED.s: Fires when committing changes to a talent (trait) configuration fails. Blizzard's talent frames end the pending commit and reset their state.

p.friendLevel: The kind of Battle.net friend the request would make.
p.name: The name of the player to send the request to.

event:CONFIRM_BATTLE_NET_FRIEND_INVITE_S.s: Fires when sending a Battle.net friend request to a unit needs confirming. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog and sends the request with `C_BattleNet.SendVerifiedBattleNetFriendInvite`.

event:CONFIRM_BEFORE_USE.s: Fires when using an item needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ConfirmOnUse`.

p.areaName: Name of the area the hearthstone would be bound to.

event:CONFIRM_BINDER.s: Fires when the player asks an innkeeper to make the inn their home. Blizzard shows a dialog to confirm binding the hearthstone there.

event:CONFIRM_DISENCHANT_ROLL.s: Fires when choosing disenchant on a group loot roll needs confirmation. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying that disenchanting the item will destroy it, and accepting calls `ConfirmLootRoll`.

event:CONFIRM_LOOT_ROLL.s: Fires when a group loot roll choice needs confirmation because the item binds when looted. Blizzard's UI shows a popup, and accepting calls `ConfirmLootRoll(rollID, rollType)`.

event:CONFIRM_PET_UNLEARN.s: Fires when the player asks a trainer to reset their pet's training. The classic UI closes the gossip window and asks for confirmation.

p.skippingStartExperience: Whether accepting skips the starting area.
p.summonReason: Why the summon was offered (`Enum.SummonReason`); scenario summons get their own dialog.

event:CONFIRM_SUMMON.s: Fires when another player offers to summon the player. Blizzard shows a summon confirmation dialog.

p.cost: The cost of the reset, in copper.
p.respecType: What is being reset; Blizzard picks the `CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE_` text for it.

event:CONFIRM_TALENT_WIPE.s: Fires when the player asks a trainer to reset their talents. Blizzard's UI closes the gossip window and asks for confirmation with the cost; accepting calls `ConfirmTalentWipe`.

event:CONFIRM_XP_LOSS.s: Fires when the player asks a spirit healer to resurrect them. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog with the resurrection sickness it would cause.

event:CONSOLE_CLEAR.s: Fires when the developer console is cleared. Blizzard's console frame removes its messages.

event:CONSOLE_COLORS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the developer console's colors change. Blizzard's console frame redraws its messages.

event:CONSOLE_FONT_SIZE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the developer console's font size changes. Blizzard's console frame applies `ConsoleGetFontHeight()`.

event:CONSOLE_LOG.s: Fires when a message is written to the console log.

p.colorType: The color category of the message.

event:CONSOLE_MESSAGE.s: Fires when a message is printed to the developer console. Blizzard's console frame adds it.

p.isEnabled: Whether content tracking is now on.

event:CONTENT_TRACKING_IS_ENABLED_UPDATE.s: Fires when content tracking is turned on or off. Blizzard's adventure objective tracker redraws.

event:CONTENT_TRACKING_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of content the player tracks changes.

event:CONTENT_TRACKING_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player starts or stops tracking a piece of content, such as an achievement or appearance. Blizzard's objective trackers and map pins update.

event:CONTRIBUTION_CHANGED.s: Fires when the state of a contribution changes.

p.isPending: Whether the contribution is still pending.

event:CONTRIBUTION_COLLECTOR_PENDING.s: Fires when a contribution the player is making starts or stops waiting for the server. Blizzard's contribution frame updates that entry.

event:CONTRIBUTION_COLLECTOR_UPDATE.s: Fires when the contributions offered by the contribution collector change. Blizzard's contribution frame rebuilds.

event:CONTRIBUTION_COLLECTOR_UPDATE_SING.s: Fires when one contribution offered by the contribution collector changes. Blizzard's contribution frame updates that entry.

event:CONVERT_TO_BIND_TO_ACCOUNT_CONFIRM.s: Fires when the player tries to equip an item they cannot equip whose appearance can be collected, which makes it account-bound. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `ConvertItemToBindToAccount`.

event:CONVERT_TO_RAID_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when an action would convert the player's party into a raid and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI shows a warning dialog when a quest session is active.

event:COOLDOWN_VIEWER_DATA_LOADED.s: Fires when the data of the cooldown manager is loaded. Blizzard's cooldown viewer settings load once this, `VARIABLES_LOADED` and `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` have all fired.

p.baseSpellID: The base spell that is gaining or losing an override.
p.overrideSpellID: The spell now overriding the base spell, or nil when the override is removed.

event:COOLDOWN_VIEWER_SPELL_OVERRIDE_UPD.s: Fires when a spell shown in the cooldown manager gains or loses an override spell. Blizzard's cooldown viewer items update.

event:COOLDOWN_VIEWER_TABLE_HOTFIXED.s: Fires when the cooldown manager's data is changed by a hotfix. Blizzard's cooldown viewer settings refresh.

event:CORPSE_IN_INSTANCE.s: Fires when the player's ghost reaches the entrance of the instance their corpse is in. Blizzard's UI offers to recover the corpse inside.

event:CORPSE_IN_RANGE.s: Fires when the player's ghost comes close enough to recover their corpse. Blizzard's UI shows the recover corpse dialog.

event:CORPSE_OUT_OF_RANGE.s: Fires when the player's ghost moves out of range of their corpse. Blizzard's UI hides the recover corpse dialogs.

event:COVENANT_CALLINGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's covenant callings arrive or change. Blizzard's callings display refreshes.

event:COVENANT_CHOSEN.s: Fires when the player chooses a covenant. Blizzard's UI shows a banner for it.

event:COVENANT_PREVIEW_CLOSE.s: Fires when the covenant preview window should close. Blizzard's preview frame hides.

p.previewInfo: What the preview shows about the covenant.

event:COVENANT_PREVIEW_OPEN.s: Fires when the preview of a covenant should open. Blizzard's UI tries to show the covenant preview frame.

event:COVENANT_RENOWN_CATCH_UP_STATE_UPD.s: Fires when the covenant renown catch-up state changes. Blizzard's renown frame updates its renown available icon.

event:COVENANT_SANCTUM_RENOWN_LEVEL_CHAN.s: Fires when the player's covenant renown level changes. Blizzard's UI shows a level-up toast when the level went up past 1, and the renown frame redraws.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CAN_REQUEST.s: Fires when the player may request crafting order lists again. Blizzard's order pages enable their refresh button, which they disable after each request.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CLAIMED_ORDER_ADDED.s: Fires when the player claims a crafting order. Blizzard's crafter order view shows the order from `C_CraftingOrders.GetClaimedOrder`.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CLAIMED_ORDER_REMOV.s: Fires when the player's claimed crafting order is removed, such as after it is fulfilled. Blizzard's crafter order view closes the order if nothing is claimed any more.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CLAIMED_ORDER_UPDAT.s: Fires when the player's claimed crafting order changes. Blizzard's crafter order view shows the order again from `C_CraftingOrders.GetClaimedOrder`.

p.orderID: The order the player tried to claim.
p.result: The result (`Enum.CraftingOrderResult`); `Ok` when the order was claimed.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CLAIM_ORDER_RESPONS.s: Fires when an attempt to claim a crafting order has been handled. On failure Blizzard's order view shows why, such as the player's own order or no claims left, and closes the order.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CRAFT_ORDER_RESPONS.s: Fires when crafting the item for a claimed crafting order runs into a problem. Blizzard's crafter order view shows an error message when it arrives.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CUSTOMER_FAVORITES_.s: Fires when the recipes the player has marked as favorites in the crafting orders customer frame change. Blizzard's frame updates its favorites button and recipe list.
