event:CRAFTINGORDERS_CUSTOMER_OPTIONS_PA.s: Fires when the recipe options for the crafting orders customer frame are ready after `C_CraftingOrders.ParseCustomerOptions`. Blizzard's frame fills its category list and enables searching.

p.itemNameString: The name of the crafted item.
p.orderTypeString: The kind of order, as display text.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_DISPLAY_CRAFTER_FUL.s: Fires when the player fulfills a crafting order. Blizzard's UI prints a message in chat with the item, the customer and the tip earned.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_FULFILL_ORDER_RESPO.s: Fires when fulfilling a claimed crafting order has been handled. Blizzard's crafter order view waits for `CRAFTINGORDERS_CLAIMED_ORDER_REMOVED` to close the order.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_HIDE_CRAFTER.s: Fires when the crafter side of the crafting orders interface should close.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_HIDE_CUSTOMER.s: Fires when the player's interaction with a crafting orders clerk ends. Blizzard's UI hides the customer orders frame.

p.result: The result (`Enum.CraftingOrderResult`); `Ok` when the order was cancelled.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_ORDER_CANCEL_RESPON.s: Fires when cancelling one of the player's crafting orders has been handled. On failure Blizzard's UI shows an error, with its own message when the order is already claimed.

p.result: The result (`Enum.CraftingOrderResult`); `Ok` when the order was placed.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_ORDER_PLACEMENT_RES.s: Fires when placing a crafting order has been handled. On failure Blizzard's order form shows why, such as an invalid target or a target who cannot craft the recipe.

p.result: The result (`Enum.CraftingOrderResult`); `Ok` when the order was rejected.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_REJECT_ORDER_RESPON.s: Fires when rejecting a personal crafting order has been handled. On success Blizzard's order view closes the order.

p.result: The result (`Enum.CraftingOrderResult`); `Ok` when the order was released.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_RELEASE_ORDER_RESPO.s: Fires when releasing a claimed crafting order has been handled. On success Blizzard's order view closes the order.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_SHOW_CRAFTER.s: Fires when the crafter side of the crafting orders interface should open.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_SHOW_CUSTOMER.s: Fires when the player talks to a crafting orders clerk. Blizzard's UI opens the customer orders frame, or shows an error for restricted trial accounts.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_UNEXPECTED_ERROR.s: Fires when a crafting order action fails unexpectedly. Blizzard's crafter order view shows a generic error message.

p.orderID: The order the name belongs to.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_UPDATE_CUSTOMER_NAM.s: Fires when the name of a crafting order's customer becomes available. Blizzard's crafter order view fills in the poster's name.

p.numOrders: How many orders of that kind are available.
p.orderType: The kind of order, such as guild or personal (`Enum.CraftingOrderType`).

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_UPDATE_ORDER_COUNT.s: Fires when the number of crafting orders of one kind available to the player arrives. Blizzard's crafter order page shows the count on the matching tab.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_UPDATE_PERSONAL_ORD.s: Fires when the number of personal crafting orders waiting for the player changes. Blizzard's minimap indicator reads `C_CraftingOrders.GetPersonalOrdersInfo` and shows itself when there are any.

p.orderID: The order the rewards belong to.

event:CRAFTINGORDERS_UPDATE_REWARDS.s: Fires when the rewards of an NPC crafting order become available or change. Blizzard's crafter order view shows them.

event:CRAFTING_DETAILS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the crafting details of the open recipe change. Blizzard's recipe form updates its detail stats.

event:CRAFTING_HOUSE_DISABLED.s: Fires when the crafting orders house is not accepting orders. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying the Artisan's Consortium is closed for now.

p.neighborhoodName: The name of the new neighborhood.

event:CREATE_NEIGHBORHOOD_RESULT.s: Fires when the server answers a request to create a neighborhood. On success Blizzard shows a banner with the neighborhood's name.

event:CRITERIA_COMPLETE.s: Fires when a criteria is completed. Blizzard's bonus objective tracker checks the scenario bonus steps for it.

p.achievementAlreadyEarnedOnAccount: Whether the achievement was already earned on the account.
p.achievementID: The achievement the criteria belongs to.

event:CRITERIA_EARNED.s: Fires when the player earns a criteria of an achievement. Blizzard shows a criteria alert.

event:CRITERIA_UPDATE.s: Fires when the progress of achievement criteria changes. Blizzard's achievement and statistics frames refresh.

event:CURRENCY_DISPLAY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the amount of a currency the player has changes. All of its values can be nil.

event:CURRENCY_TRANSFER_FAILED.s: Fires when a currency transfer between characters fails. Blizzard's transfer window closes.

event:CURRENCY_TRANSFER_INITIATED.s: Fires when a currency transfer between characters starts.

event:CURRENCY_TRANSFER_LOG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the log of currency transfers changes. Blizzard's transfer log redraws.

event:CURRENCY_TRANSFER_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a currency transfer between characters succeeds.

event:CURRENT_HOUSE_INFO_RECIEVED.s: Fires when the information about the house the player is at arrives. Blizzard's housing controls, cornerstone and house settings frames update from it.

event:CURRENT_HOUSE_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the information about the house the player is at changes. Blizzard's housing controls and cornerstone frames update from it.

p.cancelledCast: Whether the change came from cancelling a cast.

event:CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED.s: Fires when the spell the player is casting or targeting changes, such as when a cast starts, ends or is cancelled. Blizzard updates cursors and hides some enchant confirmation dialogs.

p.isDefault: Whether the cursor is now the default one.
p.oldCursorVirtualID: The virtual ID of what the cursor held before.

event:CURSOR_CHANGED.s: Fires when what the cursor holds or its type changes.

p.eventName: The name of the CVar that changed.

event:CVAR_UPDATE.s: Fires when a console variable changes. Blizzard's frames check the name and react only to the CVars they care about.

event:DAILY_RESET_INSTANCE_WELCOME.s: Fires when the player enters an instance that the daily reset will reset. Blizzard's UI prints a welcome message with the time left.

p.sessionID: The session that changed, `0` for the overall session.
p.type: The kind of meter data that changed (`Enum.DamageMeterType`).

event:DAMAGE_METER_COMBAT_SESSION_UPDATE.s: Fires when damage meter data for a combat session changes. It fires twice per update, once for the overall session (session ID 0) and once for the current session, so Blizzard's window handles only one of them.

event:DAMAGE_METER_CURRENT_SESSION_UPDAT.s: Fires when the damage meter's current session changes. Blizzard's window showing the current session redraws.

event:DAMAGE_METER_RESET.s: Fires when the damage meter data is reset. Blizzard's damage meter windows redraw from the top.

event:DECLINE_NEIGHBORHOOD_INVITATION_RE.s: Fires when the server answers the player's decline of a neighborhood invitation. On success Blizzard's house finder removes the neighborhood from its list.

p.questWarn: 1 if the item starts or belongs to a quest.

event:DELETE_ITEM_CONFIRM.s: Fires when the player tries to destroy the item on the cursor. Blizzard's UI asks for confirmation, with a stronger dialog for rare or better items and for quest items, then deletes it.

event:DISABLE_LOW_LEVEL_RAID.s: Fires when the setting read by `GetAllowLowLevelRaid` is turned off.

event:DISABLE_TAXI_BENCHMARK.s: Fires when taxi benchmark mode is turned off. Blizzard hides the framerate display it showed and prints a chat message.

event:DISABLE_XP_GAIN.s: Fires when experience gain is turned off for the player. Blizzard's status tracking bars update; `ENABLE_XP_GAIN` fires when it is turned back on.

event:DISCORD_GUILD_ACHIEVEMENT.s: Fires when the player's guild earns an achievement to share with its linked Discord server.

event:DISCORD_GUILD_LOBBY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild's Discord lobby changes. Blizzard's guild control Discord tab updates.

event:DISCORD_GUILD_SETTINGS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild's Discord settings change. Blizzard's guild control Discord tab updates its checkboxes from `C_Discord.IsGuildSettingSet`.

event:DISCORD_LINK_UPDATE.s: Fires when the link between the player's account and Discord changes. Blizzard's social and audio settings and the guild control Discord tab update.

event:DISCORD_SERVER_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of the player's Discord servers changes. Blizzard's guild control Discord tab updates.

event:DISCORD_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's Discord connection status changes. Blizzard's guild control Discord tab updates.

event:DISPLAY_EVENT_TOASTS.s: Fires when event toasts are waiting to be shown. Blizzard's event toast manager starts showing them if it is not already.

event:DISPLAY_EVENT_TOAST_LINK.s: Fires when a chat link for an event toast should be shown in chat.

event:DISPLAY_SIZE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the size of the game's display changes, for example after a resolution or window size change. Many of Blizzard's frames lay themselves out again on it.

event:DUEL_FINISHED.s: Fires when a duel ends. Blizzard hides the duel request and out-of-bounds dialogs.

event:DUEL_INBOUNDS.s: Fires when the player moves back inside the duel area. Blizzard hides the out-of-bounds warning.

event:DUEL_OUTOFBOUNDS.s: Fires when the player leaves the duel area during a duel. Blizzard shows a warning that the duel will be forfeited.

event:DUEL_REQUESTED.s: Fires when another player challenges the player to a duel. Blizzard shows a dialog to accept or decline it.

event:DUEL_TO_THE_DEATH_REQUESTED.s: Fires when another player challenges the player to a duel to the death. Blizzard shows a dialog to accept or decline it.

event:DYE_COLOR_CATEGORY_UPDATED.s: Fires when a dye color category changes. Blizzard's house editor refreshes the selected decor's details.

event:DYE_COLOR_UPDATED.s: Fires when a dye color changes, such as when the player gains one. Blizzard's house editor refreshes the selected decor's details.

event:DYNAMIC_GOSSIP_POI_UPDATED.s: Fires when the map points of interest that gossip options create change. Blizzard's map refreshes its gossip pins.

p.direction: The direction the Eclipse bar now moves in.

event:ECLIPSE_DIRECTION_CHANGE.s: Fires when the direction of the druid's Eclipse bar changes.

p.layoutInfo: The layouts and which one is active.
p.reconcileLayouts: Whether the layouts should be reconciled with the current defaults.

event:EDIT_MODE_LAYOUTS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's Edit Mode layouts are loaded or change. Blizzard's Edit Mode manager applies the layout information.

event:EJ_DIFFICULTY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the difficulty shown in the Encounter Journal changes.

p.itemID: The item whose data arrived, or nil.

event:EJ_LOOT_DATA_RECIEVED.s: Fires when loot data for the Encounter Journal has arrived.

event:ENABLE_LOW_LEVEL_RAID.s: Fires when the setting read by `GetAllowLowLevelRaid` is turned on.

event:ENABLE_TAXI_BENCHMARK.s: Fires when taxi benchmark mode is turned on. Blizzard shows the framerate display.

event:ENABLE_XP_GAIN.s: Fires when experience gain is turned back on for the player. Blizzard's status tracking bars update.

p.enchantedItem: The location of the enchanted item, or nil.

event:ENCHANT_SPELL_COMPLETED.s: Fires when an enchanting spell finishes on an item.

event:ENCHANT_SPELL_SELECTED.s: Fires when the player starts an enchanting spell that waits for an item target. Blizzard's UI plays a sound and may open the bags or character frame to pick the item.

p.difficultyID: The difficulty it was fought on.
p.encounterUnitStatus: The boss units engaged during the encounter.
p.groupSize: The number of players in the group.
p.success: Whether the encounter was won, as a number.

event:ENCOUNTER_END.s: Fires when a boss encounter ends, whether it was won or not.

p.encounterID: The encounter the loot came from.
p.fileName: Read by Blizzard's UI as that player's class file name, such as `"WARRIOR"`.
p.itemName: Read by Blizzard's UI as the name of the player who received it.

event:ENCOUNTER_LOOT_RECEIVED.s: Fires for each item a group member receives from a boss encounter. Blizzard's boss banner lists the loot under the kill banner in dungeons and raids. Blizzard's handler reads the fifth and sixth values as the player's name and class file name.

p.difficultyID: The difficulty it is fought on.
p.groupSize: The number of players in the group.

event:ENCOUNTER_START.s: Fires when a boss encounter starts.

event:ENCOUNTER_WARNING.s: Fires when a boss encounter shows a warning. Blizzard's encounter warnings frame displays it.

p.reason: The action that would end the trade window, passed back to `C_Item.EndBoundTradeable`.

event:END_BOUND_TRADEABLE.s: Fires when an action would make a tradeable bound item no longer tradeable and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.EndBoundTradeable`.

event:ENTERED_DIFFERENT_INSTANCE_FROM_PA.s: Fires when the player enters a different instance than the one their party is in.

p.name: The entitlement's name.
p.payloadID: The ID of the delivered thing.
p.showFancyToast: Whether to show the larger alert.

event:ENTITLEMENT_DELIVERED.s: Fires when an entitlement, such as a mount, pet, toy or game time, is delivered to the player. Blizzard shows an alert.

event:EQUIPMENT_SETS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's equipment sets change, such as one being saved, renamed or deleted. Blizzard's equipment manager updates.

event:EQUIPMENT_SWAP_FINISHED.s: Fires when equipping an equipment set finishes.

event:EQUIPMENT_SWAP_PENDING.s: Fires when equipping an equipment set has started but is not finished yet.

p.slot: The equipment slot the item goes into.

event:EQUIP_BIND_CONFIRM.s: Fires when equipping an item would bind it to the player and needs confirmation. Blizzard shows the bind-on-equip dialog.

event:EQUIP_BIND_REFUNDABLE_CONFIRM.s: Fires when equipping an item would make it non-refundable and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and equips it with `EquipPendingItem`.

event:EQUIP_BIND_TRADEABLE_CONFIRM.s: Fires when equipping an item would make it non-tradeable and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and equips it with `EquipPendingItem`.

event:EVENT_REALM_QUEUES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the queue information of event realms changes on the character select screen.

event:EVENT_SCHEDULER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the event scheduler's scheduled events change, for example after `C_EventScheduler.RequestEvents`. Blizzard's event scheduler and its reminders refresh.

p.expandBagBar: Whether the bag bar is now expanded.

event:EXPAND_BAG_BAR_CHANGED.s: Fires when the setting to expand the bag bar changes.

event:EXTERNAL_EVENT_LAUNCH_URL_FAILED.s: Fires when opening the web page for an external event fails. Blizzard's game menu shows an error dialog.

event:EXTERNAL_EVENT_LAUNCH_URL_RESULT.s: Fires when an attempt to open an external event's web page from the game finishes. On failure Blizzard's game menu shows an error popup.

event:EXTERNAL_EVENT_URL_CHANGED.s: Fires when the web address of the current external event changes. Blizzard's minimap button for the event refreshes.

p.itemID: The item the info is for.

event:EXTRA_BROWSE_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when extra browse info for an item arrives after `C_AuctionHouse.GetExtraBrowseInfo` returned nothing. Blizzard's level column fills in the cell for that item.

event:FACTION_STANDING_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's standing with a faction changes.

event:FIRST_FRAME_RENDERED.s: Fires when the game renders its first frame after loading. Blizzard waits for it, `VARIABLES_LOADED` and `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` before it starts showing alerts.

event:FOG_OF_WAR_UPDATED.s: Fires when the fog of war on the map changes. Blizzard's map fog frame redraws.

event:FORBIDDEN_NAME_PLATE_CREATED.s: Fires when a forbidden nameplate frame is created. Forbidden nameplates belong to units addons may not touch, such as in some instances.

p.unitToken: The nameplate's unit token, such as `nameplate1`.

event:FORBIDDEN_NAME_PLATE_UNIT_ADDED.s: Fires when a forbidden nameplate is shown for a unit.

p.unitToken: The nameplate's unit token, such as `nameplate1`.

event:FORBIDDEN_NAME_PLATE_UNIT_REMOVED.s: Fires when a forbidden nameplate stops showing a unit.

event:FORCE_REFRESH_HOUSE_FINDER.s: Fires when the house finder should reload its data. Blizzard's house finder refreshes as if its refresh button were clicked.

event:FRAME_MANAGER_UPDATE_ALL.s: Fires when the visibility of every managed UI frame type should be refreshed. Blizzard's frame manager reads each with `C_FrameManager.GetFrameVisibilityState`.

p.show: Whether frames of that type should show.

event:FRAME_MANAGER_UPDATE_FRAME.s: Fires when one managed UI frame type should be shown or hidden. Blizzard's frame manager updates the frames registered for that type.

event:FRIENDLIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's character friends list changes or is received from the server. Blizzard's friends list updates.

event:FULLSCREEN_BROWSER_SPINNER_HIDE.s: Fires when the full-screen in-game browser's loading spinner should be hidden.

event:FULLSCREEN_BROWSER_SPINNER_SHOW.s: Fires when the full-screen in-game browser's loading spinner should be shown. Blizzard's UI also stops auto-run.

event:GAMEPAD_POSSESS_BAR_OVERRIDE_CHANG.s: Fires when the override of the gamepad possess bar changes.

event:GAMEPAD_STANCE_BAR_OVERRIDE_CHANGE.s: Fires when the override of the gamepad stance bar changes.

event:GAME_MODE_DISPLAY_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the display information of the current game mode changes, such as after switching game mode. Blizzard hides its game mode picker.

p.disabled: Whether the game mode is disabled now.

event:GAME_MODE_DISPLAY_MODE_TOGGLE_DISA.s: Fires when a game mode becomes selectable or unselectable in the game mode picker.

p.isActive: Whether a game pad is now active.

event:GAME_PAD_ACTIVE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a game pad becomes the active input device or stops being it. Blizzard's frames update the key bindings they show.

p.enabled: Whether hover events are now allowed.

event:GAME_PAD_ALLOW_HOVER_EVENTS_WITH_F.s: Fires when the setting that allows mouse hover events during game pad free look changes.

event:GAME_PAD_CONFIGS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the game pad configurations change.

event:GAME_PAD_CONNECTED.s: Fires when a game pad is connected. Blizzard's input code runs the callbacks registered with `InputUtil.RegisterGamepadDeviceConnectedCallback`.

event:GAME_PAD_DISCONNECTED.s: Fires when a game pad is disconnected.

event:GAME_PAD_POWER_CHANGED.s: Fires when a game pad's battery level changes.

event:GAME_RULES_CHANGED.s: Fires when the game rules in effect change. Blizzard's character select screen refreshes its settings.

event:GARRISON_ARCHITECT_CLOSED.s: Fires when the garrison architect table, opened with `GARRISON_ARCHITECT_OPENED`, closes.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the garrison the table belongs to.

event:GARRISON_ARCHITECT_OPENED.s: Fires when the player opens the garrison architect table. Blizzard's minimap button stops its building pulse when it fires.

p.garrisonType: The garrison type (`Enum.GarrisonType`) the building belongs to.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_ACTIVATABLE.s: Fires when a garrison building finishes construction and is ready to be activated. Blizzard shows a building alert and pulses the landing page minimap button.

p.garrisonPlotInstanceID: The plot the building stands on.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_ACTIVATED.s: Fires when a garrison building is activated. Blizzard's architect table refreshes the plot it stands on.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_ERROR.s: Fires when a garrison building action fails. Blizzard's architect table plays an error sound.

p.categoryID: The building category whose list changed.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of garrison buildings the player can build changes. Blizzard's architect table refreshes its building list.

p.garrisonPlotInstanceID: The plot the building was placed on.
p.newPlacement: Whether the building is newly placed on that plot.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_PLACED.s: Fires when a garrison building is placed on a plot. Blizzard's architect table reads the new building with `C_Garrison.GetOwnedBuildingInfoAbbrev`.

p.garrPlotInstanceID: The plot the building was removed from.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_REMOVED.s: Fires when a garrison building is removed from its plot. Blizzard's architect table clears the plot.

p.garrPlotInstanceID: The plot the building stands on, if it is placed.

event:GARRISON_BUILDING_UPDATE.s: Fires when a garrison building's information changes. Blizzard's architect table refreshes the building if it is the one selected.

p.isUpgraded: Whether the follower was upgraded rather than newly gained.
p.textureKit: The texture kit used to draw the alert.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_ADDED.s: Fires when the player gains a new garrison follower. Blizzard shows a follower alert, a ship alert for naval followers.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_DURABILITY_CHANG.s: Fires when a garrison follower's durability changes. Blizzard's follower list refreshes the follower on display.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_HEALED.s: Fires when a follower is healed. Blizzard's covenant mission board updates the healed follower.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) whose list changed.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's list of garrison followers changes. Blizzard's mission and follower frames refresh when the follower type matches their own.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the removed follower.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_REMOVED.s: Fires when a garrison follower is removed. Blizzard's follower list picks another follower if the one on display is gone.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_UPGRADED.s: Fires when a garrison follower is upgraded. Blizzard's follower tab plays a level-up visual if the follower is on display.

p.oldFollowerLevel: The follower's level before the change.
p.oldFollowerQuality: The follower's quality before the change.
p.oldFollowerXp: The follower's experience before the change.

event:GARRISON_FOLLOWER_XP_CHANGED.s: Fires when a garrison follower gains experience. Blizzard's mission frames refresh the party and its buffs.

event:GARRISON_HIDE_LANDING_PAGE.s: Fires when the garrison landing page should no longer be available. Blizzard hides the landing page minimap button; `GARRISON_SHOW_LANDING_PAGE` shows it again.

event:GARRISON_INVASION_AVAILABLE.s: Fires when a garrison invasion becomes available. Blizzard pulses the landing page minimap button for a Warlords garrison; `GARRISON_INVASION_UNAVAILABLE` stops it.

event:GARRISON_INVASION_UNAVAILABLE.s: Fires when a garrison invasion is no longer available. Blizzard stops the invasion pulse on the landing page minimap button.

event:GARRISON_LANDINGPAGE_SHIPMENTS.s: Fires when the shipment data for the garrison landing page is ready. Blizzard's landing page report reads the shipments again.

p.garrisonMissonBonusAbilityID: The bonus ability of the new area.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_AREA_BONUS_ADDED.s: Fires when a bonus area is added to the shipyard mission map. Blizzard's shipyard map refreshes its missions.

p.missionID: The mission whose bonus was rolled.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_BONUS_ROLL_COMPLE.s: Fires when the bonus reward roll of a completed garrison mission finishes. Blizzard's mission complete screen registers it only while it waits for the bonus chest.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_BONUS_ROLL_LOOT.s: Fires when the player receives loot from a garrison mission's bonus roll.

p.autoCombatResult: The combat log of an adventure mission, if any.
p.canComplete: Whether the mission could be completed.
p.followerDeaths: The followers who died on the mission.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_COMPLETE_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the server answers a request to complete a garrison mission. Blizzard's mission complete screens play the result.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the mission.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_FINISHED.s: Fires when a garrison mission's time runs out and it can be completed. Blizzard shows a mission alert and pulses the landing page minimap button.

p.garrFollowerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) whose missions changed.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of garrison missions changes. Blizzard's mission frames refresh their list when the follower type matches their own.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with a garrison mission table. Blizzard hides its mission frames.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the table.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_NPC_OPENED.s: Fires when the player opens a garrison mission table. Blizzard shows the mission frame for the follower type and stops the minimap mission pulse.

p.followerDbID: The mission's database ID, as Blizzard's tooltip matches it.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_REWARD_INFO.s: Fires when the reward information of a garrison mission arrives. Blizzard's floating mission tooltip shows itself again with the data.

p.garrFollowerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the mission.

event:GARRISON_MISSION_STARTED.s: Fires when a garrison mission starts. Blizzard's mission frame plays its mission-start animation.

event:GARRISON_MONUMENT_CLOSE_UI.s: Fires when the garrison monument (trophy) interface should close. Blizzard hides `GarrisonMonumentFrame`.

event:GARRISON_MONUMENT_LIST_LOADED.s: Fires when the list of trophies for a garrison monument has loaded, after `C_Trophy.MonumentLoadList`. Blizzard then calls `C_Trophy.MonumentLoadSelectedTrophyID`.

event:GARRISON_MONUMENT_REPLACED.s: Fires when the trophy shown on a garrison monument has been replaced. Blizzard reads the new selection with `C_Trophy.MonumentGetSelectedTrophyID` and redraws the frame.

event:GARRISON_MONUMENT_SELECTED_TROPHY_.s: Fires when the monument's selected trophy has loaded, after `C_Trophy.MonumentLoadSelectedTrophyID`. Blizzard reads it with `C_Trophy.MonumentGetSelectedTrophyID`.

event:GARRISON_MONUMENT_SHOW_UI.s: Fires when the player interacts with a garrison monument. Blizzard starts loading the trophy list with `C_Trophy.MonumentLoadList`; `GARRISON_MONUMENT_LIST_LOADED` follows.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the mission.

event:GARRISON_RANDOM_MISSION_ADDED.s: Fires when a random garrison mission becomes available. Blizzard shows a mission alert and adds the mission to the open mission frame.

p.recallPortalLastUsedTime: When the portal was last used.

event:GARRISON_RECALL_PORTAL_LAST_USED_T.s: Fires when the time the garrison recall portal was last used is reported.

p.success: Whether the portal was used successfully.

event:GARRISON_RECALL_PORTAL_USED.s: Fires when the garrison recall portal is used.

event:GARRISON_RECRUITMENT_FOLLOWERS_GEN.s: Fires when the garrison recruiter has generated followers to choose from. Blizzard's recruit selection frame shows the recruits.

event:GARRISON_RECRUITMENT_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with the garrison follower recruiter. Blizzard hides its recruiter frames.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) the recruiter offers.

event:GARRISON_RECRUITMENT_NPC_OPENED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with the garrison follower recruiter. Blizzard shows the recruiter frame.

event:GARRISON_RECRUITMENT_READY.s: Fires when the garrison recruiter is ready to be used. Blizzard's recruiter frame refreshes as if it had just been shown.

event:GARRISON_RECRUIT_FOLLOWER_RESULT.s: Fires after the player recruits a follower at the garrison recruiter. Blizzard hides the recruit selection frame.

event:GARRISON_SHIPMENT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when a garrison shipment is received. Blizzard's landing page requests the shipment data again with `C_Garrison.RequestLandingPageShipmentInfo`.

event:GARRISON_SHIPYARD_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with the garrison shipyard table. Blizzard hides the shipyard frame.

p.followerTypeID: The follower type (`Enum.GarrisonFollowerType`) of the shipyard.

event:GARRISON_SHIPYARD_NPC_OPENED.s: Fires when the player opens the garrison shipyard table. Blizzard shows the shipyard frame and stops the minimap pulse for naval missions.

event:GARRISON_SHOW_LANDING_PAGE.s: Fires when the garrison landing page becomes available. Blizzard updates and shows the landing page minimap button; `GARRISON_HIDE_LANDING_PAGE` hides it.

p.doAlert: Whether an alert should be shown.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_COMPLETE.s: Fires when a garrison talent finishes researching. Blizzard refreshes its talent frames and, when `doAlert` is set, shows a talent alert from `C_Garrison.GetCompleteTalent`.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_EVENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when an event affecting garrison talents updates. Blizzard's anima diversion map refreshes its data.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with a garrison talent NPC. Blizzard closes the order hall talent frame.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_NPC_OPENED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with a garrison talent NPC. Blizzard opens the order hall talent frame with the payload.

p.garrisonTalentTreeID: The talent tree the talent belongs to.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_RESEARCH_STARTED.s: Fires when the player starts researching a garrison talent. Blizzard's covenant sanctum upgrades frame reacts to the new research.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_UNLOCKS_RESULT.s: Fires when the result of a garrison talent unlock arrives. Blizzard's anima diversion map refreshes its data.

p.garrTypeID: The garrison type (`Enum.GarrisonType`) whose talents changed.

event:GARRISON_TALENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's garrison talents change. Blizzard's talent frames and landing page refresh.

event:GARRISON_TRADESKILL_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with a garrison profession NPC. Blizzard hides the professions frame.

event:GARRISON_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's garrison information changes. Blizzard's architect table refreshes its garrison info.

p.garrisonUpgradeable: Whether the garrison can be upgraded.

event:GARRISON_UPGRADEABLE_RESULT.s: Fires when the server reports whether the garrison can be upgraded. Blizzard's architect table updates its upgrade button.

event:GENERIC_ERROR.s: Fires when the game reports a generic error.

event:GENERIC_WIDGET_DISPLAY_SHOW.s: Fires when the game asks the UI to show a widget display in the middle of the screen.

event:GET_ITEM_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when item data that was not cached yet has arrived from the server, such as after `C_Item.GetItemInfo` returned nil.

p.button: The button pressed, such as `LeftButton` or `RightButton`.

event:GLOBAL_MOUSE_DOWN.s: Fires when any mouse button is pressed, wherever the cursor is. Blizzard uses it to close open menus and popups on a click outside them.

p.button: The button released, such as `LeftButton` or `RightButton`.

event:GLOBAL_MOUSE_UP.s: Fires when any mouse button is released, wherever the cursor is.

event:GLOBAL_REGION_MOUSE_DOWN.s: Fires when a mouse button is pressed over a region. Blizzard's gamepad frame controls use it to follow mouse clicks.

event:GLOBAL_REGION_MOUSE_UP.s: Fires when a mouse button is released over a region; the release that pairs with `GLOBAL_REGION_MOUSE_DOWN`.

event:GLUE_SCREENSHOT_FAILED.s: Fires when taking a screenshot fails outside the game world, such as at the login screens. Blizzard's UI shows "Screen Capture Failed" (`SCREENSHOT_FAILURE`).

event:GLUE_SCREENSHOT_STARTED.s: Fires when a screenshot starts being taken outside the game world, such as at the login screens. Blizzard's status message hides so it isn't captured.

event:GLUE_SCREENSHOT_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when a screenshot taken outside the game world, such as at the login screens, is saved. Blizzard's UI shows "Screen Captured" (`SCREENSHOT_SUCCESS`).

event:GM_PLAYER_INFO.s: Fires when information about a player is sent to a Game Master.

p.interactionIsContinuing: Whether the interaction goes on in another window, so Blizzard's custom gossip frames stay open.

event:GOSSIP_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops talking to an NPC's gossip.

event:GOSSIP_CONFIRM.s: Fires when a gossip option asks for confirmation before it is chosen, which can include a cost. Blizzard's UI shows a confirmation dialog that selects the option on accept.

event:GOSSIP_CONFIRM_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pending gossip confirmation is cancelled. Blizzard's UI hides the confirmation and code entry dialogs.

event:GOSSIP_ENTER_CODE.s: Fires when a gossip option needs the player to enter a code. Blizzard's UI shows a text entry dialog and passes the text to `C_GossipInfo.SelectOption`.

event:GOSSIP_OPTIONS_REFRESHED.s: Fires when the options of the open gossip change.

p.uiTextureKit: A texture kit naming a custom gossip frame to use, if any.

event:GOSSIP_SHOW.s: Fires when the player starts talking to an NPC that has gossip. Read the options with `C_GossipInfo`.

p.category: The group category (home or instance group).

event:GROUP_FORMED.s: Fires when the player forms a new group.

event:GROUP_INVITE_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when a group invite or request to join needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's UI shows the next pending confirmation dialog.

p.category: The group category (home or instance group).

event:GROUP_JOINED.s: Fires when the player joins a group.

p.category: The group category (home or instance group).

event:GROUP_LEFT.s: Fires when the player leaves a group.

event:GROUP_ROSTER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's group changes, such as members joining or leaving. Blizzard's party and raid frames update.

event:GUILDBANKBAGSLOTS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the contents of the guild bank tab being viewed change. Blizzard's guild bank frame redraws the tab.

event:GUILDBANKFRAME_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with the guild bank. Blizzard's UI hides the guild bank frame.

event:GUILDBANKFRAME_OPENED.s: Fires when the player opens the guild bank. Blizzard's UI shows the guild bank frame.

event:GUILDBANKLOG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild bank's item or money log has arrived. Blizzard's guild bank frame shows it.

event:GUILDBANK_ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item in the guild bank becomes locked or unlocked. Blizzard's guild bank frame redraws the tab.

event:GUILDBANK_TEXT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the info text of a guild bank tab changes. Blizzard's guild bank frame asks for the new text with `QueryGuildBankText` when that tab is shown.

event:GUILDBANK_UPDATE_MONEY.s: Fires when the amount of money in the guild bank changes.

event:GUILDBANK_UPDATE_TABS.s: Fires when the guild bank's tabs change, such as a tab bought or renamed.

event:GUILDBANK_UPDATE_TEXT.s: Fires when the info text of a guild bank tab has arrived. Blizzard's guild bank frame shows it.

event:GUILDBANK_UPDATE_WITHDRAWMONEY.s: Fires when the amount of money the player may withdraw from the guild bank changes.

event:GUILDTABARD_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's guild tabard changes. Blizzard's guild bank frame redraws its tabard.

p.currentCount: The guild's current count for this challenge.

event:GUILD_CHALLENGE_COMPLETED.s: Fires when the player's guild completes a guild challenge.

event:GUILD_CHALLENGE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the progress of the guild's challenges changes. Blizzard's guild info frame redraws its challenge list.

event:GUILD_EVENT_LOG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild event log is available after `QueryGuildEventLog`. Read the entries with `GetNumGuildEvents` and `GetGuildEventInfo`.

event:GUILD_INVITE_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pending guild invitation to the player is withdrawn or expires. Blizzard's guild invite frame hides.

p.inviter: The name of the player who sent the invitation.
p.isNewGuild: Whether the invitation is to a guild new to the player; Blizzard's frame then warns about guild reputation.
p.oldGuildName: The name of the player's previous guild, used in the reputation warning.

event:GUILD_INVITE_REQUEST.s: Fires when someone invites the player to a guild. Blizzard's guild invite frame shows the inviter, the guild and its tabard.

event:GUILD_MOTD.s: Fires when the guild message of the day is received or changed. Blizzard's chat frames print it and the guild info frame shows it.

event:GUILD_NEWS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild news list changes, such as after `QueryGuildNews` or `GuildNewsSort`. Blizzard's guild news frame redraws while shown.

p.inGuildParty: Whether the group is now a guild group.

event:GUILD_PARTY_STATE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the game decides whether the player's group counts as a guild group. Blizzard's instance difficulty indicator shows the guild group state.

p.lastPreferredDatacenterLocalityChangeDat: When the preferred region last changed.
p.lastPreferredLocaleChangeDate: When the preferred language last changed.
p.preferredDatacenterLocalityID: The guild's preferred data center region.

event:GUILD_PREFERRED_PLAY_SETTINGS_UPDA.s: Fires when the guild's preferred play settings, its preferred language and region, are updated. Blizzard's guild settings frame refreshes.

event:GUILD_RANKS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild's ranks or their permissions change. Blizzard's guild info and guild control frames update.

event:GUILD_RANKS_UPDATE_ACTIVE_PLAYER.s: Fires when the rank information for the player in their guild arrives. Blizzard's guild control frame sets itself up again on this event.

event:GUILD_RECIPE_KNOWN_BY_MEMBERS.s: Fires when the answer to `C_GuildInfo.QueryGuildMembersForRecipe` arrives. Read it with `GetGuildRecipeInfoPostQuery`.

event:GUILD_REGISTRAR_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player's interaction with a guild registrar ends.

event:GUILD_REGISTRAR_SHOW.s: Fires when the player talks to a guild registrar.

p.nameErrorToken: The global string token describing why the name was rejected, if it was.

event:GUILD_RENAME_NAME_CHECK.s: Fires when the check of a desired new name for the player's guild finishes. Blizzard's guild rename frame shows whether the name can be used.

event:GUILD_RENAME_REFUND_RESULT.s: Fires when a request to refund a guild rename has been handled.

p.flagSet: Whether the guild must now be renamed.

event:GUILD_RENAME_REQUIRED.s: Fires when the player's guild is required to change its name, or no longer is. Blizzard's communities frame switches into or out of its rename mode.

event:GUILD_RENAME_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild's rename status arrives, such as the cost, the guild's money and whether the player is guild master. Blizzard's guild rename frame opens or updates when the player is talking to the rename NPC.

event:GUILD_REWARDS_LIST.s: Fires when the list of guild rewards arrives after `RequestGuildRewards`. Blizzard's guild rewards frame redraws from `GetNumGuildRewards` and `GetGuildRewardInfo`.

event:GUILD_REWARDS_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of guild rewards changes. Blizzard's guild rewards frame redraws while shown.

p.canRequestRosterUpdate: Whether the UI may request a fresh roster with `C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster` now.

event:GUILD_ROSTER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the guild roster information changes, such as after `C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster`. Blizzard's frames request another roster update when the payload allows it.

event:GUILD_TRADESKILL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the profession information of the player's guild changes.

event:GX_RESTARTED.s: Fires when the graphics engine restarts, for example after changing the graphics API. Blizzard's graphics settings refresh their value and the character frame sets up its model again.

event:HANDLE_UI_ACTION.s: Fires when the game asks the UI to perform an action. Blizzard's map canvas handles it.

p.memberName: The text Blizzard's raid warning frame shows.

event:HARDCORE_DEATHS.s: Fires when a character's death is announced on a hardcore realm. Blizzard's raid warning frame shows the payload as a message in the hardcore death color.

event:HEARTHSTONE_BOUND.s: Fires when the player's hearthstone is bound to a new location.

p.hideUntilLearned: Whether the heirloom stays hidden until learned.
p.itemID: The heirloom that changed, if any.

event:HEIRLOOMS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's heirloom collection changes. Blizzard's heirloom journal refreshes and the micro menu alerts on a new heirloom.

p.pendingHeirloomUpgradeSpellcast: Whether an heirloom upgrade is waiting for a target.

event:HEIRLOOM_UPGRADE_TARGETING_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player starts or stops choosing an heirloom to upgrade. Blizzard's heirloom journal pages to an upgradeable heirloom.

event:HIDE_HYPERLINK_TOOLTIP.s: Fires when the game asks to hide the tooltip it showed for a hyperlink. Blizzard's UI hides it.

event:HIDE_SUBTITLE.s: Fires when the subtitle shown with `SHOW_SUBTITLE` should be hidden. Blizzard's subtitles frame hides it.

p.isHigherLevel: Whether the honor level went up.

event:HONOR_LEVEL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's honor level changes. Blizzard's player frame, micro menu and honor bar update, and a banner shows when the level went up.

event:HONOR_XP_UPDATE.s: Fires when the unit's honor progress changes. Blizzard's honor bar and PvP frames refresh.

p.decorGUID: The decor item that was added.

event:HOUSE_DECOR_ADDED_TO_CHEST.s: Fires when a decor item is added to the player's house storage chest. Blizzard's adventure tracker marks a tracked decor as collected.

event:HOUSE_EDITOR_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the house editor becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard's housing controls update.

event:HOUSE_EDITOR_MODE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the house editor switches mode, such as between placing and customizing decor. Blizzard's housing controls update.

event:HOUSE_EDITOR_MODE_CHANGE_FAILURE.s: Fires when switching the house editor's mode fails. Blizzard shows an error with the reason.

p.isDecorHidden: Whether exterior decor is hidden now.

event:HOUSE_EXTERIOR_DECOR_HIDDEN_CHANGE.s: Fires when the decor on the outside of the house is hidden or shown in the house editor.

event:HOUSE_EXTERIOR_POSITION_FAILURE.s: Fires when moving the house's exterior to a new position fails.

event:HOUSE_EXTERIOR_POSITION_SUCCESS.s: Fires when the house's exterior has been moved to a new position. Blizzard's house editor plays the placement sound.

event:HOUSE_EXTERIOR_TYPE_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when the player unlocks a new house type for their exterior. Blizzard's exterior customization refreshes its house type options.

event:HOUSE_FINDER_NEIGHBORHOOD_DATA_REC.s: Fires when the plot map of a neighborhood selected in the house finder arrives. Blizzard's house finder draws the plots on its map.

event:HOUSE_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when information about the player's house changes. Blizzard's housing controls and house editor mode buttons update.

event:HOUSE_LEVEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when a house's level changes. Blizzard's house editor refreshes its decor and room budgets.

p.houseLevelFavor: The house's favor, with the `houseGUID` it belongs to.

event:HOUSE_LEVEL_FAVOR_UPDATED.s: Fires when a house's favor (its progress toward the next house level) changes. It can fire for every owned house at once; Blizzard checks `houseGUID` against the house it shows.

event:HOUSE_PLOT_ENTERED.s: Fires when the player enters a house plot. Blizzard updates which housing controls are shown; `HOUSE_PLOT_EXITED` fires on leaving.

event:HOUSE_PLOT_EXITED.s: Fires when the player leaves a house plot. Blizzard updates which housing controls are shown.

event:HOUSE_RESERVATION_RESPONSE_RECIEVE.s: Fires when the server answers the player's request to reserve a house plot from the house finder. On success Blizzard closes the house finder.

event:HOUSE_RESET_COMPLETED.s: Fires when resetting a house completes; `HOUSE_RESET_FAILED` fires instead when it fails.

event:HOUSE_RESET_FAILED.s: Fires when resetting a house fails. Blizzard shows an error naming the reason.

p.targetType: What kind of object is hovered.

event:HOUSING_BASIC_MODE_HOVERED_TARGET_.s: Fires in the house editor's basic mode when the mouse starts or stops hovering a placed object.

p.targetType: What kind of object is placed.

event:HOUSING_BASIC_MODE_PLACEMENT_FLAGS.s: Fires in the house editor's basic mode when the placement restrictions of the moved object change.

p.isPreview: Whether the selection is a preview.
p.targetType: What kind of object is selected.

event:HOUSING_BASIC_MODE_SELECTED_TARGET.s: Fires in the house editor's basic mode when an object is selected or deselected.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINTS_AVAILABILITY_CH.s: Fires when house blueprints become available or unavailable to the player. Blizzard's housing controls update their buttons.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_COLLECTION_FAILU.s: Fires when a request for the player's house blueprint collection with `C_HousingBlueprint.RequestBlueprintCollection` fails.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_COLLECTION_RECEI.s: Fires when the player's house blueprint collection arrives after `C_HousingBlueprint.RequestBlueprintCollection`. Blizzard's blueprint collection frame fills its list.

p.blueprintShareCode: The share code of the blueprint requested.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_CONTENTS_FAILURE.s: Fires when a request for the contents of a house blueprint fails.

p.contentInfo: The blueprint's contents, with its share code and target house.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_CONTENTS_RECEIVE.s: Fires when the contents of a house blueprint arrive after `C_HousingBlueprint.RequestBlueprintContents`. Blizzard's blueprint frames show them when they match the share code and target house they asked for.

p.blueprintID: The blueprint that was not deleted.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_DELETE_FAILURE.s: Fires when deleting a house blueprint fails.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_DELETE_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a house blueprint is deleted. Blizzard's blueprint collection requests the collection again.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_EXPORT_FAILURE.s: Fires when exporting a house blueprint fails.

p.blueprintShareCode: The share code of the exported blueprint.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_EXPORT_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a house or room blueprint has been exported. Blizzard's export frame shows the share code.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_IMPORT_FAILURE.s: Fires when importing a house blueprint fails.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_IMPORT_STARTED.s: Fires when a house blueprint import begins. Blizzard's import frame shows its loading visuals, even for imports started elsewhere such as a room import.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_IMPORT_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a house blueprint import finishes successfully. Blizzard's blueprint collection requests the collection again.

p.blueprintID: The blueprint that was not renamed.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_RENAME_FAILURE.s: Fires when renaming a house blueprint fails.

event:HOUSING_BLUEPRINT_RENAME_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a house blueprint is renamed. Blizzard's housing dashboard shows the new name.

event:HOUSING_CATALOG_CATEGORY_UPDATED.s: Fires when a housing catalog category changes. Blizzard's catalog category list updates that category.

event:HOUSING_CATALOG_SUBCATEGORY_UPDATE.s: Fires when a housing catalog subcategory changes. Blizzard's catalog category list updates that subcategory.

p.hasHoveredTarget: Whether something is under the cursor.

event:HOUSING_CLEANUP_MODE_HOVERED_TARGE.s: Fires when the target under the cursor changes in the house editor's cleanup mode. Blizzard plays a hover sound and highlights the decor or house exterior.

event:HOUSING_CLEANUP_MODE_TARGET_SELECT.s: Fires when a target is selected in the house editor's cleanup mode. Blizzard removes the selected decor with `C_HousingDecor.RemoveSelectedDecor`.

p.coreFixtureType: The kind of core fixture that changed.

event:HOUSING_CORE_FIXTURE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a core fixture of the house exterior, such as its roof or door, changes. Blizzard's exterior customization refreshes its options.

p.hasHoveredTarget: Whether something is under the cursor now.
p.targetType: What kind of target it is, such as decor or a room component.

event:HOUSING_CUSTOMIZE_MODE_HOVERED_TAR.s: Fires when the cursor moves onto or off something that can be customized in the house editor's customize mode. Blizzard shows a tooltip for it.

p.targetType: What kind of target it is, such as decor or a room component.

event:HOUSING_CUSTOMIZE_MODE_SELECTED_TA.s: Fires when the selection changes in the house editor's customize mode.

p.previewItemData: The decor item that was added.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_ADD_TO_PREVIEW_LIST.s: Fires when a decor item is added to the housing market preview list. Blizzard's market cart adds the item, or links it to the cart entry being placed.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_CUSTOMIZATION_CHANGE.s: Fires when the customization of a placed decor item, such as its dyes, changes. Blizzard's customize pane refreshes if that decor is selected.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_DYE_FAILURE.s: Fires when dyeing a decor item fails. Blizzard shows an error about missing dye.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_FREE_PLACE_STATUS_CH.s: Fires when free placement of decor is turned on or off in the house editor.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_GRID_SNAP_OCCURRED.s: Fires when moved decor snaps to the grid in the house editor. Blizzard's editor plays a sound.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_GRID_SNAP_STATUS_CHA.s: Fires when grid snapping of decor is turned on or off in the house editor.

p.isGridVisible: Whether the grid is now shown.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_GRID_VISIBILITY_STAT.s: Fires when the placement grid of the house editor is shown or hidden.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PLACE_FAILURE.s: Fires when placing a decor item fails. Blizzard's house editor shows the matching error message.

p.isNew: True if the decor was newly placed from storage, false if it was already placed and only moved.
p.isPreview: Whether the placement is a preview.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PLACE_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a decor item has been placed or moved in the house. Blizzard's house editor plays a sound for the item's size and adds new items to its placed decor list.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PRECISION_MANIPULATI.s: Fires when the player uses the move or rotate handles on a decor item in the house editor's expert mode.

p.isManipulatingSelection: Whether the player is now dragging the selection.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PRECISION_MANIPULATI.s: Fires when the player starts or stops dragging a decor item's handles in the house editor's expert mode.

p.activeSubmode: The now active submode, or nil.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PRECISION_SUBMODE_CH.s: Fires when the house editor's expert mode switches to another precision submode.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PREVIEW_LIST_REMOVE_.s: Fires when previewed decor is removed from the world. Blizzard's market cart unlinks it from its cart entry and may remove the entry.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PREVIEW_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the housing market's decor preview list changes.

p.isPreviewState: Whether the editor is now previewing decor.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_PREVIEW_STATE_CHANGE.s: Fires when the house editor enters or leaves decor preview. Blizzard's editor mode buttons update.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_REMOVED.s: Fires when a placed decor item is removed from the house. Blizzard's house editor plays the erase sound and removes it from its placed decor list.

p.result: The result (`Enum.HousingResult`); `Success` when the decor was selected.

event:HOUSING_DECOR_SELECT_RESPONSE.s: Fires when selecting a decor item in the house editor has been handled. On failure Blizzard's editor shows an error.

p.hasHoveredTarget: Whether a target is now under the cursor.
p.targetType: The kind of target, such as decor.

event:HOUSING_EXPERT_MODE_HOVERED_TARGET.s: Fires when the cursor moves onto or off a target in the house editor's expert mode.

p.activeFlags: The placement restrictions now in effect.
p.targetType: The kind of target, such as decor.

event:HOUSING_EXPERT_MODE_PLACEMENT_FLAG.s: Fires when the placement restrictions on the target in the house editor's expert mode change.

p.hasSelectedTarget: Whether a target is now selected.
p.targetType: The kind of target, such as decor.

event:HOUSING_EXPERT_MODE_SELECTED_TARGE.s: Fires when the selected target changes in the house editor's expert mode.

p.anyHovered: Whether any fixture is under the cursor now.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_HOVER_CHANGED.s: Fires when the cursor moves onto or off a fixture in exterior customization mode.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_POINT_FRAMES_RELEA.s: Fires when all fixture point frames of the house exterior are released. Blizzard's exterior customization removes its point markers.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_POINT_FRAME_ADDED.s: Fires when a fixture point frame is added in exterior customization mode. Blizzard attaches a point marker to it.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_POINT_FRAME_RELEAS.s: Fires when a fixture point frame is released in exterior customization mode. Blizzard removes its point marker.

p.hasSelection: Whether a fixture point is selected now.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_POINT_SELECTION_CH.s: Fires when the selected fixture point changes in exterior customization mode.

event:HOUSING_FIXTURE_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when the player unlocks a new house fixture. Blizzard's exterior customization refreshes its fixture options.

event:HOUSING_INSPECT_MODE_DECOR_HOVERED.s: Fires when the decor item under the cursor changes in housing inspect mode. Blizzard's inspect mode frame updates while inspect mode is active.

event:HOUSING_INSPECT_MODE_STATE_UPDATED.s: Fires when housing inspect mode turns on or off. Blizzard's inspect mode frame updates.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_OCCUPIED_FLOOR_RANG.s: Fires in the house editor's layout mode when the range of floors that have rooms changes. Blizzard's editor plays a sound when a floor is added.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_PIN_FRAMES_RELEASED.s: Fires when all pin frames of the house editor's layout mode are released.

p.pinFrame: The pin frame that was added.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_PIN_FRAME_ADDED.s: Fires when the house editor's layout mode adds a pin frame.

p.pinFrame: The pin frame that was released.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_PIN_FRAME_RELEASED.s: Fires when the house editor's layout mode releases a pin frame.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_ROOM_COMPONENT_THEM.s: Fires when the theme set of a room component changes in the house editor.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_ROOM_MOVE_INVALID.s: Fires when a room cannot be moved where the player tried in the house editor. Blizzard's editor plays an invalid placement sound.

event:HOUSING_LAYOUT_VIEWED_FLOOR_CHANGE.s: Fires when the floor viewed in the house editor's layout mode changes.

event:HOUSING_MARKET_AVAILABILITY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the availability of the housing market changes. Blizzard's house editor storage frame updates which tabs it shows.

event:HOUSING_NEW_DECOR_PLACE_COMPLETE.s: Fires when placing a new decor item in the house is complete. Blizzard's housing tutorials watch for it.

event:HOUSING_NUM_DECOR_PLACED_CHANGED.s: Fires when the number of decor items placed in the house changes. Blizzard's house editor updates its decor budget count (`C_HousingDecor.GetSpentPlacementBudget`) and catalog entries.

event:HOUSING_REFUND_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of refundable housing market purchases changes. Blizzard's house editor storage frame requests the refund info again with `C_HousingCatalog.RequestHousingMarketRefundInfo` if it asked for it before.

event:HOUSING_ROOM_COMPONENT_CUSTOMIZATI.s: Fires when the customization of a room component, such as a wall or floor, changes. Blizzard's customize pane refreshes if that component is selected.
Fires when changing the customization of a room component fails. Blizzard shows the error.

event:HOUSING_SERVICES_AVAILABILITY_UPDA.s: Fires when the availability of housing services changes. Blizzard updates the housing micro menu button.

event:HOUSING_SET_EXTERIOR_HOUSE_SIZE_RE.s: Fires when the server answers a request to change the size of the house. Blizzard refreshes the options on success or shows the error.

event:HOUSING_SET_EXTERIOR_HOUSE_TYPE_RE.s: Fires when the server answers a request to change the house type. Blizzard refreshes the options on success or shows the error.

event:HOUSING_SET_FIXTURE_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the server answers a request to set a house fixture. Blizzard shows the error if it failed.

event:HOUSING_STORAGE_ENTRY_UPDATED.s: Fires when one entry in the player's housing decor storage changes. Blizzard's storage frame and market cart update that entry.

event:HOUSING_STORAGE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's housing decor storage changes. Blizzard's storage frame runs its search again and the category list refilters.

event:IGNORELIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's ignore list changes. Blizzard's ignore list updates.

event:IGNORE_NEIGHBORHOOD_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the server answers the player's request to ignore a neighborhood. On success Blizzard's house finder removes it from its list.

event:INCOMING_RESURRECT_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit starts or stops having a resurrection cast on it. Blizzard's raid frames update the resurrect icon.

p.unitTarget: The unit with the pending summon.

event:INCOMING_SUMMON_CHANGED.s: Fires when a group member's pending summon changes. Blizzard's party and raid frames update the summon icon.

event:INITIAL_CLUBS_LOADED.s: Fires when the player's clubs have finished their initial load. Blizzard's guild micro button updates its invitation notice from `C_Club.GetInvitationsForSelf`.

event:INITIAL_HOTFIXES_APPLIED.s: Fires when the first hotfixes from the server have been applied. Blizzard's character select screen updates its expansion logo.

event:INITIATIVE_ACTIVITY_LOG_UPDATED.s: Fires when the activity log of a neighborhood initiative changes. Blizzard's housing dashboard refreshes the log.

event:INITIATIVE_COMPLETED.s: Fires when a neighborhood initiative is completed. Blizzard shows a banner with its title.

p.added: Whether it was added rather than removed.

event:INITIATIVE_TASKS_TRACKED_LIST_CHAN.s: Fires when an initiative task is added to or removed from the player's tracked tasks. Blizzard's initiative tracker redraws.

event:INITIATIVE_TASKS_TRACKED_UPDATED.s: Fires when the progress of the player's tracked initiative tasks changes. Blizzard's initiative tracker and housing dashboard refresh.

event:INITIATIVE_TASK_COMPLETED.s: Fires when the player completes a neighborhood initiative task. Blizzard shows a task complete alert.

event:INPUT_DEVICE_INTERFACE_TRANSITION.s: Fires when the UI switches between input device interfaces, such as mouse and keyboard and game pad. Blizzard's code runs the callbacks registered for interface transitions.

p.guid: The GUID of the compared unit.

event:INSPECT_ACHIEVEMENT_READY.s: Fires when the achievement data of a unit requested for comparison has arrived. Blizzard's achievement comparison frame shows it, with `GetComparisonAchievementPoints` for the points.

event:INSPECT_HONOR_UPDATE.s: Fires when the honor information of the inspected player is available. Blizzard's inspect PvP frame refreshes.

p.inspecteeGUID: The GUID of the inspected unit.

event:INSPECT_READY.s: Fires when the data requested with `NotifyInspect` has arrived and the inspect functions can read it. Blizzard's inspect frames and talent inspector update on it.

event:INSTANCE_ABANDON_VOTE_FINISHED.s: Fires when a group vote to abandon the instance ends. Blizzard's UI hides the vote dialog.

event:INSTANCE_ABANDON_VOTE_STARTED.s: Fires when a group vote to abandon the instance starts. Blizzard's UI shows the vote dialog with a sound.

event:INSTANCE_ABANDON_VOTE_UPDATED.s: Fires when a vote is cast in a group vote to abandon the instance. Blizzard's UI refreshes the vote dialog.

event:INSTANCE_BOOT_START.s: Fires when the player is in an instance whose group they are not in and will be teleported out. Blizzard's UI shows a countdown dialog.

event:INSTANCE_BOOT_STOP.s: Fires when a pending teleport out of an instance is cancelled, such as by joining its group. Blizzard's UI hides the countdown dialog.

event:INSTANCE_ENCOUNTER_ENGAGE_UNIT.s: Fires when the units of an encounter, the `boss1` to `boss5` unit tokens, change. Blizzard's boss frames update.

event:INSTANCE_ENCOUNTER_OBJECTIVE_COMPL.s: Fires when an objective of the current instance encounter is completed.

event:INSTANCE_ENCOUNTER_OBJECTIVE_START.s: Fires when an objective of the current instance encounter starts.

event:INSTANCE_ENCOUNTER_OBJECTIVE_UPDAT.s: Fires when the progress of an objective of the current instance encounter changes.

event:INSTANCE_GROUP_SIZE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the size of the player's instance group changes. Blizzard's instance difficulty indicator updates.

p.isLeaver: Whether the player is now flagged.

event:INSTANCE_LEAVER_STATUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player is flagged or unflagged as a deserter for leaving an instance. Blizzard's UI warns when the player is flagged.

event:INSTANCE_LOCK_START.s: Fires when the player is about to be saved to the instance they are in. Blizzard's UI shows the instance lock dialog.

event:INSTANCE_LOCK_STOP.s: Fires when the pending instance lock no longer applies. Blizzard's UI hides the instance lock dialog.

event:INSTANCE_LOCK_WARNING.s: Fires to warn the player that they will be saved to the instance. Blizzard's UI shows the instance lock dialog in its warning form.

p.warningMessage: A format string for the warning, with a placeholder for the time left.

event:INSTANCE_RESET_WARNING.s: Fires to warn that the current instance will reset soon. Blizzard's UI prints the warning in chat.

event:INVENTORY_SEARCH_UPDATE.s: Fires when the results of a bag or bank item search change. Blizzard's bag and bank frames dim the items that do not match.

p.questSessionActive: Whether the player is in an active quest session (Party Sync).
p.targetName: The name of the player being invited.
p.willConvertToRaid: Whether the invite would turn the party into a raid.

event:INVITE_TO_PARTY_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when inviting a player needs confirming. Blizzard's UI confirms with `C_PartyInfo.ConfirmInviteUnit`, or first asks when the invite would turn the party into a raid or a quest session is active.

p.questSessionActive: Whether the player is in an active quest session (Party Sync).
p.targetName: The name of the friend being invited.
p.willConvertToRaid: Whether the invite would turn the party into a raid.

event:INVITE_TRAVEL_PASS_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when inviting a Battle.net friend needs confirming. Blizzard's UI confirms with `C_PartyInfo.ConfirmInviteTravelPass`, after a warning dialog when a quest session is active.

event:ISLANDS_QUEUE_CLOSE.s: Fires when the Island Expeditions queue window should close.

event:ISLANDS_QUEUE_OPEN.s: Fires when the Island Expeditions queue window should open.

p.gainedBy: GUID of the unit that collected it.
p.gainedFrom: GUID of what it was collected from.

event:ISLAND_AZERITE_GAIN.s: Fires when Azerite is collected during an Island Expedition. Blizzard shows a toast for the player's team.

event:ISLAND_COMPLETED.s: Fires when an Island Expedition the player is in ends. Blizzard's UI shows the island party pose screen.

p.newHyperlink: The item's link after the change.
p.previousHyperlink: The item's link before the change.

event:ITEM_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item changes into a different version of itself, such as after an upgrade.

p.itemGUID: The GUID of the item the data is for.

event:ITEM_CONVERSION_DATA_READY.s: Fires when the data for converting an item in the item interaction frame is ready.

event:ITEM_COUNT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the number of an item the player owns changes.

event:ITEM_DATA_LOAD_RESULT.s: Fires when item data requested with `C_Item.RequestLoadItemDataByID` has loaded or failed to load.

event:ITEM_INTERACTION_CHARGE_INFO_UPDAT.s: Fires when the charges of the item interaction frame change. Blizzard's item interaction frame updates its cost.

p.itemLocation: Where the item is, or nil.

event:ITEM_INTERACTION_ITEM_SELECTION_UP.s: Fires when the item chosen in the item interaction frame changes. Blizzard's item interaction frame sets or clears the item.

event:ITEM_KEY_ITEM_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when item info for an item key arrives after `C_AuctionHouse.GetItemKeyInfo` returned `nil`. Blizzard's table cells wait for it and then draw the item's name.

p.bagOrSlotIndex: The bag the item is in, or the equipment slot when `slotIndex` is nil.
p.slotIndex: The slot within the bag, or nil for an equipped item.

event:ITEM_LOCKED.s: Fires when an item in the player's bags or equipment becomes locked, such as when it is picked up or being moved.

p.bagOrSlotIndex: The bag the item is in, or the equipment slot when `slotIndex` is nil.
p.slotIndex: The slot within the bag, or nil for an equipped item.

event:ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item in the player's bags or equipment becomes locked or unlocked. Blizzard's item buttons update their locked look.

event:ITEM_PURCHASED.s: Fires when the player buys an item from the auction house.

p.bagSlot: The bag that received the item.

event:ITEM_PUSH.s: Fires when an item is put into one of the player's bags. Blizzard's bag buttons play a fly-in animation of the item's icon on the matching bag.

event:ITEM_SEARCH_RESULTS_ADDED.s: Fires when more results arrive for an item search. Blizzard's item lists redraw.

p.newAuctionID: The auction that was added, if any.

event:ITEM_SEARCH_RESULTS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the results of an item search change. Blizzard's item lists redraw and the sell frame updates its price suggestion.

event:ITEM_TEXT_BEGIN.s: Fires when the player starts reading an item or object with text, such as a book or plaque. Blizzard sets the item text frame's title with `ItemTextGetItem`; `ITEM_TEXT_READY` follows with the text.

event:ITEM_TEXT_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops reading item text. Blizzard hides the item text frame.

event:ITEM_TEXT_READY.s: Fires when the text of the item being read is ready. Blizzard's item text frame shows the page with its material from `ItemTextGetMaterial`.

event:ITEM_TEXT_TRANSLATION.s: Fires when the item text must be translated before it can be read. Blizzard's item text frame shows a progress bar for the delay.

p.bagOrSlotIndex: The bag the item is in, or the equipment slot when `slotIndex` is nil.
p.slotIndex: The slot within the bag, or nil for an equipped item.

event:ITEM_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when an item in the player's bags or equipment is no longer locked.

event:ITEM_UPGRADE_FAILED.s: Fires when an item upgrade fails. Blizzard's item upgrade frame updates.

event:ITEM_UPGRADE_MASTER_SET_ITEM.s: Fires when the item in the item upgrade frame changes. Blizzard's item upgrade frame updates and closes any confirmation dialog.

event:ITEM_UPGRADE_MASTER_UPDATE.s: Fires when an item has been upgraded at the item upgrade frame.

event:JAILERS_TOWER_LEVEL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the level of a Torghast run changes.

event:KNOWN_TITLES_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player gains or loses a title. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its title list.

event:LANGUAGE_LIST_CHANGED.s: Fires when the list of languages the player can speak changes. Blizzard's chat menu button rebuilds its language menu.

p.isGuildPerkSpell: Whether the spell is a guild perk.
p.skillLineIndex: The spellbook skill line the spell was added to.

event:LEARNED_SPELL_IN_SKILL_LINE.s: Fires when the player learns a spell, naming the spellbook skill line it was added to. Blizzard's spellbook and tutorials react to it.

event:LEAVE_PARTY_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when leaving the group needs confirming, such as during a quest session or a Mythic+ run. Blizzard's UI shows a warning dialog for those reasons.

event:LEAVING_TUTORIAL_AREA.s: Fires when the player leaves the tutorial area of the new player experience. Blizzard's UI shows a popup that offers to end the tutorial.

event:LEGACY_FRIEND_SYSTEM_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the legacy (character) friend system is turned on or off. Blizzard's friends frame resets its selection.

p.isLegacyLootModeEnabled: Whether legacy loot rules now apply.

event:LEGACY_LOOT_RULES_CHANGED.s: Fires when legacy loot rules for old content are turned on or off.

event:LET_RECENT_ALLIES_SEE_LOCATION_SET.s: Fires when the setting that lets recent allies see the player's location changes. Blizzard's social settings read it again with `GetAllowRecentAlliesSeeLocation`.

event:LFG_BOOT_PROPOSAL_UPDATE.s: Fires when a vote to remove a player from a group finder group starts, changes or ends. Blizzard's dungeon finder shows the vote popup from `GetLFGBootProposal` if the player has not voted yet.

event:LFG_COMPLETION_REWARD.s: Fires when the player completes a group finder dungeon or scenario and receives its reward. Blizzard's alert frames show the dungeon or scenario completion alert.

event:LFG_COOLDOWNS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the group finder cooldowns of the player or their group change, such as the deserter debuff. Blizzard's dungeon and raid finder frames update their cooldown covers.

event:LFG_ENABLED_STATE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the group finder is enabled or disabled. Blizzard's UI shows or hides the group finder according to `C_LFGInfo.IsGroupFinderEnabled`.

p.automaticDelistTimeRemaining: Time left before the listing is removed.

event:LFG_GROUP_DELISTED_LEADERSHIP_CHAN.s: Fires when group leadership changes while the group has a Group Finder listing that will be delisted. Blizzard shows a warning with the listing's name and the time left.

p.subReason1: Extra detail for the error message.
p.subReason2: Extra detail for the error message.

event:LFG_INVALID_ERROR_MESSAGE.s: Fires when a group finder action fails. Blizzard's UI prints the matching error in chat, built with `GetLFGInstanceErrorString`.

p.created: Whether a new listing was just created.

event:LFG_LIST_ACTIVE_ENTRY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's group's Group Finder listing is created, changed or removed. Blizzard's group finder redraws the listing panel.

p.newPendingEntry: Whether a new applicant is waiting.
p.newPendingEntryWithData: Whether a new applicant is waiting and their details have arrived.

event:LFG_LIST_APPLICANT_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of players applying to the group's Group Finder listing changes. Blizzard makes the queue button glow for new applicants.

p.applicantID: ID of the applicant that changed.

event:LFG_LIST_APPLICANT_UPDATED.s: Fires when an applicant to the group's Group Finder listing changes, such as being invited or declined.

p.groupName: The group's name, for showing in chat.
p.newStatus: The new status, such as `declined` or `timedout`.
p.searchResultID: The search result the application was for.

event:LFG_LIST_APPLICATION_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the status of one of the player's Group Finder applications changes, such as being declined or timing out. Blizzard posts a chat message and refreshes the search results.

event:LFG_LIST_AVAILABILITY_UPDATE.s: Fires when what the player can list or search for in the Group Finder changes. Blizzard's group finder checks which panels are valid.

event:LFG_LIST_CENSORED_ACTIVE_ENTRY_UPD.s: Fires when the group's Group Finder listing is updated after a censor check. Blizzard shows a warning if the listing was censored.

event:LFG_LIST_ENTRY_CREATION_FAILED.s: Fires when creating a Group Finder listing fails. Blizzard hides the busy cover on the listing panel.

event:LFG_LIST_ENTRY_EXPIRED_TIMEOUT.s: Fires when the group's Group Finder listing is removed because it timed out. Blizzard tells the group leader in a dialog.

event:LFG_LIST_ENTRY_EXPIRED_TOO_MANY_PL.s: Fires when the group's Group Finder listing is removed because the group has too many players for the activity. Blizzard tells the group leader in a dialog.

p.searchResultID: The search result of the group joined.

event:LFG_LIST_JOINED_GROUP.s: Fires when the player joins a group through the Group Finder. Blizzard shows a dialog naming the group.

event:LFG_LIST_REVEALED_CENSORED_ACTIVE_.s: Fires when the censored text of the group's Group Finder listing is revealed.

event:LFG_LIST_ROLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the roles the player chose for group finder listings change.

p.reason: Why the search failed, if known.

event:LFG_LIST_SEARCH_FAILED.s: Fires when a Group Finder search fails. Blizzard's search panel shows that the search failed.

event:LFG_LIST_SEARCH_RESULTS_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the results of a Group Finder search arrive. Read them with `C_LFGList.GetSearchResults`.

event:LFG_LIST_SEARCH_RESULT_UPDATED.s: Fires when one Group Finder search result changes.

p.showAllLevelRanges: Whether to show activities outside the player's suggested level range.

event:LFG_LIST_SHOW_SEARCH.s: Fires when the game asks the Group Finder to show a search for certain activities. Blizzard's group browser opens a search for them.

event:LFG_LIST_UPDATE_SEARCH_RESULTS.s: Fires when the Group Finder search results need to be redrawn. Blizzard's search panel rebuilds its list.

event:LFG_LOCK_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the list of group finder dungeons the player is locked out of arrives. Blizzard's group finder reads it with `GetLFGLockList` and redraws.

p.name: The name of the dungeon offered.
p.typeID: The kind of group finder entry.

event:LFG_OFFER_CONTINUE.s: Fires when the player's group finder group can continue to the next part of a dungeon or raid. Blizzard's UI asks whether to continue, waiting until the player leaves combat.

p.dungeonID: The group finder dungeon to show.

event:LFG_OPEN_FROM_GOSSIP.s: Fires when an NPC conversation opens the dungeon finder for a dungeon. Blizzard's dungeon finder opens with that dungeon selected.

event:LFG_PROPOSAL_DONE.s: Fires when a group finder group proposal is finished. Blizzard's dungeon ready popup hides.

event:LFG_PROPOSAL_FAILED.s: Fires when a group finder group proposal fails. Blizzard's dungeon ready popup shows the failure and the queue status eye goes back to searching.

event:LFG_PROPOSAL_SHOW.s: Fires when the group finder has found a group and asks the player to accept it. Blizzard's dungeon ready popup shows.

event:LFG_PROPOSAL_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when everyone has accepted a group finder group proposal. Blizzard's dungeon ready popup hides.

event:LFG_PROPOSAL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the state of a group finder group proposal changes, such as when a member accepts. Blizzard's dungeon ready popup updates.

event:LFG_QUEUE_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the status of the player's group finder queue changes. Blizzard's queue status frame updates.

p.name: The name of the member who declined.

event:LFG_READY_CHECK_DECLINED.s: Fires when a group member declines a group finder ready check. Blizzard's PvP match results frame enables its requeue button again.

event:LFG_READY_CHECK_HIDE.s: Fires when a group finder ready check ends. Blizzard's ready check popup hides.

p.name: The name of the member who is ready.

event:LFG_READY_CHECK_PLAYER_IS_READY.s: Fires when a group member confirms a group finder ready check. Blizzard's UI prints a message in chat.

p.isRequeue: Whether the check is for queueing again.

event:LFG_READY_CHECK_SHOW.s: Fires when the group leader starts a group finder ready check before queueing. Blizzard's ready check popup shows, using `GetLFGReadyCheckUpdate`.

event:LFG_READY_CHECK_UPDATE.s: Fires when the state of a group finder ready check changes. Blizzard's queue status frame updates.

event:LFG_ROLE_CHECK_DECLINED.s: Fires when a group member declines a group finder role check. Blizzard's PvP match results frame enables its requeue button again.

event:LFG_ROLE_CHECK_HIDE.s: Fires when a group finder role check ends. Blizzard's role check popup hides and the dungeon list updates.

event:LFG_ROLE_CHECK_ROLE_CHOSEN.s: Fires when a group member picks their roles in a group finder role check. Blizzard's UI prints the chosen roles in chat.

p.isRequeue: Whether the check is for queueing again.

event:LFG_ROLE_CHECK_SHOW.s: Fires when the group leader queues the group and each member must confirm their roles. Blizzard's role check popup shows.

event:LFG_ROLE_CHECK_UPDATE.s: Fires when the state of a group finder role check changes. Blizzard's queue status frame and group finder search results update.

event:LFG_ROLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the roles the player has selected for the group finder change. Blizzard's group finder updates its role checkboxes.

event:LFG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's group finder status changes, such as joining or leaving a queue. Blizzard's group finder updates its role checkboxes and queued list.

event:LFG_UPDATE_RANDOM_INFO.s: Fires when the information about random dungeons, raids and scenarios the player can queue for changes. Blizzard's finder frames update their selection and rewards.

event:LIFESTEAL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's leech changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

event:LOADING_SCREEN_DISABLED.s: Fires when the loading screen goes away.

event:LOADING_SCREEN_ENABLED.s: Fires when a loading screen appears.

event:LOBBY_MATCHMAKER_QUEUE_ABANDONED.s: Fires when the Plunderstorm queue is left. Blizzard's queue popup hides and the queue button updates.

event:LOBBY_MATCHMAKER_QUEUE_ERROR.s: Fires when the Plunderstorm queue reports an error.

event:LOBBY_MATCHMAKER_QUEUE_EXPIRED.s: Fires when a Plunderstorm queue invitation expires. Blizzard's queue popup hides.

event:LOBBY_MATCHMAKER_QUEUE_POPPED.s: Fires when a Plunderstorm match is found. Blizzard's UI shows the queue popup and plays the queue eye's found animation.

event:LOBBY_MATCHMAKER_QUEUE_STATUS_UPDA.s: Fires when the status of the Plunderstorm queue changes. Blizzard's Plunderstorm queue button updates.

event:LOCALPLAYER_PET_RENAMED.s: Fires when the player's pet is renamed.

event:LOGOUT_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pending logout or quit is cancelled. Blizzard hides the logout and quit countdown dialogs.

p.lootSlot: The loot slot of the item.

event:LOOT_BIND_CONFIRM.s: Fires when the player loots an item that binds when picked up and the game asks for confirmation. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying looting it will bind it, and accepting calls `ConfirmLootSlot(lootSlot)`.

event:LOOT_CLOSED.s: Fires when the loot window closes. Blizzard's loot frame hides.

event:LOOT_HISTORY_CLEAR_HISTORY.s: Fires when the group loot history is cleared. Blizzard's loot history frame resets.

event:LOOT_HISTORY_GO_TO_ENCOUNTER.s: Fires when the loot history should show an encounter. Blizzard's loot history frame opens to it.

p.encounterID: The encounter the item dropped in.
p.lootListKey: The drop in that encounter's loot list.

event:LOOT_HISTORY_ONE_HUNDRED_ROLL.s: Fires when someone rolls 100 on an item in the loot history. Blizzard's loot history plays its perfect roll animation.

p.encounterID: The encounter the item dropped in.
p.lootListKey: The drop in that encounter's loot list; read it with `C_LootHistory.GetSortedInfoForDrop`.

event:LOOT_HISTORY_UPDATE_DROP.s: Fires when the rolls or winner of one drop in the loot history change.

event:LOOT_HISTORY_UPDATE_ENCOUNTER.s: Fires when the loot history of an encounter changes.

p.lootHandle: The loot the item belongs to.

event:LOOT_ITEM_AVAILABLE.s: Fires when an item becomes available to loot.
