event:LOOT_ITEM_ROLL_WON.s: Fires when the player wins a group loot roll. Blizzard's UI shows a loot toast with the roll.

event:LOOT_JOURNAL_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when the items of the loot journal change. Blizzard's loot journal refreshes.

p.autoLoot: Whether the loot is being taken automatically.
p.isFromItem: Whether the loot comes from opening an item, such as a container.

event:LOOT_OPENED.s: Fires when the loot window opens. Blizzard's loot frame shows the loot and plays a sound; if the frame can't be shown it calls `CloseLoot`.

p.autoloot: Whether the loot is being taken automatically.

event:LOOT_READY.s: Fires when loot is ready to be read with the loot functions, as the player starts looting. Blizzard's classic loot frame builds its auto-loot list on it.

p.lootHandle: The loot the rolls were for.

event:LOOT_ROLLS_COMPLETE.s: Fires when all group loot rolls for a loot source have finished.

event:LOOT_SLOT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the contents of a loot slot change while the loot window is open. Blizzard's loot frame redraws that slot.

event:LOOT_SLOT_CLEARED.s: Fires when a loot slot is emptied, for example after its item was taken. Blizzard's loot frame hides that slot's button.

p.campaignID: The campaign the entries belong to.

event:LORE_TEXT_UPDATED_CAMPAIGN.s: Fires when the lore entries of a campaign are available or change. Blizzard's campaign frames show them when the campaign matches.

p.effectIndex: The index of the new effect.

event:LOSS_OF_CONTROL_ADDED.s: Fires when a unit loses control, for example from a stun or silence. Blizzard's loss of control alert reads the effect with `C_LossOfControl.GetActiveLossOfControlData`, and action buttons, nameplates and arena frames update.

p.effectIndex: The index of the new effect.
p.victim: The GUID of the player who lost control.

event:LOSS_OF_CONTROL_COMMENTATOR_ADDED.s: Fires for a spectator in commentator mode when a watched player loses control. Blizzard's commentator frames show the effect.

event:LOSS_OF_CONTROL_COMMENTATOR_UPDATE.s: Fires for a spectator in commentator mode when a watched player's loss of control effects change. Blizzard's commentator frames show the active effect.

event:LOSS_OF_CONTROL_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's loss of control effects change. Blizzard's loss of control alert, action buttons, nameplates and arena frames update.

event:LUA_WARNING.s: Fires when the game reports a Lua warning. Blizzard's script errors frame shows it as a warning.

p.function: The name of the function that was blocked.

event:MACRO_ACTION_BLOCKED.s: Fires when a macro tried an action that is protected right now, usually during combat. Blizzard's UI prints a notice that an action was blocked.

p.function: The name of the function that was blocked.

event:MACRO_ACTION_FORBIDDEN.s: Fires when a macro script tried an action only the Blizzard UI may perform. Blizzard's UI shows a dialog about it.

event:MAIL_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops using a mailbox.

event:MAIL_FAILED.s: Fires when a mail action fails, such as sending a letter or taking an attachment. Blizzard enables the send button again.

event:MAIL_INBOX_UPDATE.s: Fires when the contents of the player's inbox change. Blizzard's inbox and open mail frames redraw; `GetInboxNumItems` gives the new count.

p.attachSlot: The attachment slot of the item.

event:MAIL_LOCK_SEND_ITEMS.s: Fires when sending an attached item would make it no longer refundable and needs confirmation. Blizzard locks the send frame and shows a confirmation dialog.

event:MAIL_OPEN_ALL_CANCELED.s: Fires when opening all mail is cancelled. Blizzard's open all button stops opening mail.

event:MAIL_SEND_INFO_UPDATE.s: Fires when the letter being written changes, such as its attachments. Blizzard's send mail frame redraws.

event:MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a letter has been sent. Blizzard clears the send mail frame.

event:MAIL_SHOW.s: Fires when the player opens a mailbox; `MAIL_CLOSED` fires when it closes.

event:MAIL_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a mail action succeeds. Blizzard enables the send button again and fetches more mail if there is another page.

event:MAIL_UNLOCK_SEND_ITEMS.s: Fires when the send frame locked by `MAIL_LOCK_SEND_ITEMS` can be used again. Blizzard unlocks it and hides the confirmation dialog.

p.isWinning: Whether this roll is currently winning.

event:MAIN_SPEC_NEED_ROLL.s: Fires when a main spec need roll on a group loot item is made. Blizzard's group loot frame plays its need animation for that roll.

event:MAJOR_FACTION_INTERACTION_ENDED.s: Fires when the player's interaction with a major faction ends.

event:MAJOR_FACTION_INTERACTION_STARTED.s: Fires when the player starts an interaction with a major faction.

event:MAJOR_FACTION_RENOWN_LEVEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's renown with a major faction changes level. Blizzard's UI shows a renown toast unless the faction hides it, and the reputation frames update.

event:MAJOR_FACTION_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when a major faction becomes available to the player. Blizzard's reputation and landing frames update.

event:MAP_EXPLORATION_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player explores a new part of the map. Blizzard's map redraws its explored overlays.

event:MASTERY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's mastery changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

event:MAX_EXPANSION_LEVEL_UPDATED.s: Fires when the highest expansion the account can play changes. Blizzard's character select screen updates its logo and upgrade panel.

p.clampedNewQueueWindowMs: The new spell queue window, in milliseconds, after clamping.

event:MAX_SPELL_START_RECOVERY_OFFSET_CH.s: Fires when the spell queue window, the time before a cast ends in which the next spell can be queued, changes.

event:MENTORSHIP_STATUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's mentorship status in the newcomer program changes. Blizzard's channel frame updates the newcomer chat channel.

event:MERCHANT_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops talking to a merchant.

event:MERCHANT_CONFIRM_TRADE_TIMER_REMOV.s: Fires when selling an item to a vendor would end its trade window and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and sells it with `SellCursorItem`.

event:MERCHANT_FILTER_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when item data for the merchant's filtered item list changes.

event:MERCHANT_SHOW.s: Fires when the player starts talking to a merchant.

event:MERCHANT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the merchant's items change. Blizzard's merchant frame redraws on its next update.

p.x: The horizontal position of the ping.
p.y: The vertical position of the ping.

event:MINIMAP_PING.s: Fires when a group member pings the minimap. Blizzard's docs mark it as a restricted callback event with secret payloads; Blizzard's minimap plays the ping sound.

event:MINIMAP_UPDATE_TRACKING.s: Fires when what the minimap tracks changes. Blizzard's minimap tracking menu and quest offer pins refresh.

event:MINIMAP_UPDATE_ZOOM.s: Fires when the minimap's zoom changes. Blizzard's minimap updates its zoom buttons.

event:MIN_EXPANSION_LEVEL_UPDATED.s: Fires when the lowest expansion level for the account changes. Blizzard's character select screen updates its logo and upgrade panel.

p.paused: Whether the timer is now paused.

event:MIRROR_TIMER_PAUSE.s: Fires when a mirror timer, such as the breath or fatigue bar, is paused or resumed.

p.scale: How fast the timer changes per second.
p.timerLabel: The text shown on the timer bar.

event:MIRROR_TIMER_START.s: Fires when a mirror timer, such as the breath or fatigue bar, starts. Blizzard shows a timer bar with these values.

event:MIRROR_TIMER_STOP.s: Fires when a mirror timer, such as the breath or fatigue bar, ends. Blizzard hides that timer's bar.

p.down: `1` when the key was pressed, `0` when it was released.
p.key: The modifier key, such as `"LSHIFT"` or `"RCTRL"`.

event:MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a modifier key (Shift, Ctrl or Alt) is pressed or released. Blizzard's secure state drivers re-evaluate their macro conditions on it.

event:MOUNT_CURSOR_CLEAR.s: Fires when a mount is no longer on the cursor.

event:MOUNT_EQUIPMENT_APPLY_RESULT.s: Fires when the server answers an attempt to apply mount equipment. Blizzard's mount journal shows the result.

event:MOUNT_JOURNAL_SEARCH_UPDATED.s: Fires when the results of the mount journal's search change. Blizzard's mount list redraws.

event:MOUNT_JOURNAL_USABILITY_CHANGED.s: Fires when which mounts the player can use changes. Blizzard's mount journal redraws.

event:MUTELIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's mute list changes. Blizzard's channel frame redraws its roster.

event:MYTHIC_PLUS_CURRENT_AFFIX_UPDATE.s: Fires when the current Mythic+ affixes are available or change. Blizzard's Mythic+ frame listens for it while shown.

event:MYTHIC_PLUS_NEW_WEEKLY_RECORD.s: Fires when the player sets a new weekly best in a Mythic+ dungeon.

event:NAME_PLATE_CREATED.s: Fires when a new nameplate frame is created. Nameplate frames are reused, so this fires once per frame, not once per unit.

p.unitToken: The nameplate's unit token, such as `nameplate1`.

event:NAME_PLATE_UNIT_ADDED.s: Fires when a nameplate is shown for a unit. Get the frame with `C_NamePlate.GetNamePlateForUnit`.

p.isBehindCamera: Whether the unit is behind the camera now.

event:NAME_PLATE_UNIT_BEHIND_CAMERA_CHAN.s: Fires when a nameplate's unit moves behind or in front of the camera.

p.unitToken: The nameplate's unit token, such as `nameplate1`.

event:NAME_PLATE_UNIT_REMOVED.s: Fires when a nameplate stops showing a unit, such as when it goes out of range.

p.isWaypoint: Whether the destination reached was a waypoint.

event:NAVIGATION_DESTINATION_REACHED.s: Fires when the player reaches the destination of the in-game navigation. Blizzard's super-tracked frame reacts to it.

event:NAVIGATION_FRAME_CREATED.s: Fires when the frame used for in-game navigation is created. Blizzard's super-tracked frame sets itself up on it.

event:NAVIGATION_FRAME_DESTROYED.s: Fires when the in-game navigation frame is destroyed. Blizzard's super-tracked frame shuts down its navigation display.

p.approved: Whether the guild meets the size requirement.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_GUILD_SIZE_VALIDATED.s: Fires when the server reports whether the player's guild is large enough to create a guild neighborhood. Blizzard shows an error when it is not.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when information about a neighborhood arrives or changes. Blizzard's bulletin board refreshes.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_INITIATIVE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the neighborhood initiative information changes. Blizzard's initiative tracker and housing dashboard refresh.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_INVITE_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the server answers an invite to a neighborhood the player sent. Blizzard adds the invite to the pending list on success or shows the error.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the house finder's neighborhood search returns. Blizzard lists them, or shows an error when `result` is not `Enum.HousingResult.Success`.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_MAP_DATA_UPDATED.s: Fires when the map data of a neighborhood changes. Blizzard's neighborhood map pins refresh.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME_UPDATED.s: Fires when a neighborhood's name changes.

event:NEIGHBORHOOD_NAME_VALIDATED.s: Fires when the server reports whether a proposed neighborhood name is allowed. Blizzard shows a name error, or goes on to create or rename the neighborhood.

event:NEUTRAL_FACTION_SELECT_RESULT.s: Fires when a neutral character's choice of faction completes. Blizzard's chat frame reloads the default language and the micro menu refreshes.

event:NEWCOMER_GRADUATION.s: Fires when the player graduates from the newcomer program. Blizzard's chat frame shows the graduation message.

event:NEW_HOUSING_ITEM_ACQUIRED.s: Fires when the player acquires a new housing item. Blizzard shows a housing item alert.

event:NEW_MATCHMAKING_PARTY_INVITE.s: Fires when the player receives a new matchmaking party invite. Blizzard's friends list shows it.

event:NEW_MOUNT_ADDED.s: Fires when the player learns a new mount.

event:NEW_PET_ADDED.s: Fires when a new battle pet is added to the player's pet journal. Blizzard shows a new pet alert.

p.baseRecipeID: The first rank of the recipe, for recipes with ranks.
p.recipeLevel: The rank of the recipe learned, for recipes with ranks.

event:NEW_RECIPE_LEARNED.s: Fires when the player learns a profession recipe or a new rank of one. Blizzard's UI shows a new recipe alert and refreshes the recipe form if it shows that recipe.

event:NEW_RUNEFORGE_POWER_ADDED.s: Fires when the player learns a new runeforge legendary power. Blizzard's UI shows an alert.

event:NEW_TOY_ADDED.s: Fires when the player learns a new toy. Blizzard's UI shows the new toy toast.

event:NEW_WARBAND_SCENE_ADDED.s: Fires when the player collects a new warband scene. Blizzard's UI shows an alert for it.

event:NEW_WMO_CHUNK.s: Fires when the player moves into a new part of a world map object, such as a building or cave. Blizzard's battlefield map and hybrid minimap check which map to show.

event:NOTCHED_DISPLAY_MODE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the notched display setting changes. Blizzard moves `UIParent` to fit the screen.

event:NOTIFY_CHAT_SUPPRESSED.s: Fires when chat is hidden from the player because of their chat restriction or age verification settings. Blizzard's chat frames print a notice explaining why.

p.numBlackMarksOnOffender: How many reports the offender has.
p.numPlayersIHaveReported: How many players the player has reported.
p.offender: The name of the reported player.

event:NOTIFY_PVP_AFK_RESULT.s: Fires when the player's report of someone as away in a PvP match has been handled.

event:NOTIFY_TURN_STRAFE_CHANGE.s: Fires when the game changes the character's turn and strafe key bindings. Blizzard's UI then shows a popup about the new turn and strafe style.

event:OBJECT_ENTERED_AOI.s: Fires when an object comes into the player's area of interest, the range in which the client tracks it.

event:OBJECT_LEFT_AOI.s: Fires when an object leaves the player's area of interest, the range in which the client tracks it.

event:OBLITERUM_FORGE_PENDING_ITEM_CHANG.s: Fires when the item placed in the Obliterum Forge changes. Blizzard's forge frame updates its item slot and obliterate button.

p.locationName: The name of the neighborhood's location.

event:OPEN_CHARTER_CONFIRMATION_UI.s: Fires when the player should confirm creating a charter neighborhood. Blizzard shows `HousingCreateCharterNeighborhoodConfirmationFrame`.

p.locationName: The name of the neighborhood's location.

event:OPEN_CREATE_CHARTER_NEIGHBORHOOD_U.s: Fires when the player starts creating a charter neighborhood. Blizzard loads and shows `HousingCreateNeighborhoodCharterFrame`; `CLOSE_CREATE_CHARTER_NEIGHBORHOOD_UI` closes it.

p.locationName: The name of the neighborhood's location.

event:OPEN_CREATE_GUILD_NEIGHBORHOOD_UI.s: Fires when the player starts creating a guild neighborhood. Blizzard loads and shows `HousingCreateGuildNeighborhoodFrame`; `CLOSE_CREATE_GUILD_NEIGHBORHOOD_UI` closes it.

event:OPEN_MASTER_LOOT_LIST.s: Fires when the master looter should choose who receives an item. Blizzard's UI opens the assign loot menu.

p.neighborhoodInfo: The neighborhood the charter is for.
p.requiredSignatures: The number of signatures the charter needs.
p.signatures: The names of the players who have signed.

event:OPEN_NEIGHBORHOOD_CHARTER.s: Fires when the player opens a neighborhood charter. Blizzard loads and shows `HousingCharterFrame` with its signatures.

p.neighborhoodInfo: The neighborhood the charter is for.

event:OPEN_NEIGHBORHOOD_CHARTER_SIGNATUR.s: Fires when another player asks the player to sign their neighborhood charter. Blizzard shows the signature request dialog.

event:OPEN_PLOT_CORNERSTONE.s: Fires when the player interacts with a housing plot's cornerstone. Blizzard opens the cornerstone frame, showing the purchase view if the plot is for sale.

p.expansionSkillLineID: The expansion-specific profession the recipe belongs to.

event:OPEN_RECIPE_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the profession to show a recipe in is known, in answer to `C_TradeSkillUI.OpenRecipe`. Blizzard's professions frame selects the recipe, waiting for `TRADE_SKILL_LIST_UPDATE` if the data source is still changing.

event:OPEN_SPLASH_SCREEN.s: Fires when the What's New splash screen should open. Blizzard's splash frame sets itself up with the info.

event:OPEN_TABARD_FRAME.s: Fires when the player talks to a tabard vendor and the guild tabard design frame should open.

event:OWNED_AUCTIONS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of the player's own auctions changes. Blizzard's auctions tab clears its selection and redraws.

event:OWNED_AUCTION_BIDDER_INFO_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the bidder's name for one of the player's auctions arrives after `C_AuctionHouse.RequestOwnedAuctionBidderInfo` returned `nil`.

event:PARTY_INVITE_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pending group invite to the player is cancelled. Blizzard's UI hides the invite dialog.

p.allowMultipleRoles: Whether more than one role may be chosen.
p.isDamage: Whether the damage role is asked for.
p.isHealer: Whether the healer role is asked for.
p.isNativeRealm: Despite the name, Blizzard's UI treats `true` as a cross-realm invite and shows its cross-realm invite text.
p.isTank: Whether the tank role is asked for.
p.name: The name of the player who sent the invite.
p.questSessionActive: Whether the player is in an active quest session (Party Sync).

event:PARTY_INVITE_REQUEST.s: Fires when someone invites the player to a group. Blizzard's UI flashes the client icon and shows an invite dialog, or a role selection when roles are asked for; answer with `AcceptGroup` or `DeclineGroup`.

p.attackerGUID: GUID of the unit that made the kill.
p.targetGUID: GUID of the unit that was killed.

event:PARTY_KILL.s: Fires when the player or a group member kills a unit.

event:PARTY_LEADER_CHANGED.s: Fires when the leader of the player's group changes.

event:PARTY_LFG_RESTRICTED.s: Fires when the group's restriction from group finder activities changes. Blizzard's raid frame updates.

event:PARTY_LOOT_METHOD_CHANGED.s: Fires when the group's loot method changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit token of the group member.

event:PARTY_MEMBER_DISABLE.s: Fires when a group member is disabled. Blizzard's unit frames update the member's power bar and their not-present icon.

p.unitTarget: The unit token of the group member.

event:PARTY_MEMBER_ENABLE.s: Fires when a group member is enabled again. Blizzard's unit frames update the member's power bar and their not-present icon.

p.essenceID: The essence picked up, or nil if none.

event:PENDING_AZERITE_ESSENCE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the essence the player has picked up to place in a slot changes. Blizzard's essence list refreshes.

p.pendingInviteList: Names of the players with pending invites.

event:PENDING_NEIGHBORHOOD_INVITES_RECIE.s: Fires when the list of pending neighborhood invites arrives from the server. Blizzard fills its pending invite list on success.

p.added: Whether it was added rather than removed.

event:PERKS_ACTIVITIES_TRACKED_LIST_CHAN.s: Fires when a Traveler's Log activity is added to or removed from the player's tracked activities. Blizzard's monthly activities tracker redraws.

event:PERKS_ACTIVITIES_TRACKED_UPDATED.s: Fires when the progress of the player's tracked Traveler's Log activities changes. Blizzard's monthly activities tracker redraws.

event:PERKS_ACTIVITIES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the Traveler's Log activities change. Blizzard's monthly activities frame reads them again with `C_PerksActivities.GetPerksActivitiesInfo`.

event:PERKS_ACTIVITY_COMPLETED.s: Fires when the player completes a Traveler's Log activity. Blizzard shows an alert and plays a sound if the activity was tracked.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_ADD_PENDING_SHOP_ITE.s: Fires when an item is added to the pending items of the Trading Post shop.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_CLOSE.s: Fires when the Trading Post interaction ends. Blizzard closes the Trading Post frame.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_CURRENCY_AWARDED.s: Fires when the player is awarded Trader's Tender. Blizzard shows a loot alert for the amount.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_CURRENCY_REFRESH.s: Fires when the player's Trader's Tender balance changes. Blizzard's Trading Post updates the amount it shows.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_DATA_REFRESH.s: Fires when the Trading Post's list of items is refreshed. Blizzard reloads it with `C_PerksProgram.GetAvailableVendorItemIDs`.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_DATA_SPECIFIC_ITEM_R.s: Fires when the data of one Trading Post item is refreshed. Blizzard redraws that item.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_DISABLED.s: Fires when the Trading Post is disabled. Blizzard shows a dialog saying it is unavailable.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_OPEN.s: Fires when the player opens the Trading Post. Blizzard shows the Trading Post frame.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_PURCHASE_CART_SUCCES.s: Fires when a purchase of several Trading Post items succeeds.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_PURCHASE_SUCCESS.s: Fires when buying a Trading Post item succeeds. Blizzard plays a sound and marks the item purchased.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_REFUND_SUCCESS.s: Fires when refunding a Trading Post item succeeds. Blizzard plays a sound and marks the item as no longer purchased.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_REMOVE_PENDING_SHOP_.s: Fires when an item is removed from the pending items of the Trading Post shop.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_RESULT_ERROR.s: Fires when a Trading Post request fails on the server. Blizzard's Trading Post shows its error state.

event:PERKS_PROGRAM_SET_FROZEN_ITEM.s: Fires when the player freezes a Trading Post item to keep it for later months.

event:PETITION_CLOSED.s: Fires when the petition (charter) window should close. Blizzard's petition frame hides.

event:PETITION_SHOW.s: Fires when the player opens a guild or arena charter to view or sign it. Blizzard's petition frame shows, closing the petition if the frame cannot open.

event:PET_ATTACK_START.s: Fires when the player's pet starts attacking. Blizzard's pet frame shows its attack indicator.

event:PET_ATTACK_STOP.s: Fires when the player's pet stops attacking. Blizzard's pet frame hides its attack indicator.

event:PET_BAR_HIDEGRID.s: Fires when the empty slots of the pet action bar should be hidden again. Blizzard's pet action bar uses it as its hide grid event.

event:PET_BAR_SHOWGRID.s: Fires when the empty slots of the pet action bar should be shown, such as while dragging a pet action. Blizzard's pet action bar uses it as its show grid event.

event:PET_BAR_UPDATE.s: Fires when the pet action bar changes, such as when the player gains or loses a pet. Blizzard's pet bar updates.

event:PET_BAR_UPDATE_COOLDOWN.s: Fires when the cooldowns of pet actions change. Blizzard's pet and possess bar buttons redraw their cooldowns.

event:PET_BAR_UPDATE_USABLE.s: Fires when the usability of the pet's actions changes. Blizzard's pet action bar redraws its buttons.

p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_ABILITY_CHANGED.s: Fires when an ability of a pet in a pet battle changes.

event:PET_BATTLE_ACTION_SELECTED.s: Fires when the player selects an action for the current pet battle round. Blizzard disables the skip button and updates the action buttons.

p.owner: Which side the aura belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`), `Weather` for weather.
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_AURA_APPLIED.s: Fires when an aura is applied to a pet in a pet battle, or to the weather. Blizzard refreshes the pet's frame, or the weather frame.

p.owner: Which side the aura belonged to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`), `Weather` for weather.
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_AURA_CANCELED.s: Fires when an aura is removed from a pet in a pet battle, or from the weather. Blizzard refreshes the pet's frame, or the weather frame.

p.owner: Which side the aura belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`), `Weather` for weather.
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_AURA_CHANGED.s: Fires when an aura on a pet in a pet battle, or on the weather, changes. Blizzard refreshes the pet's frame, or the weather frame.

p.owner: Which side the captured pet belonged to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).

event:PET_BATTLE_CAPTURED.s: Fires when a pet is captured in a pet battle. Blizzard's level up display shows a capture notice when the captured pet was the enemy's.

event:PET_BATTLE_CLOSE.s: Fires when a pet battle ends and its interface closes. Blizzard removes the pet battle frame and restores the action bars.

event:PET_BATTLE_FINAL_ROUND.s: Fires when the final round of a pet battle is reached and the winner is known. Blizzard's level up display shows the winner.

p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_HEALTH_CHANGED.s: Fires when a pet's health changes in a pet battle. Blizzard updates the pet's health bar.

p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_LEVEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when a pet gains a level in a pet battle. Blizzard's pet journal updates its loadout.

event:PET_BATTLE_LOOT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the player receives loot from a pet battle. Blizzard's level-up display shows the reward.

p.healthChange: How much the maximum health changed.
p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_MAX_HEALTH_CHANGED.s: Fires when a pet's maximum health changes in a pet battle. Blizzard updates the pet's health bar.

event:PET_BATTLE_OPENING_DONE.s: Fires when the opening of a pet battle has finished and the first round can start. Blizzard starts the turn timer and plays the battle start sound.

event:PET_BATTLE_OPENING_START.s: Fires when a pet battle begins and the camera moves in. Blizzard shows the pet battle frame and hides the override action bar; `PET_BATTLE_OPENING_DONE` follows.

event:PET_BATTLE_OVER.s: Fires when a pet battle is over and the camera moves out; `PET_BATTLE_CLOSE` follows when the interface closes.

event:PET_BATTLE_OVERRIDE_ABILITY.s: Fires when one of the player's pet battle abilities is overridden. Blizzard updates that ability button.

p.owner: The side whose active pet changed (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).

event:PET_BATTLE_PET_CHANGED.s: Fires when the active pet of a side changes in a pet battle. Blizzard updates the unit frames, action buttons and experience bar.

event:PET_BATTLE_PET_ROUND_PLAYBACK_COMP.s: Fires when the playback of a pet battle round has finished and the next action can be chosen. Blizzard restarts the turn timer and updates the action buttons.

event:PET_BATTLE_PET_ROUND_RESULTS.s: Fires when the results of a pet battle round arrive.

p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_PET_TYPE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a pet's type changes in a pet battle. Blizzard updates the pet's type icon and the action buttons.

event:PET_BATTLE_PVP_DUEL_REQUESTED.s: Fires when another player challenges the player to a pet battle duel. Blizzard shows a dialog to accept or decline.

event:PET_BATTLE_PVP_DUEL_REQUEST_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pet battle duel request is cancelled. Blizzard hides the duel request dialog.

event:PET_BATTLE_QUEUE_PROPOSAL_ACCEPTED.s: Fires when a proposed pet battle match from the queue is accepted. Blizzard hides the queue ready dialog.

event:PET_BATTLE_QUEUE_PROPOSAL_DECLINED.s: Fires when a proposed pet battle match from the queue is declined. Blizzard hides the queue ready dialog.

event:PET_BATTLE_QUEUE_PROPOSE_MATCH.s: Fires when the pet battle queue finds a match for the player. Blizzard plays a sound and shows the queue ready dialog.

event:PET_BATTLE_QUEUE_STATUS.s: Fires when the player's pet battle queue status changes. Blizzard's pet journal and queue status frame update.

p.owner: Which side the pet belongs to (`Enum.BattlePetOwner`).
p.petIndex: The pet's slot on that side.

event:PET_BATTLE_XP_CHANGED.s: Fires when a pet gains experience in a pet battle. Blizzard updates the pet battle experience bar.

event:PET_DISMISS_START.s: Fires when the player's pet starts being dismissed.

p.declinedName1: A declined form of the name.
p.declinedName2: A declined form of the name.
p.declinedName3: A declined form of the name.
p.declinedName4: A declined form of the name.
p.declinedName5: A declined form of the name.
p.name: The pet's name.

event:PET_FORCE_NAME_DECLENSION.s: Fires when the player must enter the declined forms of a pet's name, on clients with declensions. Blizzard's declension frame opens for the pet.

event:PET_INFO_UPDATE.s: Fires when information about the hunter's pets changes. Blizzard's stable frame refreshes.

p.slotIndex: The battle slot the pet was placed in.

event:PET_JOURNAL_AUTO_SLOTTED_PET.s: Fires when the game automatically places a pet into one of the player's battle pet slots.

event:PET_JOURNAL_CAGE_FAILED.s: Fires when putting a battle pet in a cage fails. Blizzard's pet journal clears the pending cage.

event:PET_JOURNAL_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of pets in the player's pet journal changes. Blizzard's pet journal redraws its list, loadout and pet card.

event:PET_JOURNAL_NEW_BATTLE_SLOT.s: Fires when the player unlocks a new battle pet slot. Blizzard shows an alert on the collections micro button.

event:PET_JOURNAL_PETS_HEALED.s: Fires when the player's battle pets are healed. Blizzard's pet journal updates its loadout.

event:PET_JOURNAL_PET_DELETED.s: Fires when a pet is removed from the player's pet journal, such as when it is released or caged. Blizzard's pet journal updates its list and loadout.

event:PET_JOURNAL_PET_RESTORED.s: Fires when a battle pet is restored to the player's pet journal.

event:PET_JOURNAL_PET_REVOKED.s: Fires when a battle pet is revoked from the player's pet journal.

event:PET_JOURNAL_TRAP_LEVEL_SET.s: Fires when the level of the player's battle pet trap is set. Blizzard's level up display announces the trap upgrade.

event:PET_SPECIALIZATION_CHANGED.s: Fires when the specialization of the player's pet changes. The Mists of Pandaria talent frame updates.

event:PET_STABLE_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops using the stable. Blizzard closes the stable frame.

event:PET_STABLE_FAVORITES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the hunter's favorite stabled pets change. Blizzard's stable frame refreshes its pet list.

event:PET_STABLE_SHOW.s: Fires when the player opens the stable at a stable master. Blizzard shows the stable frame.

event:PET_STABLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the pets in the stable change. Blizzard's stable frame refreshes.

event:PET_STATS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the stats of the player's pet change. Blizzard's character frame queues an update when the pet stats pane is shown.

event:PET_UI_CLOSE.s: Fires when the pet UI should close. Blizzard's classic pet frame closes the pet tab if it is shown.

event:PET_UI_UPDATE.s: Fires when the pet frame and pet action bar need to be refreshed.

event:PHOTO_SHARING_AUTHORIZATION_NEEDED.s: Fires when sharing a photo needs the player to sign in. Blizzard's photo sharing browser opens.

p.showNotification: Whether to tell the player about the change.

event:PHOTO_SHARING_AUTHORIZATION_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's photo sharing sign-in changes. Blizzard's photo sharing frame updates its publish button.

event:PHOTO_SHARING_PHOTO_UPLOAD_STATUS.s: Fires with the result of uploading a shared photo. Blizzard's UI shows a message for success or errors.

event:PHOTO_SHARING_SCREENSHOT_READY.s: Fires when a screenshot for photo sharing has been taken. Blizzard's photo sharing frame shows the preview.

p.authUrl: The URL of the sign-in page.

event:PHOTO_SHARING_THIRD_PARTY_AUTHORIZ.s: Fires when sharing a photo needs the player to sign in to a third-party service.

event:PING_SYSTEM_ERROR.s: Fires when a ping cannot be sent. Blizzard's UI shows the error in red.

event:PLAYERBANKSLOTS_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item slot or bag slot of the character bank changes.

event:PLAYER_ACCOUNT_BANK_TAB_SLOTS_CHAN.s: Fires when a tab slot of the account (warband) bank changes.

event:PLAYER_ALIVE.s: Fires when the player becomes alive or releases their spirit. A comment in Blizzard's tutorial notes that it fires on release, not on returning to the corpse; `PLAYER_UNGHOST` fires then.

event:PLAYER_AVG_ITEM_LEVEL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's average item level changes; `GetAverageItemLevel` returns the new value. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

event:PLAYER_CAMPING.s: Fires when the player starts logging out and the logout countdown begins. Blizzard shows the logout countdown dialog; `LOGOUT_CANCEL` fires if it is cancelled.

p.canGlide: Whether the player can glide now.

event:PLAYER_CAN_GLIDE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player becomes able or unable to glide.

p.characterInfos: The characters that can own the house.
p.ownerListIndex: The index of the current owner in the list.

event:PLAYER_CHARACTER_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of the player's characters that can own a house arrives, after `C_Housing.RequestPlayerCharacterList`. Blizzard's house settings frame fills its owner dropdown.

event:PLAYER_CHOICE_CLOSE.s: Fires when a player choice window should close.

event:PLAYER_CHOICE_UPDATE.s: Fires when a player choice is offered or changes. Blizzard's UI shows the choice window.

event:PLAYER_CONTROL_GAINED.s: Fires when the player regains control of their character. Blizzard's pet and possess bars update.

event:PLAYER_CONTROL_LOST.s: Fires when the player loses control of their character, for example when a taxi flight starts. Blizzard's UI closes open windows unless the player is on a taxi, and the pet and possess bars update.

event:PLAYER_DAMAGE_DONE_MODS.s: Fires when the player's damage done modifiers change. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

event:PLAYER_DEAD.s: Fires when the player dies. Blizzard's UI closes open windows and shows the release spirit dialog.

event:PLAYER_DIFFICULTY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's dungeon or raid difficulty changes. Blizzard's instance difficulty indicator updates.

event:PLAYER_ENTERING_BATTLEGROUND.s: Fires when the player enters a battleground. Blizzard's battleground chat filters start on this event.

p.isInitialLogin: Whether this is the first time after logging in.
p.isReloadingUi: Whether the UI was just reloaded.

event:PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD.s: Fires when the player enters the world: on login, on a UI reload, and after every loading screen. Blizzard closes open windows and refreshes many frames on it.

event:PLAYER_ENTER_COMBAT.s: Fires when the player starts auto-attacking. For entering combat in general, use `PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED`.

event:PLAYER_EQUIPMENT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the item in one of the player's equipment slots changes. Blizzard's character frame updates the slot button for that slot.

event:PLAYER_FARSIGHT_FOCUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's view moves to or from another object, such as with Eagle Eye or Mind Vision. Blizzard's pet and possess bars refresh.

event:PLAYER_FLAGS_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's player flags change, such as away, busy or PvP status. Blizzard's friends list and raid frames refresh.

event:PLAYER_FOCUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's focus target changes. Blizzard's focus frame redraws for the new unit.

p.vehicleUIIndicatorID: The vehicle seat indicator to show.

event:PLAYER_GAINS_VEHICLE_DATA.s: Fires when a unit gains vehicle data, such as entering a vehicle with its own interface. Blizzard's unit frames and vehicle seat indicator update.

event:PLAYER_GUILD_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's guild membership or guild information changes, such as when the player joins or leaves a guild. Blizzard's guild and calendar frames update, and the communities frame redraws the guild tabard.

event:PLAYER_HOUSE_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of the player's houses arrives. Blizzard's housing dashboard fills its house dropdown.

event:PLAYER_IMPULSE_APPLIED.s: Fires when an impulse, such as a knockback, is applied to the player's movement.

p.isInside: Whether the player is now inside the area.

event:PLAYER_INSIDE_QUEST_BLOB_STATE_CHA.s: Fires when the player enters or leaves a quest's objective area on the map. Blizzard's quest item buttons update.

event:PLAYER_INTERACTION_MANAGER_FRAME_H.s: Fires when an interaction with an NPC or object ends, such as closing a merchant or mailbox. Blizzard's interaction manager hides the frame for that interaction type.

event:PLAYER_INTERACTION_MANAGER_FRAME_S.s: Fires when the player starts an interaction with an NPC or object, such as a merchant or mailbox. Blizzard's interaction manager shows the frame for that interaction type.

p.inCombat: Whether the player is now in combat.

event:PLAYER_IN_COMBAT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player enters or leaves combat. Blizzard's damage meter, cooldown viewer, buff frame and combat audio alerts update.

p.isGliding: Whether the player is gliding now.

event:PLAYER_IS_GLIDING_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player starts or stops gliding.

event:PLAYER_JOINED_PVP_MATCH.s: Fires when the player joins a PvP match. Blizzard's UI hides the PvP ready popup and sets up the match scoreboard.

event:PLAYER_LEARN_PVP_TALENT_FAILED.s: Fires when learning a PvP talent fails.

event:PLAYER_LEARN_TALENT_FAILED.s: Fires when learning a talent fails.

event:PLAYER_LEAVE_COMBAT.s: Fires when the player stops auto-attacking. For leaving combat in general, use `PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`.

event:PLAYER_LEAVING_WORLD.s: Fires when the player leaves the world, before a loading screen or logout. `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` follows once the player is back in the world.

p.real: Whether the player's real level changed.

event:PLAYER_LEVEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's level changes, including changes that are not real level gains.

event:PLAYER_LEVEL_UP.s: Fires when the player gains a level, with what the new level adds.

event:PLAYER_LOGIN.s: Fires once after login, when the addons that load at startup have loaded and the player is available. Blizzard loads the time manager and combat log on it; `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` follows.

event:PLAYER_LOGOUT.s: Fires when the player logs out or the UI is about to unload. Blizzard writes settings into its saved variables on it, such as the stopwatch position.

event:PLAYER_LOOT_SPEC_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's loot specialization changes. Blizzard's bonus roll frame updates its specialization icon from `GetLootSpecialization`.

event:PLAYER_LOSES_VEHICLE_DATA.s: Fires when a unit loses its vehicle data. Blizzard's unit frames update and the vehicle seat indicator unloads for the player.

p.newMapID: The map the player is now on.

event:PLAYER_MAP_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player moves from one map to another.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose maximum level changed.

event:PLAYER_MAX_LEVEL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the maximum level the player can reach changes. Blizzard's status tracking bars refresh.

event:PLAYER_MONEY.s: Fires when the amount of money the player carries changes. Read the new amount with `GetMoney`.

event:PLAYER_MOUNT_DISPLAY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player mounts or dismounts. Blizzard's mount journal and pet bar refresh.

p.isPvpFlagged: Whether the player is now flagged for PvP.

event:PLAYER_PVP_FLAG_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player becomes flagged or unflagged for PvP. Blizzard's player frame updates its PvP icon and can play a sound when flagged.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose kill count changed.

event:PLAYER_PVP_KILLS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's count of honorable kills changes.

event:PLAYER_PVP_RANK_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's PvP rank changes. Blizzard's character frame updates the title it shows with `UnitPVPName`.

event:PLAYER_PVP_TALENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's PvP talents change. Blizzard's PvP talent slots clear their predicted choice and update.

event:PLAYER_QUITING.s: Fires when the player starts quitting the game. Blizzard shows the quit countdown dialog; `LOGOUT_CANCEL` fires if it is cancelled.

event:PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED.s: Fires when the player enters combat and health regeneration stops. Protected actions are blocked from now until `PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`.

event:PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED.s: Fires when the player leaves combat and health regeneration resumes. Protected actions put off during combat can run now.

p.invitedByGUID: The GUID of the reported player.

event:PLAYER_REPORT_SUBMITTED.s: Fires when the player has reported someone. Blizzard's UI removes that player's chat messages, declines their community invitation and closes their crafting order.

event:PLAYER_ROLES_ASSIGNED.s: Fires when the roles of the group's members change.

event:PLAYER_SKINNED.s: Fires when the player's insignia is taken from their corpse, so they can only resurrect at the graveyard. Blizzard's UI hides the resurrection dialogs and shows an error message.

event:PLAYER_SOFT_ENEMY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's soft enemy target changes. Blizzard's nameplates and raid frames update their highlight.

event:PLAYER_SOFT_FRIEND_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's soft friendly target changes. Blizzard's nameplates and raid frames update their highlight.

p.newTarget: GUID of the new soft interact target, or nil if there is none.
p.oldTarget: GUID of the previous soft interact target.

event:PLAYER_SOFT_INTERACT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the object the player's interact key would use changes. Blizzard plays a sound and updates the nameplate icons.

event:PLAYER_SOFT_TARGET_INTERACTION.s: Fires when the player interacts with their soft interact target. Blizzard's interact key tutorial counts these interactions.

event:PLAYER_SPECIALIZATION_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's specialization changes. Blizzard's PvP, group finder and stable frames refresh.

event:PLAYER_STARTED_LOOKING.s: Fires when the player starts turning the camera with the mouse.

event:PLAYER_STARTED_MOVING.s: Fires when the player starts moving. Blizzard's frame fader uses it to fade frames while the player moves.

event:PLAYER_STARTED_TURNING.s: Fires when the player's character starts turning.

event:PLAYER_STOPPED_LOOKING.s: Fires when the player stops turning the camera with the mouse.

event:PLAYER_STOPPED_MOVING.s: Fires when the player stops moving. Blizzard's frame fader uses it to bring faded frames back.

event:PLAYER_STOPPED_TURNING.s: Fires when the player's character stops turning.

p.swingDuration: The duration of the swing, which Blizzard's swing timer restarts with.

event:PLAYER_SWING.s: Fires when the player makes a melee or ranged swing. Blizzard's swing timer and gamepad reticle animate it.

event:PLAYER_TALENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's talents change. Blizzard's micro menu, class power bars and character frame update.

event:PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's target changes, including when it is cleared. Blizzard's target frame redraws for the new unit.

event:PLAYER_TARGET_DIED.s: Fires when the player's target dies. Blizzard's combat audio alerts can announce it.

event:PLAYER_TOTEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when one of the player's totems changes, such as when it is summoned, expires or is destroyed. Blizzard's totem frame and cooldown viewer read the slot with `GetTotemInfo`.

event:PLAYER_TRADE_CURRENCY.s: Fires when the currency the player offers in a trade changes.

event:PLAYER_TRADE_MONEY.s: Fires when the money the player offers in a trade changes. Blizzard's money frames update.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose banked experience changed.

event:PLAYER_TRIAL_XP_UPDATE.s: Fires when the experience a trial character has banked beyond the level limit changes.

event:PLAYER_UNGHOST.s: Fires when the player stops being a ghost, by recovering the corpse or being resurrected.

event:PLAYER_UPDATE_RESTING.s: Fires when the player starts or stops resting, such as entering or leaving an inn. Blizzard's player frame and experience bar refresh.

event:PLAYER_XP_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's experience changes. Blizzard's experience bar redraws.

event:PLAY_MOVIE.s: Fires when the game plays a movie. Blizzard shows the movie frame and plays it; `STOP_MOVIE` stops it.

event:PORTRAITS_UPDATED.s: Fires when unit portraits need to be redrawn. Blizzard's unit frames and micro menu refresh their portraits.

event:POST_MATCH_CURRENCY_REWARD_UPDATE.s: Fires when a currency reward for the finished PvP match arrives. Blizzard's match results frame rebuilds its reward section if the rewards were already shown.

event:POST_MATCH_ITEM_REWARD_UPDATE.s: Fires when an item reward for the finished PvP match arrives. Blizzard's match results frame rebuilds its reward section if the rewards were already shown.

event:PREFERRED_PLAY_SETTINGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's preferred play settings, such as locale and datacenter, change. Blizzard's settings panel re-evaluates those options.

p.isTool: Whether the item is a tool rather than an accessory.
p.skillLineID: The profession the equipment belongs to.

event:PROFESSION_EQUIPMENT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player equips profession equipment. The first time, Blizzard shows a help tip about the profession equipment slots.

p.skillName: The name of the profession to unlearn.

event:PROFESSION_RESPEC_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when the player asks an NPC to unlearn a profession. Blizzard's UI asks for confirmation, then calls `C_TradeSkillUI.ConfirmProfessionRespec` or `C_TradeSkillUI.CancelProfessionRespec`.

event:PROVING_GROUNDS_SCORE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's score in the Proving Grounds changes.

p.result: The result; Blizzard treats 0 as a failure.

event:PURCHASE_PLOT_RESULT.s: Fires when the server answers the player's attempt to buy a housing plot. Blizzard shows an error if it failed.

event:PVPQUEUE_ANYWHERE_SHOW.s: Fires when the battleground queue information for the PvP frame is available. Blizzard's honor frame updates its battleground lists.

event:PVPQUEUE_ANYWHERE_UPDATE_AVAILABLE.s: Fires when the battlegrounds the player can queue for change. Blizzard's honor frame updates its battleground lists.

event:PVP_BRAWL_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when information about the current PvP brawl changes. Blizzard's PvP and group finder frames refresh their brawl entries.

event:PVP_MATCH_ACTIVE.s: Fires when a PvP match the player is in becomes active. Blizzard's match results frame starts listening for the match's events.

event:PVP_MATCH_COMPLETE.s: Fires when the PvP match the player is in ends. Blizzard's match results frame shows unless the player is spectating as a commentator.

event:PVP_MATCH_INACTIVE.s: Fires when the PvP match the player is in stops being active.

event:PVP_MATCH_STATE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the state of the current PvP match changes; `C_PvP.GetActiveMatchState` returns the new state.

event:PVP_POWER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's PvP power changes.

event:PVP_RATED_STATS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's rated PvP statistics are updated. Blizzard's PvP frames refresh their rated brackets.

event:PVP_REWARDS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the PvP rewards information changes. Blizzard's PvP frame requests the random battleground information again while shown.

p.readyCheckInfo: The ready check the popup showed, or nil to hide it at once.

event:PVP_ROLE_POPUP_HIDE.s: Fires when the PvP role or ready popup should close. Blizzard's popup hides at once when no ready check information comes with it.

event:PVP_ROLE_POPUP_SHOW.s: Fires when a PvP queue needs the player to confirm their role and readiness. Blizzard's PvP ready popup sets itself up from the payload.

event:PVP_ROLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the roles the player has selected for PvP queues change. Blizzard's PvP frames update their role buttons.

event:PVP_SPECIAL_EVENT_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when information about special PvP events changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose PvP timer changed.

event:PVP_TIMER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's PvP flag timer starts or stops. Blizzard's player frame shows or hides the timer from `GetPVPTimer`.

p.ratedBGBlitz: Whether rated Battleground Blitz is enabled.
p.ratedSoloShuffle: Whether rated Solo Shuffle is enabled.
p.wargameBattlegrounds: Whether war game battlegrounds are enabled.

event:PVP_TYPES_ENABLED.s: Fires when the client learns which kinds of PvP are enabled. Blizzard's PvP frame stores the flags to enable or disable its queues.

event:PVP_VEHICLE_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the battleground vehicles shown on the map change. Blizzard's map vehicle provider redraws its pins.

event:PVP_WORLDSTATE_UPDATE.s: Fires when PvP world state information changes. Blizzard's PvP frame requests the random battleground information again while shown.

p.requestRequired: Whether the quest lines must be requested again.

event:QUESTLINE_UPDATE.s: Fires when quest line data for the map changes. Blizzard's map quest offer provider requests the quest lines again when `requestRequired` is true, and otherwise redraws its pins.

event:QUEST_ACCEPTED.s: Fires when the player accepts a quest. Blizzard's objective trackers and quest log react to the new quest, for example to watch it automatically.

p.name: The name of the player who started the quest.

event:QUEST_ACCEPT_CONFIRM.s: Fires when a group member starts a quest that the player is asked to accept as well, such as an escort quest. Blizzard shows a dialog to accept it, or one that says the quest log is full.

p.questId: The quest that can be completed.

event:QUEST_AUTOCOMPLETE.s: Fires when a quest can be completed without returning to its quest giver. Blizzard's objective tracker shows a "complete" popup for it.

p.displayTime: How long to show the message, in seconds.
p.enableBossEmoteWarningSound: Whether to play the warning sound.
p.text: The message, a format string with `%s` for the speaker's name.

event:QUEST_BOSS_EMOTE.s: Fires when a quest creature performs a boss-style emote.

event:QUEST_COMPLETE.s: Fires when a quest giver shows the reward page of a quest the player can turn in. Blizzard's quest frame shows the reward panel.

p.questID: The quest that gave the reward.

event:QUEST_CURRENCY_LOOT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the player receives a currency as a quest reward. Blizzard's warfront results screen adds it to its rewards.

event:QUEST_DATA_LOAD_RESULT.s: Fires when quest data requested with `C_QuestLog.RequestLoadQuestByID` has loaded or failed to load.

p.questStartItemID: The item that started the quest, if any.

event:QUEST_DETAIL.s: Fires when a quest giver shows the details of a quest the player can accept. Blizzard's quest frame shows the detail panel, or an objective tracker popup for quests started from an item or area.

event:QUEST_FINISHED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with a quest giver. Blizzard hides `QuestFrame`.

event:QUEST_GREETING.s: Fires when a quest giver with several quests shows its greeting. Blizzard shows the greeting panel of `QuestFrame`.

event:QUEST_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when item information for the quest shown at a quest giver changes. Blizzard's quest frame redraws its rewards or required items.

event:QUEST_LOG_CRITERIA_UPDATE.s: Fires when progress is made on a quest criterion. Blizzard's quest map may show the progress, such as "Description: 3/10", in the error frame.

event:QUEST_LOG_UPDATE.s: Fires when the quest log changes, including quest progress. It fires often; Blizzard's quest log, map and objective trackers redraw on it.

p.questID: The quest that gave the reward.

event:QUEST_LOOT_RECEIVED.s: Fires when the player receives an item as a quest reward. Blizzard's UI adds it to the world quest or invasion completion toast.

event:QUEST_POI_UPDATE.s: Fires when quest points of interest change. Blizzard's quest map and objective tracker redraw their quest locations.

event:QUEST_PROGRESS.s: Fires when the player talks to a quest giver about a quest in progress. Blizzard shows the progress panel of `QuestFrame`.

p.wasReplayQuest: Whether the quest was a replay quest.

event:QUEST_REMOVED.s: Fires when a quest leaves the player's quest log. Blizzard's bonus objective tracker removes its block.

event:QUEST_SESSION_CREATED.s: Fires when a quest session (Party Sync) is created for the player's group.

event:QUEST_SESSION_DESTROYED.s: Fires when the group's quest session (Party Sync) ends. Blizzard's UI hides the session start dialog.

p.enabled: Whether quest sessions are now available.

event:QUEST_SESSION_ENABLED_STATE_CHANGE.s: Fires when quest sessions (Party Sync) become available or unavailable.

event:QUEST_SESSION_JOINED.s: Fires when the player joins the group's quest session (Party Sync).

event:QUEST_SESSION_LEFT.s: Fires when the player leaves the group's quest session (Party Sync).

event:QUEST_SESSION_MEMBER_CONFIRM.s: Fires when a group member starts a quest session (Party Sync) and the player is asked to join. Blizzard's UI shows the start prompt.

event:QUEST_SESSION_MEMBER_START_RESPONS.s: Fires when a group member answers the prompt to start a quest session (Party Sync).

p.guid: The GUID of the player the result is about.

event:QUEST_SESSION_NOTIFICATION.s: Fires with a result or error about the group's quest session (Party Sync). Blizzard's UI prints a message for it and may close its dialogs.

event:QUEST_TURNED_IN.s: Fires when the player turns in a quest. Blizzard's objective tracker plays the turn-in animation, and the alert frames may show a completion toast.

p.added: Whether the quest was added to the watch list.
p.questID: The quest whose watch changed, if any.

event:QUEST_WATCH_LIST_CHANGED.s: Fires when a quest is added to or removed from the watched quests. Blizzard's objective tracker redraws and plays a fanfare for newly watched quests.

event:QUEST_WATCH_UPDATE.s: Fires when progress is made on a quest's objectives. With the `autoQuestWatch` CVar on, Blizzard's quest log starts watching the quest.

event:QUICK_TICKET_SYSTEM_STATUS.s: Fires when the availability of the in-game support ticket system changes. Blizzard's help frame listens for it.

event:QUICK_TICKET_THROTTLE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the limit on how often the player can submit support tickets changes. Blizzard's help frame listens for it.

p.name: The reward's name.
p.payloadID: The ID of the delivered thing.
p.showFancyToast: Whether to show the larger alert.

event:RAF_ENTITLEMENT_DELIVERED.s: Fires when a Recruit-a-Friend reward is delivered to the player. Blizzard shows a reward alert.

event:RAF_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's Recruit-A-Friend information changes. Blizzard's Recruit-A-Friend frame updates.

event:RAF_RECRUITING_ENABLED_STATUS.s: Fires when recruiting through Recruit-A-Friend becomes available or unavailable.

event:RAF_REWARD_CLAIM_FAILED.s: Fires when claiming a Recruit-A-Friend reward fails. Blizzard's Recruit-A-Friend frame turns off its automatic claiming.

p.enabled: Whether the system is now enabled.

event:RAF_SYSTEM_ENABLED_STATUS.s: Fires when the Recruit-A-Friend system becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard's friends frame updates which tabs it shows.

event:RAF_SYSTEM_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the general Recruit-A-Friend system information changes. Blizzard's Recruit-A-Friend frame updates.

p.displayTime: How long to show the message, in seconds.
p.enableBossEmoteWarningSound: Whether to play the warning sound.
p.text: The message, a format string with `%s` for the speaker's name.

event:RAID_BOSS_EMOTE.s: Fires when a boss performs an emote meant for the raid. Blizzard's UI shows it in the middle of the screen and can play a warning sound.

p.displayTime: How long to show the message, in seconds.
p.enableBossEmoteWarningSound: Whether to play the warning sound.
p.text: The message, a format string with `%s` for the speaker's name.

event:RAID_BOSS_WHISPER.s: Fires when a boss whispers to the player. Blizzard's UI shows it in the middle of the screen and can play a warning sound.

p.extended: 1 if the player's lock has been extended, else 0.
p.locked: 1 if the player is locked to the instance, else 0.
p.timeLeft: Seconds until the instance lock expires.

event:RAID_INSTANCE_WELCOME.s: Fires when the player enters a raid instance. Blizzard's UI prints a welcome message with the time until the instance lock expires.

event:RAID_ROSTER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's raid roster changes. Blizzard's raid frames redraw the groups.

event:RAID_TARGET_UPDATE.s: Fires when a raid target marker is set on or cleared from a unit. Blizzard's unit frames redraw their raid target icons.

event:RAISED_AS_GHOUL.s: Fires when the dead player is raised as a ghoul. Blizzard's UI handles it like `PLAYER_ALIVE` and hides the death dialog.

p.initiatorName: The name of the player who started the ready check.

event:READY_CHECK.s: Fires when a ready check starts. Blizzard's unit frames show a ready check icon on each member.

p.unitTarget: The unit token of the member who answered.

event:READY_CHECK_CONFIRM.s: Fires when a group member answers a ready check.

p.preempted: Whether the ready check ended early.

event:READY_CHECK_FINISHED.s: Fires when a ready check ends. Blizzard's unit frames show the results for a moment and then hide the icons.

event:RECEIVED_ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.s: Fires when the player's achievement data has arrived. Blizzard's achievements micro button registers it.

event:RECEIVED_ACHIEVEMENT_MEMBER_LIST.s: Fires when the list of guild members who have earned an achievement arrives. Blizzard's achievement frame updates the tooltip that asked for it.

event:RECEIVED_HOUSE_LEVEL_REWARDS.s: Fires in answer to `C_Housing.GetHouseLevelRewardsForLevel` with the rewards of one house level. Blizzard's house upgrade frame waits for every level before it draws the reward track.

event:RECENT_ALLIES_CACHE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the cached list of the player's recent allies changes. Blizzard's recent allies list refreshes, keeping its scroll position.

event:RECENT_ALLIES_DATA_READY.s: Fires when the data about the player's recent allies is ready to read.

event:RECENT_ALLIES_SYSTEM_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the recent allies feature becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard's friends frame updates which tabs it shows.

p.characterGUID: The GUID of the ally whose data changed.

event:RECENT_ALLY_DATA_UPDATED.s: Fires when the data about one of the player's recent allies changes.

event:REJECTED_MATCHMAKING_PARTY_INVITE.s: Fires when a matchmaking party invite is rejected.

event:REMIX_ARTIFACT_ITEM_SPECS_LOADED.s: Fires when the specialization data for remix artifacts has loaded. Blizzard's remix artifact tutorial updates if it loaded.

event:REMIX_ARTIFACT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the remix artifact is opened or its data changes. Blizzard's UI shows the remix artifact frame and updates its tutorial.

event:REMIX_END_OF_EVENT.s: Fires when a Remix (Timerunning) event the player took part in has ended. Blizzard's UI shows a notice that the characters went back to the main timeline and event items were removed.

p.signature: The name of the player whose signature was removed.

event:REMOVE_NEIGHBORHOOD_CHARTER_SIGNAT.s: Fires when a signature is removed from the open neighborhood charter. Blizzard's charter frame removes it.

p.existingStr: The name of the current enchant.
p.replacementStr: The name of the new enchant.

event:REPLACE_ENCHANT.s: Fires when applying an enchant would replace an item's existing one and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ReplaceEnchant`.

p.existing: The name of the current enchant.
p.replacement: The name of the new enchant.

event:REPLACE_TRADESKILL_ENCHANT.s: Fires when a profession enchant would replace an item's existing one and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ReplaceTradeskillEnchant`.

event:REPLICATE_ITEM_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the full auction house listing requested with `C_AuctionHouse.ReplicateItems` has been updated.

event:REPORT_PLAYER_RESULT.s: Fires when the result of a player report arrives. Blizzard's UI shows the result as an error and a chat message.

event:REPORT_SCREENSHOT_READY.s: Fires when the screenshot for a player report is ready. Blizzard's report frame shows its preview.

event:REQUESTED_GUILD_RENAME_RESULT.s: Fires when a guild rename the player requested has been handled. Blizzard's guild rename frame and an alert show the outcome.

p.isGossipTriggered: Whether the request came from a gossip option.

event:REQUEST_CEMETERY_LIST_RESPONSE.s: Fires when the list of graveyards the player can choose arrives. Blizzard's map refreshes its selectable graveyard pins.

p.dps: Whether the damage role was chosen.
p.healer: Whether the healer role was chosen.
p.questSessionActive: Whether the target's group is in an active quest session (Party Sync).
p.tank: Whether the tank role was chosen.
p.targetName: The name of the player whose group the request is for.

event:REQUEST_INVITE_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when the player asks to join another player's group and the request needs confirming. Blizzard's UI confirms with `C_PartyInfo.ConfirmRequestInviteFromUnit`, after a warning dialog when a quest session is active.

event:REQUIRED_GUILD_RENAME_RESULT.s: Fires when the rename of a guild that was required to change its name has been handled. On failure Blizzard's communities frame shows an invalid-name error.

event:RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_COMPLETE.s: Fires when the player completes an archaeology artifact. Blizzard's archaeology frame plays a glow on the artifact page if it shows that artifact.

event:RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_DIG_SITE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's archaeology dig sites change. Blizzard's archaeology frame refreshes the page it shows.

event:RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's archaeology artifact progress changes. Blizzard's archaeology frame refreshes the page it shows.

p.inviter: The name of the player offering the resurrection.

event:RESURRECT_REQUEST.s: Fires when another player offers to resurrect the player. Blizzard's UI shows the accept dialog, except in Hardcore.

p.changedName: Name of the player whose role changed.
p.fromName: Name of the player who changed it.
p.newRole: The new role, such as `TANK`, or `NONE` if removed.

event:ROLE_CHANGED_INFORM.s: Fires when a group member's role changes. Blizzard posts a chat message naming who changed it.

p.fromName: Name of the player who started the role check.

event:ROLE_POLL_BEGIN.s: Fires when the group leader starts a role check. Blizzard shows the role selection popup.

event:RUNEFORGE_LEGENDARY_CRAFTING_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops using the Runeforge. Blizzard's UI hides the Runeforge frame.

p.isUpgrade: Whether the Runeforge opened to upgrade a legendary instead of crafting one.

event:RUNEFORGE_LEGENDARY_CRAFTING_OPENE.s: Fires when the player opens the Runeforge. Blizzard's UI shows the Runeforge frame.

event:RUNEFORGE_POWER_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the data of a runeforge legendary power has been updated.

event:RUNE_POWER_UPDATE.s: Fires when a death knight rune is used or becomes ready. Blizzard's rune frame redraws its runes.

event:RUNE_TYPE_UPDATE.s: Fires when a death knight rune changes type.

p.addOnName: The addon whose settings could not be loaded.

event:SAVED_VARIABLES_TOO_LARGE.s: Fires when an addon's saved variables can't be loaded because there isn't enough memory. Blizzard's UI shows a popup naming the addon and asking to disable some addons.

event:SCENARIO_BONUS_OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE.s: Fires when a scenario bonus objective is completed.

event:SCENARIO_BONUS_VISIBILITY_UPDATE.s: Fires when scenario bonus objectives are shown or hidden. Blizzard's bonus objective tracker listens for it.

p.questID: The reward quest of the scenario.

event:SCENARIO_COMPLETED.s: Fires when the player completes a scenario. Blizzard's objective tracker shows the experience and money rewards.

event:SCENARIO_CRITERIA_SHOW_STATE_UPDAT.s: Fires when the scenario criteria should be shown or hidden in the objective tracker.

event:SCENARIO_CRITERIA_UPDATE.s: Fires when progress on a scenario criterion changes. Blizzard's scenario tracker redraws.

event:SCENARIO_POI_UPDATE.s: Fires when the map points of interest of the current scenario change.

event:SCENARIO_SPELL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the spells the current scenario offers change. Blizzard's scenario tracker redraws.

event:SCENARIO_UPDATE.s: Fires when the current scenario changes, such as when it moves to a new stage.

p.index: The slot the item was added to.

event:SCRAPPING_MACHINE_ITEM_ADDED.s: Fires when an item is added to the scrapping machine. Blizzard's scrapping frame plays the item added sound.

p.index: The slot the item was removed from.

event:SCRAPPING_MACHINE_ITEM_REMOVED.s: Fires when an item is removed from the scrapping machine. Blizzard's scrapping frame plays the item removed sound.

event:SCRAPPING_MACHINE_PENDING_ITEM_CHA.s: Fires when the items waiting in the scrapping machine change. Blizzard's scrapping frame updates its scrap button and slots.

event:SCRAPPING_MACHINE_SCRAPPING_FINISH.s: Fires when the scrapping machine finishes scrapping its items.

event:SCREENSHOT_FAILED.s: Fires when taking a screenshot fails. Blizzard's UI shows "Screen Capture Failed" (`SCREENSHOT_FAILURE`).

event:SCREENSHOT_STARTED.s: Fires when a screenshot starts being taken. Blizzard's status message hides so it isn't captured.

event:SCREENSHOT_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when a screenshot has been saved. Blizzard's UI shows "Screen Captured" (`SCREENSHOT_SUCCESS`).

event:SCRIPTED_ANIMATIONS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the scripted animation effect data changes. Blizzard's UI reloads it with `ScriptedAnimationEffectsUtil.ReloadDB`.

event:SEARCH_DB_LOADED.s: Fires when the game's search database has loaded. Blizzard's encounter journal and wardrobe restart any search in progress.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_CANCEL.s: Fires when a pending secure transfer confirmation is cancelled. Blizzard's secure transfer dialog hides.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_CONFIRM_HOUSING_PU.s: Fires when a housing purchase needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's secure transfer dialog shows the quantity and cost from `C_SecureTransfer`.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_CONFIRM_SEND_MAIL.s: Fires when sending mail needs the player's confirmation, because the recipient might be a stranger. Blizzard's dialog reads the details with `C_SecureTransfer.GetMailSendInfo`.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_CONFIRM_TAKE_MAIL_.s: Fires when taking money from a mail needs the player's confirmation, because the sender might be a stranger. Blizzard's dialog reads the sender with `C_SecureTransfer.GetMailReceiveInfo`.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_CONFIRM_TRADE_ACCE.s: Fires when accepting a trade needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's secure transfer dialog asks.

event:SECURE_TRANSFER_HOUSING_CURRENCY_P.s: Fires when buying housing virtual currency (Hearthsteel) needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's dialog reads the product with `C_SecureTransfer.GetHousingVCPurchaseProductID`.

event:SELECTED_LOADOUT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the selected talent loadout changes. Blizzard's talents frame updates its loadout menu.

event:SELF_RES_SPELL_CHANGED.s: Fires when the ways the dead player can resurrect themselves change, such as a soulstone. Blizzard's UI redraws the death dialog if it is shown.

event:SEND_MAIL_COD_CHANGED.s: Fires when the cash on delivery amount of the letter being written changes. Blizzard's money frames update.

event:SEND_MAIL_MONEY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the money attached to the letter being written changes. Blizzard's money frames update.

event:SETTINGS_LOADED.s: Fires once the player's game settings have loaded.

p.openToCategoryID: The category to open, or nil.
p.scrollToElementName: The setting to scroll to, or nil.

event:SETTINGS_PANEL_OPEN.s: Fires when the game asks to open the settings panel. Blizzard's settings panel opens, to a category when one is given.

p.productIds: The IDs of the seen products.

event:SET_SEEN_PRODUCTS.s: Fires with the shop products the player has already seen. Blizzard's shop stores them unless it already has a saved set.

event:SHARD_TRANSFER.s: Fires when the player is moved to another shard. Blizzard hides the imminent shard transfer notice.

event:SHARD_TRANSFER_CANCELLED.s: Fires when a pending shard transfer is cancelled. Blizzard hides the imminent shard transfer notice.

event:SHARD_TRANSFER_IMMINENT.s: Fires when the player is about to be moved to another shard. Blizzard shows a notice with a countdown; `SHARD_TRANSFER` or `SHARD_TRANSFER_CANCELLED` follows.

event:SHIPMENT_CRAFTER_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with a garrison work order NPC. Blizzard's work order frame stops its updates.

p.maxShipments: The most shipments that can be queued.
p.ownedShipments: The number of shipments the player has.
p.plotInstanceID: The plot of the building the work orders belong to.
p.shipmentCount: The number of shipments in progress.

event:SHIPMENT_CRAFTER_INFO.s: Fires when the information for an open garrison work order NPC arrives. Blizzard's work order frame draws the shipment slots.

p.charShipmentContainerID: The shipment container the NPC uses.

event:SHIPMENT_CRAFTER_OPENED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with a garrison work order NPC. Blizzard shows the work order frame; `SHIPMENT_CRAFTER_INFO` follows with its data.

event:SHIPMENT_CRAFTER_REAGENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the reagents available for garrison work orders change. Blizzard's work order frame redraws.

p.hasAttachedFollower: Whether the shipment has a follower attached.
p.shipmentStarted: Whether a new shipment was started.

event:SHIPMENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when a garrison shipment changes. Blizzard requests the shipment data again with `C_Garrison.RequestShipmentInfo`, and pulses the minimap button when a shipment starts.

event:SHOW_END_OF_MATCH_UI.s: Fires when a match ends and its results screen should show.

event:SHOW_FACTION_SELECT_UI.s: Fires when the game asks a neutral character to choose a faction. Blizzard shows the faction choice frame.

event:SHOW_HYPERLINK_TOOLTIP.s: Fires when the game asks to show a tooltip for a hyperlink. Blizzard's UI shows it.

event:SHOW_LFG_EXPAND_SEARCH_PROMPT.s: Fires when a dungeon finder search has been taking a while. Blizzard's UI asks whether to expand the search to dungeons from other expansions.

p.lessAwesome: Whether to show a smaller toast.
p.personalLootToast: Whether the reward came from personal loot.
p.quantity: How many were received, or the amount of money or honor.
p.specID: The loot specialization the reward was for.
p.toastMethod: Where the loot came from, passed to the toast as its loot source.

event:SHOW_LOOT_TOAST.s: Fires when the game wants a loot toast shown for something the player received. Blizzard's alert frames show an item, money, currency (personal loot only) or honor toast depending on `typeIdentifier`.

event:SHOW_LOOT_TOAST_LEGENDARY_LOOTED.s: Fires when the player loots a legendary item. Blizzard's UI shows the legendary item toast.

p.baseQuality: The item's quality before the upgrade.
p.lessAwesome: Whether to show a smaller toast.
p.personalLootToast: Whether the item came from personal loot.
p.specID: The loot specialization the item was for.

event:SHOW_LOOT_TOAST_UPGRADE.s: Fires when the player receives an item that was upgraded from its base quality. Blizzard's UI shows the loot upgrade toast.

p.cosmeticOwnerName: The name of the neighborhood's current owner.

event:SHOW_NEIGHBORHOOD_OWNERSHIP_TRANSF.s: Fires when the player is offered ownership of a neighborhood. Blizzard shows a dialog that calls `C_Housing.AcceptNeighborhoodOwnership` or `C_Housing.DeclineNeighborhoodOwnership`.

event:SHOW_NEW_PRODUCT_NOTIFICATION.s: Fires when the shop may have new products to point out. The character select screen shows a badge on its shop button while `C_CatalogShop.HasNewProducts` is true.

event:SHOW_PARTY_POSE_UI.s: Fires at the end of a match or encounter to show the party pose screen. Blizzard shows the party pose celebration frame.

event:SHOW_PLAYER_EVICTED_DIALOG.s: Fires when the player has been evicted from a neighborhood. Blizzard shows a dialog telling them.

p.lessAwesome: Whether to show a smaller toast.
p.personalLootToast: Whether the reward came from personal loot.
p.quantity: How many were received, or the amount of money.
p.specID: The loot specialization the reward was for.

event:SHOW_PVP_FACTION_LOOT_TOAST.s: Fires when the player receives a PvP faction reward. Blizzard's alert frames show an item, money or currency toast depending on `typeIdentifier`.

p.lessAwesome: Whether to show a smaller toast.
p.personalLootToast: Whether the reward came from personal loot.
p.quantity: How many were received, or the amount of money.
p.specID: The loot specialization the reward was for.

event:SHOW_RATED_PVP_REWARD_TOAST.s: Fires when the player receives a rated PvP reward. Blizzard's alert frames show an item, money or currency toast depending on `typeIdentifier`.

event:SHOW_STAIR_DIRECTION_CONFIRMATION.s: Fires when the player must choose a direction for a new stairwell in the house editor. Blizzard's UI asks and answers with `C_HousingLayout.ConfirmStairChoice`.

p.type: Which kind of offer to show (`Enum.SubscriptionInterstitialType`).

event:SHOW_SUBSCRIPTION_INTERSTITIAL.s: Fires when the game should show a subscription offer screen. Blizzard shows the subscription interstitial frame.

p.sender: The name of the speaker, if any.
p.subtitle: The subtitle text.

event:SHOW_SUBTITLE.s: Fires when a subtitle line should be shown during a cinematic or movie. Blizzard's subtitles frame shows it when subtitles are turned on.

event:SIMPLE_BROWSER_POPUP.s: Fires when a page in the in-game browser opens a popup window. Blizzard's photo sharing browser shows the popup at that URL.

event:SIMPLE_BROWSER_SOCIAL_CALLBACK_INV.s: Fires when the in-game browser reaches the callback URL of a social sign-in. Blizzard's photo sharing browser completes authorization with `C_PhotoSharing.CompleteAuthorizationFlow`.

event:SIMPLE_BROWSER_WEB_ERROR.s: Fires when a page in the in-game browser fails to load. Blizzard's UI shows an error dialog with the code.

event:SIMPLE_BROWSER_WEB_PROXY_FAILED.s: Fires when the in-game browser cannot connect through its web proxy. Blizzard's UI shows an error dialog.

event:SIMPLE_CHECKOUT_CLOSED.s: Fires when the in-game store's checkout window closes.

event:SKILL_LINES_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's skills change, such as learning a profession or a skill rising.

event:SKILL_LINE_SPECS_RANKS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the ranks of the player's profession specializations change. Blizzard's profession tutorials check whether to remind the player of a new specialization.

event:SKILL_LINE_SPECS_UNLOCKED.s: Fires when profession specializations are unlocked for the player. Blizzard shows an alert and updates the professions frame tabs.

event:SOCIAL_QUEUE_CONFIG_UPDATED.s: Fires when the Quick Join configuration changes. Blizzard's Quick Join toast reads it again with `C_SocialQueue.GetConfig`.

event:SOCIAL_QUEUE_UPDATE.s: Fires when a group shown in Quick Join changes. Blizzard's Quick Join toast and friends frame update.

event:SOCIAL_UI_FRIENDS_LIST_SYSTEM_STAT.s: Fires when the friends list system is turned on or off. Blizzard's social frame updates which features it offers.

event:SOCIAL_UI_RAID_LIST_SYSTEM_STATUS_.s: Fires when the availability of the social raid list system changes. Blizzard's raid frame social view updates.

event:SOCIAL_UI_SOCIAL_QUEUE_SYSTEM_STAT.s: Fires when the Quick Join feature becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard's Quick Join view updates.

event:SOCIAL_UI_SYSTEM_STATUS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the social UI system is turned on or off. Blizzard's friends frame hides itself and its subframes when `C_SocialUI.IsSystemEnabled()` becomes true.

event:SOCKET_INFO_ACCEPT.s: Fires when the player applies gems in the socketing frame. Blizzard disables the sockets until `SOCKET_INFO_SUCCESS` or `SOCKET_INFO_FAILURE`.

event:SOCKET_INFO_BIND_CONFIRM.s: Fires when socketing would bind the item and needs confirmation. Blizzard shows the bind confirmation dialog.

event:SOCKET_INFO_CLOSE.s: Fires when the item socketing interface closes. Blizzard hides `ItemSocketingFrame`.

event:SOCKET_INFO_FAILURE.s: Fires when socketing gems fails. Blizzard enables the sockets again.

event:SOCKET_INFO_REFUNDABLE_CONFIRM.s: Fires when socketing would make the item no longer refundable and needs confirmation. Blizzard shows a confirmation dialog.

event:SOCKET_INFO_SUCCESS.s: Fires when socketing gems succeeds. Blizzard enables the sockets again.

p.uiType: The socketing interface type now in use.

event:SOCKET_INFO_UI_EVENT_REGISTRATION_.s: Fires when the kind of socketing interface in use changes. Blizzard's socketing frames register their events only when the type is theirs.

event:SOCKET_INFO_UPDATE.s: Fires when the socketing information of an item is available or changes, such as when the player starts socketing it. Blizzard loads and shows the item socketing frame.

event:SOULBIND_ACTIVATED.s: Fires when the player activates a soulbind.

event:SOULBIND_CONDUIT_COLLECTION_CLEARE.s: Fires when the player's conduit collection is cleared. Blizzard's conduit list rebuilds itself.

event:SOULBIND_CONDUIT_COLLECTION_REMOVE.s: Fires when a conduit is removed from the player's collection.

event:SOULBIND_CONDUIT_COLLECTION_UPDATE.s: Fires when a conduit in the player's collection is added or changes.

p.nodeID: The node the conduit went into.

event:SOULBIND_CONDUIT_INSTALLED.s: Fires when a conduit is installed in a soulbind node.

event:SOULBIND_CONDUIT_UNINSTALLED.s: Fires when a conduit is removed from a soulbind node.

event:SOULBIND_FORGE_INTERACTION_ENDED.s: Fires when the player stops interacting with the Forge of Bonds.

event:SOULBIND_FORGE_INTERACTION_STARTED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with the Forge of Bonds.

event:SOULBIND_NODE_LEARNED.s: Fires when the player learns a soulbind node.

event:SOULBIND_NODE_UNLEARNED.s: Fires when a soulbind node is unlearned.

event:SOULBIND_NODE_UPDATED.s: Fires when a soulbind node changes.

event:SOULBIND_PATH_CHANGED.s: Fires when the path chosen through a soulbind tree changes.

event:SOULBIND_PENDING_CONDUIT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the conduit waiting to be installed in a soulbind node changes.

p.soundHandle: The handle of the sound that finished.

event:SOUNDKIT_FINISHED.s: Fires when a sound played with `PlaySound` finishes, if its fourth argument asked for a finish callback. Blizzard's customization audio compares the handle with the one `PlaySound` returned.

event:SOUND_DEVICE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of sound devices changes.

event:SPECIALIZATION_CHANGE_CAST_FAILED.s: Fires when the cast to change specialization fails.

p.isPet: Whether it was the pet's specialization that changed.

event:SPEC_INVOLUNTARILY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the game changes the player's specialization because the old one was disabled. Blizzard's UI shows a popup saying so.

event:SPEED_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's speed stat changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

event:SPELLS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's spells change, such as after learning or unlearning a spell or changing specialization. Many Blizzard frames refresh on it, among them the spellbook and the stable.

event:SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_GLOW_HIDE.s: Fires when a spell's proc glow on action buttons should stop. Blizzard's action buttons and cooldown viewer hide the glow.
