event:SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_GLOW_SHOW.s: Fires when a spell's proc glow on action buttons should start. Blizzard's action buttons and cooldown viewer show the glow.

p.spellID: The spell whose overlays to hide; `nil` for all.

event:SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_HIDE.s: Fires when spell activation overlays around the character should hide. Blizzard's overlay frame hides the spell's overlays, or all of them when no spell is given.

p.locationType: Where on the screen to show it.
p.spellID: The spell the overlay is for.

event:SPELL_ACTIVATION_OVERLAY_SHOW.s: Fires when a spell activation overlay (proc art around the character) should show. Blizzard's overlay frame shows it if the `displaySpellActivationOverlays` CVar is on.

p.currencyCost: How much of that currency it costs.
p.duration: How long the prompt stays open, in seconds.

event:SPELL_CONFIRMATION_PROMPT.s: Fires when a spell asks the player to confirm it, such as a bonus roll. Blizzard shows a dialog or the bonus roll frame for the prompt.

event:SPELL_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT.s: Fires when a spell confirmation prompt expires. Blizzard hides the dialog or bonus roll frame it showed.

event:SPELL_DATA_LOAD_RESULT.s: Fires when spell data requested with `C_Spell.RequestLoadSpellData` has loaded or failed to load.

p.spellID: The spell in the flyout that changed.

event:SPELL_FLYOUT_UPDATE.s: Fires when a spell flyout changes. Blizzard updates the flyout buttons and the action buttons that hold that flyout.

event:SPELL_POWER_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's spell power changes. Blizzard's character frame queues an update of its stats.

p.slot: The action slot the spell was placed in; it may be `0` when the gamepad interface is enabled.

event:SPELL_PUSHED_TO_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the game places a newly learned spell on the player's action bar. Blizzard plays the icon fly-in animation to that slot.

p.flyoutSlot: The action slot of the flyout.

event:SPELL_PUSHED_TO_FLYOUT_ON_ACTIONBA.s: Fires when the game places a newly learned spell into a flyout on the player's action bar. Blizzard plays the icon fly-in animation.

event:SPELL_TEXT_UPDATE.s: Fires when a spell's description text has been updated. Blizzard's frames redraw tooltips for that spell.

event:SPELL_UPDATE_CHARGES.s: Fires when the charges of one of the player's spells change. Blizzard's action buttons update their count.

p.startRecoveryCategory: The global cooldown category that changed.

event:SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN.s: Fires when the cooldown of one of the player's spells changes. Blizzard's action buttons and cooldown displays refresh their cooldowns.

event:SPELL_UPDATE_ICON.s: Fires when the icon of one of the player's spells changes. Blizzard's action buttons and cooldown viewer refresh their icons.

event:SPELL_UPDATE_USABLE.s: Fires when the usability of the player's spells changes. Blizzard's flyout buttons and cooldown viewer update.

event:SPELL_UPDATE_USES.s: Fires when the remaining uses of one of the player's spells change. Blizzard's cooldown viewer updates.

event:STARTER_BUILD_ACTIVATION_FAILED.s: Fires when activating the starter talent build fails. Blizzard's talents frame goes back to the previous loadout.

event:START_AUTOREPEAT_SPELL.s: Fires when the player starts an auto-repeating spell, such as Auto Shot or a wand attack. Blizzard's action buttons start flashing; `STOP_AUTOREPEAT_SPELL` fires when it stops.

p.lootHandle: The loot the roll belongs to, if any.
p.rollID: The new roll, used with `GetLootRollItemInfo` and `RollOnLoot`.
p.rollTime: How long the roll lasts; Blizzard's roll frame uses it as the length of its timer bar.

event:START_LOOT_ROLL.s: Fires when a group loot roll starts for an item. Blizzard's UI adds a roll frame for it until the time runs out or `CANCEL_LOOT_ROLL` fires.

p.informChat: Whether to report it in chat.
p.initiatedBy: The GUID of the player who started it.
p.initiatedByName: The name of that player, or nil.
p.totalTime: The countdown's full length, in seconds.

event:START_PLAYER_COUNTDOWN.s: Fires when a group member starts a countdown, such as with `C_PartyInfo.DoCountdown`. Blizzard's timer frame shows it.

p.totalTime: The timer's full length, in seconds.

event:START_TIMER.s: Fires when a timer starts, such as the countdown before a PvP match or a Mythic+ run begins. Blizzard's timer frame shows it.

event:STOP_AUTOREPEAT_SPELL.s: Fires when the player's auto-repeating spell stops. Blizzard's action buttons stop flashing.

event:STOP_MOVIE.s: Fires when the movie being played should stop. Blizzard's movie frame finishes the movie.

event:STOP_TIMER_OF_TYPE.s: Fires when timers of one kind should stop. Blizzard's timer frame hides them.

event:STORE_FRONT_STATE_UPDATED.s: Fires when an account store front becomes available or unavailable. Blizzard enables or disables its Plunderstore button.

p.streamingStatus: The streaming status, as `GetFileStreamingStatus` returns it.

event:STREAMING_ICON.s: Fires when the game's file streaming status changes. Blizzard updates the streaming icon; `GetFileStreamingStatus` returns the same status.

p.lastReadTime: When the stream was last read, if known.

event:STREAM_VIEW_MARKER_UPDATED.s: Fires when the read marker of a club stream changes. Blizzard's communities list updates its unread notification for that club.

event:SUPER_TRACKING_CHANGED.s: Fires when what the player super-tracks (the quest or waypoint the navigation points to) changes.

event:SUPER_TRACKING_PATH_UPDATED.s: Fires when the path to the super-tracked target changes. Blizzard's waypoint map pins and quest trackers refresh.

event:SURVEY_DELIVERED.s: Fires when an in-game survey is delivered to the player. Blizzard's UI shows the survey button.

p.b: The blue part of the message color.
p.g: The green part of the message color.
p.r: The red part of the message color.

event:SYSMSG.s: Fires with a system message for the error frame. Blizzard's `UIErrorsFrame` shows it in the given color.

event:SYSTEM_VISIBILITY_CHANGED.s: Fires when UI systems are shown or hidden by the system visibility manager.

event:TABARD_CANSAVE_CHANGED.s: Fires when whether the tabard design can be saved changes. Blizzard's tabard frame updates its buttons.

event:TABARD_SAVE_PENDING.s: Fires when a tabard design is being saved. Blizzard's tabard frame updates its buttons.

p.isPetTalents: Whether the pet's talents were reset.

event:TALENTS_INVOLUNTARILY_RESET.s: Fires when the game resets some of the player's or pet's talents, such as after talent tree changes. Blizzard's UI shows a popup unless the character is a returning one.

event:TALKINGHEAD_CLOSE.s: Fires when the talking head dialog should close. Blizzard closes the talking head frame.

event:TALKINGHEAD_REQUESTED.s: Fires when a talking head dialog, an NPC speaking with a portrait, should play. Blizzard's talking head frame plays it.

event:TASK_PROGRESS_UPDATE.s: Fires when progress on a task (bonus objective) quest changes.

event:TAXIMAP_CLOSED.s: Fires when the flight map closes. Blizzard's taxi and flight map frames hide.

event:TAXIMAP_OPENED.s: Fires when the player talks to a flight master. Blizzard's UI shows the taxi map when `system` is `Enum.UIMapSystem.Taxi`.

event:TAXI_NODE_STATUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the status of flight points changes. Blizzard's map redraws its flight point pins.

p.timePlayedThisLevel: The time played at the current level, in seconds.
p.totalTimePlayed: The total time played on the character, in seconds.

event:TIME_PLAYED_MSG.s: Fires with the player's played time, after `RequestTimePlayed` or `/played`. Blizzard's chat frame prints it.

p.showConsole: Whether to show the console, if given.

event:TOGGLE_CONSOLE.s: Fires when the developer console should be shown or hidden. Blizzard's console frame toggles itself.

event:TOKEN_AUCTION_SOLD.s: Fires when a WoW Token the player listed on the auction house sells. Blizzard's UI prints a sold message in chat and the token frame refreshes the player's listed tokens.

event:TOKEN_BUY_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.s: Fires when buying a WoW Token needs the player's confirmation at the current price. Blizzard's token dialog asks the player to confirm the buyout.

p.result: The result code, such as `LE_TOKEN_RESULT_SUCCESS` or `LE_TOKEN_RESULT_ERROR_NONE_FOR_SALE`.

event:TOKEN_BUY_RESULT.s: Fires when an attempt to buy a WoW Token has been handled. Blizzard's token frames show an error when the purchase fails or the market is disabled.

event:TOKEN_CAN_VETERAN_BUY_UPDATE.s: Fires when the client learns whether a veteran account may buy a WoW Token. Blizzard's character select screen checks the account's veteran status with it.

p.result: The result of the update; Blizzard's code treats 1 as success.

event:TOKEN_DISTRIBUTIONS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the account's WoW Token distribution information is updated. Blizzard's character select screen checks the veteran status again when it succeeds.

p.result: The result code, such as `LE_TOKEN_RESULT_ERROR_DISABLED` when the token market is unavailable.

event:TOKEN_MARKET_PRICE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the current WoW Token market price arrives. Blizzard's token frames update the price, or mark the market disabled when the result says so.

event:TOKEN_REDEEM_BALANCE_UPDATED.s: Fires when the balance a WoW Token can be redeemed for changes. Blizzard's token redemption frame updates its balance option.

p.choiceType: What the token is being redeemed for, such as `LE_TOKEN_REDEEM_TYPE_GAME_TIME`.

event:TOKEN_REDEEM_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.s: Fires when redeeming a WoW Token needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's token dialog asks for game time or balance confirmation depending on the choice.

event:TOKEN_REDEEM_FRAME_SHOW.s: Fires when the WoW Token redemption frame should open. Blizzard's frame shows and keeps its redeem buttons disabled until the token system is available.

event:TOKEN_REDEEM_GAME_TIME_UPDATED.s: Fires when the amount of game time a WoW Token redeems for is known. Blizzard's redemption frame shows it.

p.choiceType: What the token was redeemed for.

event:TOKEN_REDEEM_RESULT.s: Fires when redeeming a WoW Token has been handled. Blizzard's token dialog shows success or failure.

event:TOKEN_SELL_CONFIRMED.s: Fires when the player has confirmed listing a WoW Token on the auction house. Blizzard's token sell frame clears its item slot.

event:TOKEN_SELL_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.s: Fires when listing a WoW Token on the auction house needs the player's confirmation. Blizzard's token dialog asks the player to confirm the auction.

p.result: The result code, such as `LE_TOKEN_RESULT_ERROR_DISABLED` when token auctions are unavailable.

event:TOKEN_SELL_RESULT.s: Fires when listing a WoW Token on the auction house has been handled. Blizzard's token frame shows an error when it fails.

event:TOKEN_STATUS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the availability of the WoW Token system changes. Blizzard's token frames re-read `C_WowTokenPublic.GetCommerceSystemStatus` and refresh.

p.anchorFrame: The frame to anchor the comparison to, or nil.
p.tooltip: The tooltip to show the comparison next to.

event:TOOLTIP_SHOW_ITEM_COMPARISON.s: Fires when the game asks to show item comparison tooltips next to a tooltip. Blizzard's tooltip comparison code shows them.

p.hasFanfare: Whether the toy has a fanfare to show.
p.isNew: Whether the toy was just added.
p.itemID: The toy that changed, if any.

event:TOYS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the toy box changes. Blizzard's toy box redraws, and for a new toy it pages to it and the collections button shows an alert.

event:TRACKABLE_INFO_UPDATE.s: Fires when the information of a trackable piece of content changes. Blizzard's adventure objective tracker redraws.

p.added: Whether it was added rather than removed.

event:TRACKED_ACHIEVEMENT_LIST_CHANGED.s: Fires when an achievement is added to or removed from the player's tracked achievements. Blizzard's achievement objective tracker redraws.

p.duration: The duration of a timed criteria.
p.elapsed: The time elapsed of a timed criteria.

event:TRACKED_ACHIEVEMENT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the progress of a tracked achievement changes. Blizzard's achievement objective tracker updates it, with a timer bar when it is timed.

p.trackedHouse: The house now tracked, if any.

event:TRACKED_HOUSE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the house the player tracks changes. Blizzard's status tracking bars update, among them the house favor bar.

p.tracked: Whether the recipe is now tracked.

event:TRACKED_RECIPE_UPDATE.s: Fires when a profession recipe is added to or removed from the objective tracker. Blizzard's recipe tracker and recipe forms update their tracking state.

event:TRACKING_TARGET_INFO_UPDATE.s: Fires when the information about where to find tracked content changes. Blizzard's adventure objective tracker and map pins update.

p.playerAccepted: `1` if the player has accepted, `0` if not.
p.targetAccepted: `1` if the trade partner has accepted, `0` if not.

event:TRADE_ACCEPT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player or the trade partner accepts the trade or withdraws acceptance. Blizzard's trade frame updates its accept highlights.

event:TRADE_CLOSED.s: Fires when the trade window closes. Blizzard hides the trade frame and its warning dialogs.

event:TRADE_CURRENCY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the currency the trade partner offers changes.

event:TRADE_MONEY_CHANGED.s: Fires when the money the trade partner offers changes. Blizzard's money frames for the partner's offer update.

event:TRADE_PLAYER_ITEM_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item the player offers in a trade changes. Blizzard's trade frame updates that slot.

p.canBecomeBoundForTrade: Whether the item could become bound.

event:TRADE_POTENTIAL_BIND_ENCHANT.s: Fires when an enchant offered in the trade could bind the item it is applied to. Blizzard shows or hides a warning dialog.

p.tradeSlotIndex: The trade slot the item is in.

event:TRADE_POTENTIAL_REMOVE_TRANSMOG.s: Fires when trading an item would remove its transmogrification. Blizzard shows a warning dialog naming the item.

p.existing: The name of the current enchant.
p.replacement: The name of the new enchant.

event:TRADE_REPLACE_ENCHANT.s: Fires when an enchant applied through the trade window would replace the item's existing one and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ReplaceTradeEnchant`.

p.name: The name of the player who asked.

event:TRADE_REQUEST.s: Fires when another player asks to trade with the player. Blizzard shows the trade request dialog; `TRADE_REQUEST_CANCEL` fires if the request is withdrawn.

event:TRADE_REQUEST_CANCEL.s: Fires when a trade request is cancelled. Blizzard hides the trade request dialog.

event:TRADE_SHOW.s: Fires when the trade window opens. Blizzard shows the trade frame; `TRADE_CLOSED` fires when it closes.

event:TRADE_SKILL_CLOSE.s: Fires when the open profession window closes. Blizzard's professions frames hide and action buttons update.

event:TRADE_SKILL_CRAFTING_REAGENT_BONUS.s: Fires when the bonus text of a crafting reagent becomes available.

event:TRADE_SKILL_CRAFT_BEGIN.s: Fires when the player starts crafting a profession recipe. Blizzard's crafting details note the recipe so they can animate its result.

p.data: The result of the craft, including the currency.

event:TRADE_SKILL_CURRENCY_REWARD_RESULT.s: Fires when a craft gives the player a currency. Blizzard's crafting output log adds it.

event:TRADE_SKILL_DATA_SOURCE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the profession the trade skill functions read has finished changing. Blizzard's crafting page resets itself.

event:TRADE_SKILL_DATA_SOURCE_CHANGING.s: Fires when the profession the trade skill functions read is about to change; `TRADE_SKILL_DATA_SOURCE_CHANGED` follows. While it changes, `C_TradeSkillUI.IsDataSourceChanging` returns true.

event:TRADE_SKILL_DETAILS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the details of the open profession change.

p.isFavorite: Whether the recipe is now a favorite.

event:TRADE_SKILL_FAVORITES_CHANGED.s: Fires when a profession recipe is marked or unmarked as a favorite. Blizzard's recipe form and crafter order page update their favorite buttons.

p.data: The result of the craft, including the item.

event:TRADE_SKILL_ITEM_CRAFTED_RESULT.s: Fires when the player crafts an item. Blizzard's crafting output log adds it and the crafting details play the quality animation.

event:TRADE_SKILL_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when an item used by the profession window changes. Blizzard's recipe form refreshes when it is the item being recrafted.

event:TRADE_SKILL_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the recipe list of the open profession changes, which filter changes can also cause. Blizzard's professions frame rebuilds its list.

event:TRADE_SKILL_NAME_UPDATE.s: Fires when the name of the open profession changes. Blizzard's professions frame refreshes its title.

event:TRADE_SKILL_SHOW.s: Fires when a profession window opens. Blizzard's professions frame shows its crafting page and action buttons update.

event:TRADE_TARGET_ITEM_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item the trade partner offers changes. Blizzard's trade frame updates that slot.

event:TRADE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the trade changes as a whole. Blizzard's trade frame redraws.

event:TRADE_UPDATE_WARNINGS.s: Fires when the warnings shown for the trade change. Blizzard's trade frame updates its warnings.

event:TRAINER_CLOSED.s: Fires when the player stops talking to a trainer.

event:TRAINER_DESCRIPTION_UPDATE.s: Fires when the description of the selected trainer service is available or changes. Blizzard's trainer frame selects the service again to redraw its details.

event:TRAINER_SERVICE_INFO_NAME_UPDATE.s: Fires when the name of a trainer service arrives. Blizzard's trainer frame redraws its list.

event:TRAINER_SHOW.s: Fires when the player opens a trainer. Blizzard's UI loads and shows the trainer frame.

event:TRAINER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the trainer's list of services changes, such as after a filter change. Blizzard's trainer frame redraws the list.

event:TRAINING_GROUNDS_ENABLED_STATUS_UP.s: Fires when the training grounds become available or unavailable. Blizzard's PvP frame refreshes its queue button.

event:TRAIT_COND_INFO_CHANGED.s: Fires when the information of a trait condition changes.

p.configInfo: Information about the new configuration, including its `ID` and `type`.

event:TRAIT_CONFIG_CREATED.s: Fires when a talent (trait) configuration, such as a new loadout, is created. Blizzard's talent frame refreshes its loadout list for combat configurations.

event:TRAIT_CONFIG_DELETED.s: Fires when a talent (trait) configuration, such as a loadout, is deleted.

event:TRAIT_CONFIG_LIST_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of the player's talent (trait) configurations changes. Blizzard's talent frame refreshes its loadout list.

event:TRAIT_CONFIG_UPDATED.s: Fires when a talent (trait) configuration changes, for example after a commit finishes. Blizzard's talent frames refresh the trees that use it.

event:TRAIT_NODE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a node in a talent (trait) tree changes. Blizzard's talent frames mark the node's cached info as stale and read it again.

event:TRAIT_NODE_CHANGED_PARTIAL.s: Fires when some fields of a talent (trait) node change. Blizzard's talent frames copy the non-nil fields into their cached node info.

event:TRAIT_NODE_ENTRY_UPDATED.s: Fires when an entry of a talent (trait) node changes.

event:TRAIT_SUB_TREE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a talent sub tree, such as a hero talent tree, changes.

event:TRAIT_SYSTEM_INTERACTION_STARTED.s: Fires when the player starts interacting with an NPC or object that opens a trait tree. Blizzard's UI opens the matching trait frame.

event:TRAIT_SYSTEM_NPC_CLOSED.s: Fires when the interaction that opened a trait tree ends. Blizzard's trait frames close.

event:TRAIT_TREE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a talent (trait) tree changes. Blizzard's talent frames redraw the tree.

event:TRAIT_TREE_CURRENCY_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the currencies spent in a talent (trait) tree, such as its points, change.

event:TRANSMOGRIFY_CLOSE.s: Fires when the player stops using the transmogrifier. Blizzard's classic UI hides the wardrobe frame.

event:TRANSMOGRIFY_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when the items in the transmogrifier's slots update. Blizzard's classic transmog frame redraws its slots.

event:TRANSMOGRIFY_OPEN.s: Fires when the player talks to a transmogrifier. Blizzard's classic UI loads the collections and shows the wardrobe frame.

event:TRANSMOGRIFY_SUCCESS.s: Fires when a transmogrification is applied to a slot. Blizzard's wardrobe redraws its items.

p.transmogLocation: The slot that changed, if any.

event:TRANSMOGRIFY_UPDATE.s: Fires when a pending transmog change is set or cleared. Blizzard's wardrobe redraws its items for the slot.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_CAMERA_UPDATE.s: Fires when the camera settings used for appearance previews change. Blizzard's wardrobe resets its model cameras.

p.isFavorite: Whether it is now a favorite.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_ITEM_FAVORITE_.s: Fires when an appearance is marked or unmarked as a favorite. Blizzard's set details show or hide the favorite star.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_ITEM_UPDATE.s: Fires when item data for appearances in the collection arrives or changes. Blizzard's dressing room and wardrobe refresh their tooltips and lists.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_SOURCE_ADDED.s: Fires when the player collects a new appearance source. Blizzard's objective tracker completes tracked appearances, and a toast shows while the Trading Post is open.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_SOURCE_REMOVED.s: Fires when an appearance source is removed from the player's collection.

p.collectionIndex: The collection category that changed, if given.
p.itemAppearanceID: The appearance that changed, if given.

event:TRANSMOG_COLLECTION_UPDATED.s: Fires when the appearance collection changes. Blizzard's wardrobe and transmog frames refresh their lists.

event:TRANSMOG_COSMETIC_COLLECTION_SOURC.s: Fires when the player collects a new cosmetic appearance. Blizzard's UI shows the new cosmetic toast.

event:TRANSMOG_CUSTOM_SETS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's custom transmog sets change. Blizzard's transmog frames update their set lists.

event:TRANSMOG_DISPLAYED_OUTFIT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the transmog outfit the player displays changes. Blizzard's transmog frame refreshes its outfit list.

p.newOutfitID: The outfit just added, if any.

event:TRANSMOG_OUTFITS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player's transmog outfits change, such as one being saved or deleted. Blizzard's transmog frame refreshes its outfit list.

p.collectionType: The collection category searched, if any.

event:TRANSMOG_SEARCH_UPDATED.s: Fires when a search of the appearance collection updates its results. Blizzard's transmog frame refreshes the list that matches `searchType` and `collectionType`.

event:TRANSMOG_SETS_UPDATE_FAVORITE.s: Fires when a transmog set is marked or unmarked as a favorite. Blizzard's set lists redraw.

p.collectable: Whether the player can collect it.

event:TRANSMOG_SOURCE_COLLECTABILITY_UPD.s: Fires when it changes whether the player can collect an appearance source. Blizzard's dressing room marks its set details for a redraw.

event:TREASURE_PICKER_CACHE_FLUSH.s: Fires when cached quest reward data is cleared. Blizzard's PvP match results check their conquest reward data again and wait for `QUEST_LOG_UPDATE` if it isn't there yet.

event:TRIAL_CAP_REACHED_MONEY.s: Fires when a trial account reaches its money cap. Blizzard's UI prints "Free Trial money cap reached." to chat (`CAPPED_MONEY_TRIAL`).

p.nodeFinishedOn: The last node that was bought.

event:TRY_PURCHASE_TO_NODE_PARTIAL_SUCCE.s: Fires when an attempt to buy every node up to a target node stops part of the way. Blizzard's artifact UI plays the purchase effects on the node it reached.

event:TUTORIAL_COMBAT_EVENT.s: Fires when combat happens in the new player experience tutorial. Blizzard's tutorial listens for it during its combat lessons.

p.tutorialGlobalStringTag: The global string to show with the highlight.

event:TUTORIAL_HIGHLIGHT_SPELL.s: Fires when a tutorial wants a spell highlighted on the action bar. Blizzard's boost tutorial points at the spell with the given text.

p.forceShow: Whether to show it even if it was shown before.

event:TUTORIAL_TRIGGER.s: Fires when a tutorial tip should show. Blizzard's tutorial frame adds the tip.

event:TUTORIAL_UNHIGHLIGHT_SPELL.s: Fires when a tutorial's spell highlights should be removed. Blizzard's boost tutorial clears them.

p.errorType: The kind of error, which identifies the message independent of language.

event:UI_ERROR_MESSAGE.s: Fires when the game reports an error to the player, such as an inventory full or out of range message. Blizzard's `UIErrorsFrame` shows it in red.

event:UI_ERROR_POPUP.s: Fires when the game reports an error that should be shown in a dialog. Blizzard shows it as a popup notification.

p.errorType: The kind of message, which identifies it independent of language.

event:UI_INFO_MESSAGE.s: Fires when the game shows an information message to the player, such as quest progress. Blizzard's `UIErrorsFrame` shows it in yellow.

event:UI_MODEL_SCENE_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the model scene data the UI uses has updated. Blizzard's frames that show model scenes reload them.

event:UI_SCALE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the UI scale changes. Many Blizzard frames recompute their size and position.

event:UNIT_ABSORB_AMOUNT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the damage absorb shields on a unit change. Blizzard's unit frames redraw their absorb bars.

event:UNIT_AREA_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit moves to another area.

event:UNIT_ATTACK.s: Fires when a unit's melee attack values change. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose attack power changed.

event:UNIT_ATTACK_POWER.s: Fires when a unit's melee attack power changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose attack speed changed.

event:UNIT_ATTACK_SPEED.s: Fires when a unit's attack speed changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

p.updateInfo: What changed: `addedAuras`, `updatedAuraInstanceIDs` and `removedAuraInstanceIDs`, or `isFullUpdate` when every aura should be read again.

event:UNIT_AURA.s: Fires when the auras on a unit change. The payload says which auras were added, updated or removed, so frames can update without rescanning every aura.

event:UNIT_AURA_BLOCKED.s: Fires when an aura on a unit is blocked from the private aura display. Blizzard's private aura frames track it as blocked.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose block list was cleared.

event:UNIT_AURA_BLOCK_LIST_CLEARED.s: Fires when the list of blocked auras on a unit is cleared. Blizzard's private aura frames forget their blocked auras for that unit.

event:UNIT_CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's classification, such as elite or rare, changes. Blizzard's target frame redraws its border.

p.amount: The amount of damage or healing.
p.schoolMask: Bit mask of the damage schools involved.

event:UNIT_COMBAT.s: Fires when a unit takes damage or heals, or an attack on it is blocked, absorbed or resisted. Blizzard's player and pet frames show it as feedback text on the portrait.

p.isConnected: Whether the unit is online now.

event:UNIT_CONNECTION.s: Fires when a group member goes offline or comes back online.

event:UNIT_CTR_OPTIONS.s: Fires when a group member's status icon options change. Blizzard's party and raid frames update the icon in the middle of the frame.

event:UNIT_DAMAGE.s: Fires when a unit's melee damage changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

event:UNIT_DEFENSE.s: Fires when a unit's defense changes.

p.unitGUID: GUID of the unit that died.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose power type changed.

event:UNIT_DISPLAYPOWER.s: Fires when the type of power a unit shows changes, such as a druid shifting from mana to energy. Blizzard's unit frames redraw their power bars.

p.isInDistance: Whether the unit is within the distance now.

event:UNIT_DISTANCE_CHECK_UPDATE.s: Fires when a group member moves into or out of the distance the raid frames check. Blizzard's raid frames update how far away the unit looks.

p.hasPitch: Whether the vehicle can aim up and down.
p.isControlSeat: Whether the unit's seat controls the vehicle.
p.mayChooseExit: Whether the unit may leave the vehicle.
p.showVehicleFrame: Whether the vehicle has its own unit frame.
p.vehicleUIIndicatorID: The vehicle seat indicator to show.

event:UNIT_ENTERED_VEHICLE.s: Fires when a unit has entered a vehicle; `UNIT_ENTERING_VEHICLE` fires before it. Blizzard's unit frames switch to the vehicle and the raid frame shows a vehicle indicator.

p.hasPitch: Whether the vehicle can aim up and down.
p.isControlSeat: Whether the unit's seat controls the vehicle.
p.mayChooseExit: Whether the unit may leave the vehicle.
p.showVehicleFrame: Whether the vehicle has its own unit frame.
p.vehicleUIIndicatorID: The vehicle seat indicator to show.

event:UNIT_ENTERING_VEHICLE.s: Fires when a unit begins entering a vehicle; `UNIT_ENTERED_VEHICLE` follows once it is in.

event:UNIT_EXITED_VEHICLE.s: Fires when a unit has left a vehicle. Blizzard's unit frames switch back and the vehicle seat indicator unloads for the player; `UNIT_EXITING_VEHICLE` fires before it.

event:UNIT_EXITING_VEHICLE.s: Fires when a unit begins leaving a vehicle; `UNIT_EXITED_VEHICLE` follows. Blizzard's combat text switches back to the player.

event:UNIT_FACTION.s: Fires when a unit's faction or PvP status changes. Blizzard's player and party frames update the PvP icon.

event:UNIT_FLAGS.s: Fires when a unit's flags, such as its combat or PvP state, change.

event:UNIT_FORM_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit changes form, such as a druid shapeshifting. Blizzard's dressing room and transmog frames refresh the player model.

event:UNIT_GUILD_LEVEL.s: Fires when the player's guild reaches a new level. The Cataclysm-era level up display shows a guild level banner.

event:UNIT_HAPPINESS.s: Fires when a hunter pet's happiness changes. Blizzard's pet happiness icon updates.

event:UNIT_HEALTH.s: Fires when a unit's health changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose heal absorbs changed.

event:UNIT_HEAL_ABSORB_AMOUNT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the heal absorbs on a unit, which soak up incoming healing, change. Blizzard's unit frames redraw their heal prediction bars.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose incoming heals changed.

event:UNIT_HEAL_PREDICTION.s: Fires when the healing about to land on a unit changes. Blizzard's unit frames redraw their heal prediction bars.

event:UNIT_INVENTORY_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's equipped items change.

p.isInRange: Whether the unit is in range now.

event:UNIT_IN_RANGE_UPDATE.s: Fires when a group member moves into or out of range. Blizzard's raid frames fade out units that are out of range.

event:UNIT_LEVEL.s: Fires when a unit's level changes.

event:UNIT_LOOT.s: Fires when a unit becomes lootable or stops being lootable.

event:UNIT_MANA.s: Fires when a unit's mana changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose maximum health changed.

event:UNIT_MAXHEALTH.s: Fires when a unit's maximum health changes.

p.powerType: The power type that changed, such as `MANA`.
p.unitTarget: The unit whose maximum power changed.

event:UNIT_MAXPOWER.s: Fires when a unit's maximum power changes.

p.percentMaxHealthAdjusted: The share of maximum health the effects take away.

event:UNIT_MAX_HEALTH_MODIFIERS_CHANGED.s: Fires when effects that lower a unit's maximum health change. Blizzard's unit frames redraw the lost health.

event:UNIT_MODEL_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's model changes. Blizzard's character and tabard frames refresh their models.

event:UNIT_NAME_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's name changes or becomes known.

event:UNIT_OTHER_PARTY_CHANGED.s: Fires when a group member joins or leaves another group, such as an instance group. Blizzard's party and raid frames update their status icon.

p.unitTarget: The unit that owns the pet.

event:UNIT_PET.s: Fires when a unit's pet is summoned, dismissed or changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose pet's experience changed.

event:UNIT_PET_EXPERIENCE.s: Fires when the experience of the player's pet changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes the pet experience bar.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose pet's training points changed.

event:UNIT_PET_TRAINING_POINTS.s: Fires when the training points of the player's pet change. Blizzard's trainer frame refreshes.

event:UNIT_PHASE.s: Fires when a unit's phase changes relative to the player. Blizzard's party and raid frames update the phase icon.

p.uiTextureKit: The texture kit of the ping.

event:UNIT_PING_PIN_ADDED.s: Fires when a ping is placed on a unit. Blizzard's unit frames show the ping on the unit's frame.

event:UNIT_PING_PIN_REMOVED.s: Fires when a ping on a unit is removed. Blizzard's unit frames clear it.

event:UNIT_PORTRAIT_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's portrait needs to be redrawn.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose bar was hidden.

event:UNIT_POWER_BAR_HIDE.s: Fires when a unit's alternate power bar is hidden.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose bar is shown.

event:UNIT_POWER_BAR_SHOW.s: Fires when a unit gains an alternate power bar, such as for an encounter. Blizzard shows the bar.

event:UNIT_POWER_BAR_TIMER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the timers on a unit's alternate power bar change. Blizzard's buff timer bars refresh.

p.powerType: The power type that changed, such as `MANA`.

event:UNIT_POWER_FREQUENT.s: Fires when a unit's power changes, more often than `UNIT_POWER_UPDATE` does.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose charged points changed.

event:UNIT_POWER_POINT_CHARGE.s: Fires when a unit's charged power points, such as charged combo points, change. Blizzard's combo point bars redraw.

p.powerType: The power type that changed, such as `MANA`.

event:UNIT_POWER_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's power, such as mana, rage or energy, changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose quest log changed.

event:UNIT_QUEST_LOG_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit's quest log changes. Blizzard's quest log refreshes when the unit is the player.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose ranged damage changed.

event:UNIT_RANGEDDAMAGE.s: Fires when a unit's ranged damage changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose ranged attack power changed.

event:UNIT_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER.s: Fires when a unit's ranged attack power changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

event:UNIT_RESISTANCES.s: Fires when a unit's armor or resistances change. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the channel is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_START.s: Fires when a unit starts channeling a spell. Blizzard's cast bars start their channel display.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the channel was shown on.
p.interruptedBy: GUID of the unit that interrupted the channel, if any.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_STOP.s: Fires when a unit stops channeling a spell, whether it finished or was cut short.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the channel is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_UPDATE.s: Fires when the time left on a unit's channeled spell changes, such as when the channel is pushed back.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_DELAYED.s: Fires when a unit's cast is pushed back, such as by taking damage. Blizzard's cast bars update the cast's end time.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_EMPOWER_START.s: Fires when a unit starts an empowered cast. Blizzard's cast bars show its stages.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.
p.interruptedBy: GUID of the unit that interrupted the cast, if any.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_EMPOWER_STOP.s: Fires when a unit's empowered cast ends, whether released or cut short.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_EMPOWER_UPDATE.s: Fires when the timing of a unit's empowered cast changes. Blizzard's cast bars update its stages.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.
p.unitTarget: The unit that tried to cast.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_FAILED.s: Fires when a unit's cast fails, such as for lack of a target or resources.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.
p.unitTarget: The unit that tried to cast.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_FAILED_QUIET.s: Fires when a unit's cast fails without an error message being shown.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.
p.interruptedBy: GUID of the unit that interrupted the cast, if any.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED.s: Fires when a unit's cast is interrupted.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTIBLE.s: Fires when a unit's current cast becomes interruptible. Blizzard's cast bars drop their shield.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_NOT_INTERRUPTIBLE.s: Fires when a unit's current cast can no longer be interrupted. Blizzard's cast bars show a shield.

p.spellID: The spell that was being aimed.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_RETICLE_CLEAR.s: Fires when the player stops aiming a ground-targeted spell. Blizzard's action buttons refresh.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_RETICLE_TARGET.s: Fires when the player starts aiming a ground-targeted spell with the targeting circle. Blizzard's action buttons refresh.

p.castGUID: GUID of this cast, matching the events that follow.
p.target: Name of the spell's target, if any.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_SENT.s: Fires when the client sends a cast request to the server, before the cast starts. Blizzard's `/castsequence` handling uses it to track the pending cast.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast is shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_START.s: Fires when a unit starts casting a spell with a cast time. Blizzard's cast bars start showing the cast.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_STOP.s: Fires when a unit's cast ends, whether it finished or was cut short.

p.castBarID: The cast bar the cast was shown on.
p.unitTarget: The unit that cast the spell.

event:UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED.s: Fires when a unit's spell cast succeeds.

event:UNIT_SPELL_DIMINISH_CATEGORY_STATE.s: Fires when the diminishing returns state of a spell category changes on a unit. Blizzard's diminishing returns tray adds or updates the category.

event:UNIT_SPELL_HASTE.s: Fires when a unit's spell haste changes. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

event:UNIT_STATS.s: Fires when a unit's primary stats change. Blizzard's character frame refreshes its stats.

event:UNIT_TARGET.s: Fires when a unit's target changes.

event:UNIT_TARGETABLE_CHANGED.s: Fires when a unit becomes targetable or untargetable.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose threat list changed.

event:UNIT_THREAT_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's threat list changes.

p.unitTarget: The unit whose threat status changed.

event:UNIT_THREAT_SITUATION_UPDATE.s: Fires when a unit's threat status changes. Blizzard's unit frames update their threat highlight.

event:UPDATE_ACTIVE_BATTLEFIELD.s: Fires when the battlefield the player is active in changes. Blizzard's party frames and raid frame manager update.

event:UPDATE_ALL_UI_WIDGETS.s: Fires when all UI widgets should be refreshed. Blizzard's widget containers process all their widgets again.

event:UPDATE_BATTLEFIELD_SCORE.s: Fires when new scoreboard data for the current battleground or arena is available. Blizzard's match scoreboard redraws its table.

p.battleFieldIndex: The queue slot whose status changed.

event:UPDATE_BATTLEFIELD_STATUS.s: Fires when the status of one of the player's battleground or arena queues changes, such as queued, invited or in the match. Blizzard's UI updates its queue status and the ready dialog.

event:UPDATE_BINDINGS.s: Fires when key bindings change. Blizzard's action buttons and other frames redraw the hotkeys they show.

event:UPDATE_BONUS_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the bonus action bar changes, such as when the player changes stance or form. Blizzard's action bars update.

event:UPDATE_BULLETIN_BOARD_MEMBER_TYPE.s: Fires when a neighborhood member's resident type changes. Blizzard's bulletin board roster updates the member.

event:UPDATE_BULLETIN_BOARD_ROSTER.s: Fires when the roster of the neighborhood bulletin board arrives. Blizzard fills the roster list.

event:UPDATE_BULLETIN_BOARD_ROSTER_STATU.s: Fires when the statuses of members on the neighborhood bulletin board change. Blizzard updates those roster entries.

event:UPDATE_CHAT_COLOR.s: Fires when the color of a chat type changes. Blizzard's chat frames store the new color for that type.

p.colorNameByClass: Whether names are now colored by class.
p.name: The chat type, such as `"SAY"`.

event:UPDATE_CHAT_COLOR_NAME_BY_CLASS.s: Fires when the setting to color sender names by class changes for a chat type.

event:UPDATE_CHAT_WINDOWS.s: Fires when the saved settings of the chat windows are loaded or change. Blizzard's chat frames apply the window's font size and other settings.

event:UPDATE_EXHAUSTION.s: Fires when the player's rested experience changes. Blizzard's experience bar redraws.

event:UPDATE_EXPANSION_LEVEL.s: Fires when the expansion level the account can play changes. Read it with `GetExpansionLevel`.

event:UPDATE_EXTRA_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the extra action button appears, disappears or changes. Blizzard's extra action bar updates.

event:UPDATE_FACTION.s: Fires when the player's reputation information changes. Blizzard's reputation frames, renown displays and reputation bar refresh.

event:UPDATE_FLOATING_CHAT_WINDOWS.s: Fires when the floating chat windows need to be updated. Blizzard's chat frames refresh each window's layout.

event:UPDATE_INSTANCE_INFO.s: Fires when the player's saved instance information arrives or changes. Blizzard's UI then reads it with `GetNumSavedInstances`.

event:UPDATE_INVENTORY_ALERTS.s: Fires when the durability warnings for the player's equipped items change. Blizzard updates the durability figure and the equipment slot buttons.

event:UPDATE_INVENTORY_DURABILITY.s: Fires when the durability of the player's items changes. Blizzard's merchant frame updates its repair buttons.

event:UPDATE_LFG_LIST.s: Fires when the looking-for-group listings change.

event:UPDATE_MACROS.s: Fires when the player's macros change. Blizzard's macro frame redraws its list.

event:UPDATE_MASTER_LOOT_LIST.s: Fires when the list of players the master looter can give loot to changes. Blizzard's master looter frame redraws its player list.

event:UPDATE_MOUSEOVER_UNIT.s: Fires when the unit under the mouse cursor changes, so `mouseover` refers to a new unit.

event:UPDATE_MULTI_CAST_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the multi-cast (totem) action bar changes. Blizzard's totem bar updates.

event:UPDATE_OVERRIDE_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the override action bar appears, disappears or changes. Blizzard's action bars update.

event:UPDATE_PENDING_MAIL.s: Fires when the player's unread mail status changes. Blizzard shows or hides the minimap mail icon by `HasNewMail`.

event:UPDATE_POSSESS_BAR.s: Fires when the possess bar changes. Blizzard's UI updates the possess and stance bars.

event:UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_COOLDOWN.s: Fires when the cooldown of the player's stance or form abilities changes. Blizzard's stance bar updates.

event:UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_FORM.s: Fires when the player changes stance or form. `GetShapeshiftFormID` returns the new form; Blizzard's action bars update.

event:UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_FORMS.s: Fires when the stances or forms available to the player change. Blizzard's stance bar updates.

event:UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_USABLE.s: Fires when the usability of the player's stances or forms changes. Blizzard's stance bar updates.

event:UPDATE_SPELL_TARGET_ITEM_CONTEXT.s: Fires when the items a pending spell can target change. Blizzard's item buttons update which items they highlight.

event:UPDATE_STEALTH.s: Fires when the player enters or leaves stealth. Blizzard's secure state driver rescans its macro conditions.

event:UPDATE_SUMMONPETS_ACTION.s: Fires when the summon pet actions on the player's action bars change. Blizzard's action buttons update the icons of their `summonpet` actions.

p.isScrapping: Whether the cast that stopped was scrapping.

event:UPDATE_TRADESKILL_CAST_STOPPED.s: Fires when a profession cast stops, including a scrapping cast. Blizzard's scrapping machine clears its items when a scrap stops.

event:UPDATE_UI_WIDGET.s: Fires when one UI widget changes. Blizzard's widget containers update it if it belongs to their widget set and unit.

event:UPDATE_VEHICLE_ACTIONBAR.s: Fires when the vehicle action bar changes. Blizzard's action bars and pet bar update.

p.caseDescription: The description to show for the case.
p.caseIndex: The index of the ticket's case.
p.caseTitle: The title to show for the case.
p.hasTicket: Whether the player has an open ticket.
p.numTickets: How many tickets the player has.
p.ticketStatus: The ticket's status, such as `LE_TICKET_STATUS_OPEN` or `LE_TICKET_STATUS_RESPONSE`.
p.waitMessage: A message about the wait, which may contain a time format.

event:UPDATE_WEB_TICKET.s: Fires when the state of the player's support ticket arrives, such as after `GetWebTicket`. Blizzard's help frame shows the ticket's status, such as the wait time or a response waiting.

event:URL_TEXTURE_REQUEST_RESULT.s: Fires with the progress of loading a texture from a URL. Blizzard's shop shows a spinner while the result is `Requested`.

event:USER_WAYPOINT_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's map waypoint is set, changed or cleared. Blizzard's map waypoint pins and tracking pin button update.

event:USE_BIND_CONFIRM.s: Fires when using an item would bind it to the player and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ConfirmBindOnUse`.

p.useCombinedBags: Whether combined bags are now used.

event:USE_COMBINED_BAGS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the setting to show all bags as one combined bag changes. Blizzard's bag frames switch layout.

event:USE_GLYPH.s: Fires when the player uses a glyph or glyph remover and must choose the spell to use it on. Blizzard's UI opens the spellbook, which shows its pending glyph visuals.

event:USE_NO_REFUND_CONFIRM.s: Fires when using an item would make it non-refundable and needs confirming. Blizzard's UI asks and confirms with `C_Item.ConfirmNoRefundOnUse`.

event:VARIABLES_LOADED.s: Fires when the game has loaded its saved settings (CVars, key bindings). Blizzard reads CVars on it; together with `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` it marks a UI ready for use.

event:VEHICLE_ANGLE_SHOW.s: Fires when the aim angle display of the player's vehicle should be shown or hidden.

p.normalizedPitch: The pitch scaled to the vehicle's aiming range; Blizzard places its pitch marker by it.

event:VEHICLE_ANGLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the aiming angle of the player's vehicle changes. Blizzard's vehicle bar moves its pitch slider.

event:VEHICLE_PASSENGERS_CHANGED.s: Fires when the passengers of the player's vehicle change. Blizzard's vehicle seat indicator updates.

event:VEHICLE_POWER_SHOW.s: Fires when the power display of the player's vehicle should be shown or hidden.

event:VEHICLE_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's vehicle state changes. Blizzard's leave vehicle button updates.

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the transmog outfit being viewed at the transmogrifier changes. Blizzard's transmog frame redraws its slots.

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_SECONDARY_S.s: Fires when the secondary slots, such as a separate shoulder, of the transmog outfit being viewed change. Blizzard's transmog frame redraws its slots.

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_SITUATIONS_.s: Fires when the situations set for the transmog outfit being viewed change. Blizzard's transmog frame updates the cost it shows.

p.option: The option now chosen for the slot.

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_SLOT_OPTION.s: Fires when the option chosen for a slot of the transmog outfit being viewed changes.

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_SLOT_REFRES.s: Fires when the slots of the transmog outfit being viewed need to be redrawn. Blizzard's transmog frame refreshes the slots and cost.

p.type: Whether an appearance or an illusion was saved (`Enum.TransmogType`).

event:VIEWED_TRANSMOG_OUTFIT_SLOT_SAVE_S.s: Fires when a slot of the transmog outfit being viewed is saved.

event:VIEW_HOUSES_LIST_RECIEVED.s: Fires when a list of houses to view arrives. Blizzard's house list frame shows them.

event:VIGNETTES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the vignettes around the player change. Blizzard's map vignette provider redraws its pins.

p.onMinimap: Whether the vignette is now on the minimap.

event:VIGNETTE_MINIMAP_UPDATED.s: Fires when a vignette appears on or disappears from the minimap.

event:VOICE_CHAT_ACTIVE_INPUT_DEVICE_UPD.s: Fires when the voice chat microphone in use changes. The active device is not a CVar and only updates once the voice service answers, so Blizzard's audio settings refresh the input device dropdown on this event.

event:VOICE_CHAT_ACTIVE_OUTPUT_DEVICE_UP.s: Fires when the voice chat output device in use changes. Blizzard's audio settings refresh the output device dropdown on this event, since the active device only updates once the voice service answers.

p.voiceProviderID: The voice provider now in use (`Enum.VoiceProviderID`).

event:VOICE_CHAT_ACTIVE_VOICE_PROVIDER_C.s: Fires when the voice chat service the client uses changes, such as between Blizzard's own voice service and Discord. Blizzard's channel frame reports the switch in chat and notes that Discord does not support Speak for Me or transcription.

p.isSpeaking: Whether the captured audio counts as speech.

event:VOICE_CHAT_AUDIO_CAPTURE_ENERGY.s: Fires when the microphone input level is measured, repeatedly while voice chat captures audio. Blizzard's audio settings use it to drive the meter of the microphone test.

event:VOICE_CHAT_AUDIO_CAPTURE_STARTED.s: Fires when voice chat starts capturing audio from the microphone.

event:VOICE_CHAT_AUDIO_CAPTURE_STOPPED.s: Fires when voice chat stops capturing audio from the microphone. The capture can stop on its own, such as when the voice provider has no audio source, so Blizzard's microphone test ends itself on this event.

p.channelID: The voice channel that became active.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_ACTIVATED.s: Fires when a voice channel becomes the player's active voice channel.

p.channelID: The voice channel that was deactivated.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_DEACTIVATED.s: Fires when a voice channel stops being the player's active voice channel.

p.channelID: The voice channel that was renamed.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_DISPLAY_NAME_CH.s: Fires when a voice channel's display name changes. Blizzard's channel frame renames the channel's button.

p.channelID: The voice channel that was joined.
p.channelType: The kind of chat channel the voice channel belongs to (`Enum.ChatChannelType`).
p.clubId: The community the channel belongs to, for community channels.
p.status: The result of the join (`Enum.VoiceChatStatusCode`); `Success` when the channel was joined.
p.streamId: The community stream the channel belongs to, for community channels.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_JOINED.s: Fires when an attempt to join a voice channel finishes, successfully or not.

p.isActive: Whether the member is now active in the channel.
p.memberID: The voice chat member whose state changed.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_ACTIVE_S.s: Fires when a member of a voice channel becomes active or inactive in it.

p.channelID: The voice channel the member joined.
p.memberID: The voice chat member who was added.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_ADDED.s: Fires when a member joins a voice channel.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_ENERGY_C.s: Fires when the speaking level of a voice channel member changes. Blizzard's voice activity manager uses it for its speaking indicators.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_GUID_UPD.s: Fires when the game learns which character a voice channel member is. Blizzard's channel and community frames redraw the member list.

p.isMutedForAll: Whether the member is now muted for everyone.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_MUTE_FOR.s: Fires when a voice channel member is muted or unmuted for everyone in the channel.

p.isMutedForMe: Whether the player now has the member muted.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_MUTE_FOR.s: Fires when the player mutes or unmutes a voice channel member for themselves. Blizzard's channel frame plays a mute or unmute sound.

p.channelID: The voice channel the member left.
p.memberID: The voice chat member who was removed.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_REMOVED.s: Fires when a member leaves a voice channel.

p.isSilenced: Whether the member is now silenced.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_SILENCED.s: Fires when a voice channel member is silenced or no longer silenced.

p.isSpeaking: Whether the member is now speaking.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_SPEAKING.s: Fires when a voice channel member starts or stops speaking.

p.memberID: The voice chat member who spoke.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_STT_MESS.s: Fires when speech-to-text produces a transcribed message from a voice channel member.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MEMBER_VOLUME_C.s: Fires when the volume of a voice channel member changes.

p.isMuted: Whether the channel is now muted.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_MUTE_STATE_CHAN.s: Fires when a voice channel is muted or unmuted.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_PTT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the push-to-talk setting of a voice channel changes.

p.channelID: The voice channel that was removed.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_REMOVED.s: Fires when a voice channel is removed, such as when the player leaves it.

p.isTranscribing: Whether the channel is now being transcribed.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_TRANSCRIBING_CH.s: Fires when speech-to-text transcription starts or stops for a voice channel. Blizzard's chat frames print a message when transcription starts.

p.isTransmitting: Whether the player is now transmitting.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_TRANSMIT_CHANGE.s: Fires when the player starts or stops transmitting their voice in a voice channel. Blizzard's channel frame plays the talk start or stop sound.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CHANNEL_VOLUME_CHANGED.s: Fires when the volume of a voice channel changes.

event:VOICE_CHAT_COMMUNICATION_MODE_CHAN.s: Fires when the voice chat communication mode changes, such as between push-to-talk and open mic.

event:VOICE_CHAT_CONNECTION_SUCCESS.s: Fires when the client connects to the voice chat service. Blizzard's channel frame reports a restored connection if an error was shown before.

p.isDeafened: Whether voice chat is now deafened.

event:VOICE_CHAT_DEAFENED_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player deafens or undeafens voice chat.

event:VOICE_CHAT_DISCORD_SETTINGS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the voice settings that come from Discord change. Blizzard's audio settings refresh the push-to-talk binding, the voice volumes and the chat mode.

p.platformCode: The error code from the voice platform.
p.statusCode: The voice chat status code of the error (`Enum.VoiceChatStatusCode`).

event:VOICE_CHAT_ERROR.s: Fires when the voice chat service reports an error. Blizzard's channel frame shows the matching error message in chat.

event:VOICE_CHAT_INPUT_DEVICES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of microphones available to voice chat changes. Blizzard's audio settings refresh the input device dropdown.

event:VOICE_CHAT_LOGIN.s: Fires when the client finishes logging in to the voice chat service, successfully or not. Blizzard's channel frame runs voice commands it queued while waiting for the login.

p.status: The status code of the logout (`Enum.VoiceChatStatusCode`).

event:VOICE_CHAT_LOGOUT.s: Fires when the client logs out of the voice chat service.

p.isMuted: Whether the player's microphone is now muted.

event:VOICE_CHAT_MUTED_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player mutes or unmutes their own microphone in voice chat.

event:VOICE_CHAT_OUTPUT_DEVICES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the list of output devices available to voice chat changes. Blizzard's audio settings refresh the output device dropdown.

p.channelType: The kind of chat channel being joined (`Enum.ChatChannelType`).
p.pendingJoin: Whether the join is still pending.
p.streamId: The community stream, for community channels.

event:VOICE_CHAT_PENDING_CHANNEL_JOIN_ST.s: Fires when a request to join a voice channel starts or stops waiting on the voice service.

p.isPressed: Whether push-to-talk is now held down.

event:VOICE_CHAT_PTT_BUTTON_PRESSED_STAT.s: Fires when the voice chat push-to-talk key is pressed or released.

p.isSilenced: Whether the player is now silenced.

event:VOICE_CHAT_SILENCED_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player is silenced in voice chat or no longer silenced.

event:VOICE_CHAT_SPEAK_FOR_ME_ACTIVE_STA.s: Fires when Speak for Me (reading the player's typed text aloud to the voice channel) is turned on or off. Blizzard's transcription frame and accessibility settings update on it; see `C_VoiceChat.IsSpeakForMeActive`.

event:VOICE_CHAT_SPEAK_FOR_ME_FEATURE_ST.s: Fires when the availability of the Speak for Me feature changes. Blizzard's accessibility settings show or hide its options; see `C_VoiceChat.IsSpeakForMeAllowed`.

p.bookmarkName: The name of the bookmark reached.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_PLAYBACK_BOOKMARK.s: Fires when text-to-speech playback reaches a bookmark in an utterance.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_PLAYBACK_FAILED.s: Fires when a text-to-speech utterance fails to play. Blizzard's text-to-speech frame treats it like a finished playback and moves on.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_PLAYBACK_FINISHED.s: Fires when a text-to-speech utterance finishes playing.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_PLAYBACK_STARTED.s: Fires when a text-to-speech utterance starts playing.

p.utteranceID: The utterance the request belongs to.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_SPEAK_TEXT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the status of a text-to-speech request changes.

event:VOICE_CHAT_TTS_VOICES_UPDATE.s: Fires when the list of text-to-speech voices changes or becomes available. Blizzard's accessibility settings wait for it before building their voice options.

event:VOICE_CHAT_VAD_SETTINGS_UPDATED.s: Fires when the voice activity detection settings of voice chat change.

event:VOICE_CHAT_VOICE_PROVIDERS_AVAILAB.s: Fires when the set of voice chat services the client can use changes. Blizzard's audio settings re-evaluate the voice provider and push-to-talk options.

event:VOICE_CHAT_VOICE_PROVIDER_CHANGED.s: Fires when the voice chat service the client uses changes. Blizzard's channel frame drops voice commands it had queued for the previous service's login.

p.name: The name of the player to remove.

event:VOTE_KICK_REASON_NEEDED.s: Fires when the player starts a vote to remove someone from the group and a reason is needed. Blizzard's UI asks for the reason and passes it to `C_PartyInfo.UninviteUnit`.

event:WARBAND_SCENE_FAVORITES_UPDATED.s: Fires when the player's favorite warband scenes change. Blizzard's warband scene collection redraws.

event:WARFRONT_COMPLETED.s: Fires when a Warfront the player is in ends. Blizzard's UI shows the warfront party pose screen.

event:WARGAME_INVITE_SENT.s: Fires when the player's war game challenge has been sent.

p.battlegroundName: The battleground of the war game.
p.timeoutSeconds: How long the challenge can be answered.
p.tournamentRules: Whether the war game uses tournament rules.

event:WARGAME_REQUESTED.s: Fires when another group challenges the player's group to a war game. Blizzard's PvP popup asks the player to accept, and answers with `WarGameRespond`.

p.responderGUID: The GUID of the player who answered.
p.responderName: The name of the player who answered.

event:WARGAME_REQUEST_RESPONSE.s: Fires when a challenged player answers the player's war game request.

p.warModeEnabled: Whether War Mode is now on.

event:WAR_MODE_STATUS_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's War Mode is turned on or off. Blizzard's PvP talent slots update.

event:WAYPOINT_UPDATE.s: Fires when the player's map waypoint changes.

event:WEAPON_ENCHANT_CHANGED.s: Fires when a temporary weapon enchant on the player's weapons changes. Blizzard's buff frame updates.

event:WEAPON_SLOT_CHANGED.s: Fires when the weapon in one of the player's weapon slots changes. Blizzard's buff frame updates its weapon enchant icons and the swing timer updates.

event:WEEKLY_REWARDS_ITEM_CHANGED.s: Fires when an item in the weekly rewards (Great Vault) changes. Blizzard's PvP conquest bar redraws.

event:WEEKLY_REWARDS_UPDATE.s: Fires when weekly rewards (Great Vault) progress or data changes. Blizzard's PvP conquest bar and weekly rewards frame redraw.

event:WHO_LIST_UPDATE.s: Fires when the results of a Who search arrive. Blizzard's Who list shows them.

p.guid: GUID of the world loot object.

event:WORLD_LOOT_OBJECT_INFO_UPDATED.s: Fires when the information of a world loot object changes. Blizzard's spell widgets update their type icon.

p.uiMapID: The map to open to, if any.

event:WORLD_MAP_OPEN.s: Fires when the game asks the world map to open. Blizzard opens the world map at the given map.

event:WORLD_PVP_QUEUE.s: Fires when a world PvP battle is about to begin and the player can queue for it from elsewhere. The classic UI shows a popup to join the queue alone or as a group.

event:WORLD_QUEST_COMPLETED_BY_SPELL.s: Fires when a world quest is completed by a spell.

event:WORLD_STATE_TIMER_START.s: Fires when a world state timer starts, such as a Mythic+ or Proving Grounds timer. Blizzard's objective tracker shows it.

event:WORLD_STATE_TIMER_STOP.s: Fires when a world state timer stops. Blizzard's objective tracker hides it.

event:WOW_MOUSE_NOT_FOUND.s: Fires when the game cannot find a World of Warcraft mouse. Blizzard shows a dialog saying so.

event:ZONE_CHANGED.s: Fires when the player moves into a different subzone. Blizzard updates the zone text and minimap zone name; `ZONE_CHANGED_NEW_AREA` fires instead for a new zone.

event:ZONE_CHANGED_INDOORS.s: Fires when the player moves into a different subzone indoors, or between indoors and outdoors. Blizzard updates the zone text and minimap.

event:ZONE_CHANGED_NEW_AREA.s: Fires when the player enters a new zone. Blizzard updates the zone text, minimap and maps, and the PvP status.

exp.s: Returns e raised to a power; the same as `math.exp`.

floor.s: Returns the largest whole number not greater than a number; the same as `math.floor`.

foreach.s: Calls a function with each key and value of a table, stopping if it returns a value other than nil; the same as `table.foreach`.

foreachi.s: Calls a function with each index and value of an array, stopping if it returns a value other than nil; the same as `table.foreachi`.

format.s: Returns a string built from a format string and values; the same as `string.format`.

frexp.s: Splits a number into a mantissa and a power of two; the same as `math.frexp`.

getmetatable.s: Returns the metatable of a value, or its `__metatable` field if it has one.

getn.s: Returns the length of an array; the same as `table.getn`.

gmatch.s: Returns an iterator over the matches of a pattern in a string; the same as `string.gmatch`.

gsub.s: Returns a copy of a string with matches of a pattern replaced, and the number of replacements; the same as `string.gsub`.

ldexp.s: Returns a mantissa multiplied by two raised to an exponent; the same as `math.ldexp`.

log.s: Returns the natural logarithm of a number; the same as `math.log`.

log10.s: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number; the same as `math.log10`.

math.acos.s: Returns the arc cosine of a number, in radians.

math.asin.s: Returns the arc sine of a number, in radians.

math.atan.s: Returns the arc tangent of a number, in radians. Use `math.atan2` to get the angle of a point in the right quadrant.

math.atan2.s: Returns the arc tangent of `y / x` in radians, using the signs of both arguments to pick the quadrant. It takes `y` first, then `x`.

math.cos.s: Returns the cosine of an angle given in radians.

math.cosh.s: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

math.deg.s: Converts an angle from radians to degrees.

math.frexp.s: Splits a number into a mantissa `m` and an integer exponent `e` so that the number equals `m * 2^e`, with the absolute value of `m` in [0.5, 1) (or zero).

math.ldexp.s: Returns `m * 2^e` for a mantissa `m` and an integer exponent `e`; the inverse of `math.frexp`.

math.log.s: Returns the natural logarithm of a number. In WoW's Lua 5.1 it takes no base argument; divide by `math.log(base)` for other bases.

math.log10.s: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

math.max.s: Returns the largest of its numeric arguments.

math.min.s: Returns the smallest of its numeric arguments.

math.modf.s: Returns the integer part and the fractional part of a number, both with the number's sign.

math.pow.s: Returns `x` raised to the power `y`; the same as `x ^ y`.

math.rad.s: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.

math.sinh.s: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a number.

math.sqrt.s: Returns the square root of a number.

math.tan.s: Returns the tangent of an angle given in radians.

math.tanh.s: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a number.

max.s: Returns the largest of its arguments; the same as `math.max`.

min.s: Returns the smallest of its arguments; the same as `math.min`.

mod.s: Returns the remainder of dividing one number by another; the same as `math.fmod`.

rad.s: Converts an angle from degrees to radians; the same as `math.rad`.

random.s: Returns a random number: a float from 0 to 1 with no arguments, or a whole number in the given range.

rawequal.s: Returns whether two values are equal without calling the `__eq` metamethod.

rawget.s: Returns the value of a table key without calling the `__index` metamethod.

settablesecurity.s: Sets a security option on a table, like `SetTableSecurityOption`.

sort.s: Sorts an array in place, with an optional comparison function; the same as `table.sort`.

sqrt.s: Returns the square root of a number; the same as `math.sqrt`.

strbyte.s: Returns the byte values of characters in a string; the same as `string.byte`.

strchar.s: Returns a string made from byte values; the same as `string.char`.

strcmputf8i.s: Compares two UTF-8 strings without regard to case. Returns a negative number, 0 or a positive number when the first is smaller, equal or larger.

strconcat.s: Returns its arguments joined into one string.

strfind.s: Returns the start and end of the first match of a pattern in a string, and any captures; the same as `string.find`.

string.gfind.s: Returns an iterator over the matches of a pattern in a string. It is the Lua 5.0 name of `string.gmatch`, which new code should use.

string.gmatch.s: Returns an iterator that gives the next match of a pattern in a string, or its captures, on each call; used as `for word in string.gmatch(text, "%a+") do`.

strjoin.s: Returns its string arguments joined with a separator, given as the first argument.

strlen.s: Returns the length of a string in bytes; the same as `string.len`.

strlower.s: Returns a string in lowercase; the same as `string.lower`.

strmatch.s: Returns the captures of the first match of a pattern in a string, or the whole match; the same as `string.match`.

strrep.s: Returns a string repeated a number of times; the same as `string.rep`.

strrev.s: Returns a string reversed; the same as `string.reverse`.

strsplit.s: Splits a string at a delimiter and returns the pieces as separate values. The optional last argument limits the number of pieces.

strsplittable.s: Splits a string at a delimiter and returns the pieces in a table. The optional last argument limits the number of pieces.

strsub.s: Returns part of a string, from a start to an end position; the same as `string.sub`.

strtrim.s: Returns a string with whitespace removed from both ends. An optional second argument names the characters to remove instead, such as `"\n\r"`.

strupper.s: Returns a string in uppercase; the same as `string.upper`.

tContains.s: Returns whether a table holds a value.

tDeleteItem.s: Removes every entry of an array equal to a value and returns how many it removed.

tIndexOf.s: Returns the index of the first entry of an array equal to a value, or nil if there is none.

tUnorderedRemove.s: Removes an entry from an array by moving the last entry into its place. Faster than `tremove`, but it does not keep the order.

table.maxn.s: Returns the largest positive numeric key of a table, or 0 if it has none. Unlike the `#` operator it walks the whole table, so gaps in the array do not matter.

tinsert.s: Inserts a value into an array, at the end or at a given position; the same as `table.insert`.

tremove.s: Removes an entry from an array, the last one or at a given position, and returns it; the same as `table.remove`.

wipe.s: Removes every entry from a table and returns the table.
